units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1|name|31|0
units.english: Pick up Ijs from <planet>
units.italian: Preleva Ijs da <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1|description|32|0
units.english: Bring Katya and Sawyer to <destination>, along with Raven's ship (the Eye of Horus), and pick up Ijs and his equipment for detecting atomic testing.
units.italian: Porta Katya e Sawyer su <destination>, insieme alla nave di Raven (l'Eye of Horus), e preleva Ijs con il suo equipaggiamento per rilevare i test atomici.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1|dialog|48|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that Katya, Sawyer, and Raven have not all arrived. Better depart and wait for the ships they are aboard.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che Katya, Sawyer e Raven non sono ancora arrivati tutti. Meglio ripartire e aspettare le navi su cui viaggiano.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1|log|51|0
units.english: Decided to rescue the Syndicate defector rather than turning him over to the Syndicate. A Questioner who works with Navy Intelligence has confirmed that he is telling the truth, and a ceasefire has been declared. Also, the Navy has agreed to release Katya now that there is evidence proving her innocence.
units.italian: Hai deciso di salvare il disertore del Sindacato invece di consegnarlo al Sindacato. Un Interrogatore che lavora per l'Intelligence della Marina ha confermato che dice la verità, ed è stato dichiarato un cessate il fuoco. Inoltre la Marina ha accettato di rilasciare Katya, ora che ci sono prove della sua innocenza.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1|log|52|0
units.english: Raven, whose full name is unknown, is a Questioner who works for Navy Intelligence. Through some combination of training and natural ability, she is able to reliably detect whether or not someone is telling the truth.
units.italian: Raven, il cui nome completo è sconosciuto, è un Interrogatore che lavora per l'Intelligence della Marina. Grazie a una combinazione di addestramento e capacità naturale, riesce a capire con affidabilità se qualcuno dice la verità o no.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1|log|53|0
units.english: It is unclear why the Navy needs their own intelligence force, since the Republic already has a Department of Intelligence that is incredibly powerful and well-funded. Rumors say that one of the main purposes of Navy Intelligence is to watch for human rights abuses being committed by the Republic itself and for other questionable activities that the Department of Intelligence might turn a blind eye toward or even collude with.
units.italian: Non è chiaro perché la Marina abbia bisogno di una propria forza di intelligence, dato che la Repubblica ha già un Dipartimento dell'Intelligence estremamente potente e ben finanziato. Le voci dicono che uno degli scopi principali dell'Intelligence della Marina sia sorvegliare gli abusi dei diritti umani commessi dalla Repubblica stessa, e altre attività discutibili che il Dipartimento dell'Intelligence potrebbe ignorare, o addirittura assecondare.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1|On your way to the spaceport, you fill Katya in on the state of the war. She says that Intelligence has been keeping her in a relatively comfortable but totally isolated cell; she's not even sure what world it was on. From the fact that her questioners seemed to be growing increasingly frustrated about the Free Worlds, she knew that you were still managing to resist the Navy, but they did not share any details with her.|56|0
units.english: On your way to the spaceport, you fill Katya in on the state of the war. She says that Intelligence has been keeping her in a relatively comfortable but totally isolated cell; she's not even sure what world it was on. From the fact that her questioners seemed to be growing increasingly frustrated about the Free Worlds, she knew that you were still managing to resist the Navy, but they did not share any details with her.
units.italian: Mentre andate allo spazioporto, metti al corrente Katya dello stato della guerra. Dice che l'Intelligence l'ha tenuta in una cella relativamente confortevole ma del tutto isolata; non è nemmeno sicura di su quale mondo fosse. Dal fatto che i suoi interrogatori sembrassero sempre più frustrati nei confronti delle Free Worlds, aveva capito che continuavate a resistere alla Marina, ma non le hanno condiviso nessun dettaglio.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1|	You meet up with Raven in a small tea shop, close enough to the spaceport that the tables shake each time another Free Worlds capital ship arrives in response to the Syndicate attack. "Thank you for allowing me to land here," says Raven. "Now, what questions do you have for me?"|57|0
units.english: You meet up with Raven in a small tea shop, close enough to the spaceport that the tables shake each time another Free Worlds capital ship arrives in response to the Syndicate attack. "Thank you for allowing me to land here," says Raven. "Now, what questions do you have for me?"
units.italian: Incontri Raven in una piccola sala da tè, abbastanza vicina allo spazioporto perché i tavoli tremino ogni volta che un'altra nave capitale delle Free Worlds arriva in risposta all'attacco del Sindacato. "Grazie per avermi permesso di atterrare qui," dice Raven. "Ora, che domande hai per me?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1|	"Are we at peace with the Republic now?"|59|0
units.english: "Are we at peace with the Republic now?"
units.italian: "Ora siamo in pace con la Repubblica?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1|	"Are you some sort of mind reader?"|61|0
units.english: "Are you some sort of mind reader?"
units.italian: "Sei una specie di lettrice del pensiero?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1|	"What exactly is the job of Navy Intelligence?"|63|0
units.english: "What exactly is the job of Navy Intelligence?"
units.italian: "Qual è esattamente il compito dell'Intelligence della Marina?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1|	"Well," she says, "only Parliament can decide that. But the Navy has been ordered not to attack Free Worlds ships, and the news that Sawyer brought has become public knowledge, so you'll find that most Republic worlds will be willing to welcome you, now."|67|0
units.english: "Well," she says, "only Parliament can decide that. But the Navy has been ordered not to attack Free Worlds ships, and the news that Sawyer brought has become public knowledge, so you'll find that most Republic worlds will be willing to welcome you, now."
units.italian: "Beh," dice, "questo può deciderlo solo il Parlamento. Ma alla Marina è stato ordinato di non attaccare le navi delle Free Worlds, e la notizia che ha portato Sawyer è ormai di dominio pubblico, quindi scoprirai che la maggior parte dei mondi della Repubblica ora sarà disposta ad accoglierti."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1|	"Are you some sort of mind reader?"|69|0
units.english: "Are you some sort of mind reader?"
units.italian: "Sei una specie di lettrice del pensiero?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1|	"What exactly is the job of Navy Intelligence?"|71|0
units.english: "What exactly is the job of Navy Intelligence?"
units.italian: "Qual è esattamente il compito dell'Intelligence della Marina?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1|	She laughs, and says, "No, I'm just a really good listener." When she sees that you're not satisfied with that answer, she elaborates. "The official term for us is 'empaths.' We have a heightened ability to absorb the emotional state of those around us. That, combined with extensive training, makes us better lie detectors than any machine. But if you're asking whether my abilities work through body language and vocal cues, or through some sort of mystical powers, honestly none of us knows that for sure."|75|0
units.english: She laughs, and says, "No, I'm just a really good listener." When she sees that you're not satisfied with that answer, she elaborates. "The official term for us is 'empaths.' We have a heightened ability to absorb the emotional state of those around us. That, combined with extensive training, makes us better lie detectors than any machine. But if you're asking whether my abilities work through body language and vocal cues, or through some sort of mystical powers, honestly none of us knows that for sure."
units.italian: Ride e dice: "No, sono solo una che ascolta molto bene." Quando vede che la risposta non ti soddisfa, si spiega meglio. "Il termine ufficiale per noi è 'empati'. Abbiamo una capacità accentuata di assorbire lo stato emotivo di chi ci sta intorno. Questo, unito a un addestramento intenso, ci rende migliori rilevatori di bugie di qualsiasi macchina. Ma se mi chiedi se le mie capacità funzionano tramite il linguaggio del corpo e i segnali della voce, o tramite una specie di potere mistico, sinceramente nessuno di noi lo sa per certo."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1|	"Are we at peace with the Republic now?"|77|0
units.english: "Are we at peace with the Republic now?"
units.italian: "Ora siamo in pace con la Repubblica?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1|	"What exactly is the job of Navy Intelligence?"|79|0
units.english: "What exactly is the job of Navy Intelligence?"
units.italian: "Qual è esattamente il compito dell'Intelligence della Marina?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1|	She says, "I assume your real question is, why does Navy Intelligence exist at all, since the Republic already has a very powerful, well-funded, and nearly omniscient Department of Intelligence that exists independent of the Navy? The short answer is, we don't trust them. Someone needs to watch the watchers."|83|0
units.english: She says, "I assume your real question is, why does Navy Intelligence exist at all, since the Republic already has a very powerful, well-funded, and nearly omniscient Department of Intelligence that exists independent of the Navy? The short answer is, we don't trust them. Someone needs to watch the watchers."
units.italian: Dice: "Immagino che la tua domanda vera sia perché l'Intelligence della Marina esista affatto, dato che la Repubblica ha già un Dipartimento dell'Intelligence molto potente, ben finanziato e quasi onnisciente, che esiste indipendentemente dalla Marina. La risposta breve è che non ci fidiamo di loro. Qualcuno deve sorvegliare i sorveglianti."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1|	"Are we at peace with the Republic now?"|85|0
units.english: "Are we at peace with the Republic now?"
units.italian: "Ora siamo in pace con la Repubblica?"

units.english: "Are you some sort of mind reader?"
units.italian: "Sei una specie di lettrice del pensiero?"

The short answer is, we don't trust them. Someone needs to watch the watchers."
