La risposta breve è che non ci fidiamo di loro. Qualcuno deve sorvegliare i sorveglianti."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1|	Katya asks, "What do we do now? Will Sawyer's evidence be enough to end this war?"|103|0
units.english: Katya asks, "What do we do now? Will Sawyer's evidence be enough to end this war?"
units.italian: Katya chiede: "Che cosa facciamo adesso? Le prove di Sawyer basteranno a porre fine a questa guerra?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1|	Raven says, "Possibly. Especially because the Syndicate incriminated themselves by chasing after him. But the Syndicate has so much power in Parliament that the more evidence we can collect, the better. And that means we should visit the world where he said the development was done, and look for more evidence there."|104|0
units.english: Raven says, "Possibly. Especially because the Syndicate incriminated themselves by chasing after him. But the Syndicate has so much power in Parliament that the more evidence we can collect, the better. And that means we should visit the world where he said the development was done, and look for more evidence there."
units.italian: Raven dice: "Forse. Soprattutto perché il Sindacato si è autoaccusato dando la caccia a lui. Ma il Sindacato ha così tanto potere in Parlamento che più prove raccogliamo, meglio è. Il che significa che dovremmo visitare il mondo dove ha detto che è stato fatto lo sviluppo, e cercare altre prove lì."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1|	Katya says, "Captain <last>, is Ijs Springborn still working for the Free Worlds?"|105|0
units.english: Katya says, "Captain <last>, is Ijs Springborn still working for the Free Worlds?"
units.italian: Katya dice: "Capitano <last>, Ijs Springborn lavora ancora per le Free Worlds?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1|	You tell her that the last you heard, Ijs was helping to found a new university on <planet>. She says, "We should bring him with us. Raven, will you be traveling with us too?"|106|0
units.english: You tell her that the last you heard, Ijs was helping to found a new university on <planet>. She says, "We should bring him with us. Raven, will you be traveling with us too?"
units.italian: Le dici che, per quanto ne sai, Ijs stava aiutando a fondare una nuova università su <planet>. Dice: "Dovremmo portarlo con noi. Raven, verrai anche tu con noi?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1|	"Yes," she says. "I'll tell my ship and crew to get ready."|107|0
units.english: "Yes," she says. "I'll tell my ship and crew to get ready."
units.italian: "Sì," dice. "Dirò alla mia nave e al mio equipaggio di prepararsi."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|name|123|0
units.english: Travel to <planet>
units.italian: Va' su <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|description|124|0
units.english: Bring Ijs, Sawyer, and Katya to <system>. Destroy any Syndicate ships that are watching you, then land on <planet>. Make sure Raven's ship arrives there as well. You may need to bribe Syndicate worlds to let you refuel.
units.italian: Porta Ijs, Sawyer e Katya nel sistema <system>. Distruggi tutte le navi del Sindacato che ti stanno osservando, poi atterra su <planet>. Assicurati che anche la nave di Raven arrivi lì. Potrebbe essere necessario corrompere i mondi del Sindacato perché ti lascino fare rifornimento.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|blocked|131|0
units.english: You need another bunk free (for Ijs) in order to continue this mission.
units.italian: Per continuare questa missione ti serve un'altra cuccetta libera (per Ijs).

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|The moment you land Katya is eager to visit the Conservatory and find Ijs. In the time that he has been here, it has grown into a small but bustling community, with crowds of students walking from building to building carrying backpacks and wrapped in thick coats. You find Ijs' office; Katya knocks and says, "Professor Springborn, are you having office hours right now?"|140|0
units.english: The moment you land Katya is eager to visit the Conservatory and find Ijs. In the time that he has been here, it has grown into a small but bustling community, with crowds of students walking from building to building carrying backpacks and wrapped in thick coats. You find Ijs' office; Katya knocks and says, "Professor Springborn, are you having office hours right now?"
units.italian: Appena atterri, Katya è impaziente di visitare il Conservatorio e trovare Ijs. Nel tempo che ha passato qui, è diventato una piccola ma vivace comunità, con folle di studenti che camminano da un edificio all'altro con gli zaini in spalla e avvolti in cappotti pesanti. Trovi l'ufficio di Ijs; Katya bussa e dice: "Professor Springborn, è in orario di ricevimento adesso?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|	He recognizes her voice immediately and comes running out of the office to hug her. "Katya! You're free! Is the war over?"|141|0
units.english: He recognizes her voice immediately and comes running out of the office to hug her. "Katya! You're free! Is the war over?"
units.italian: Riconosce subito la sua voce e corre fuori dall'ufficio ad abbracciarla. "Katya! Sei libera! La guerra è finita?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|	"Not quite," she says, "but we've found the bombers. Apparently the whole thing was sponsored by the Syndicate. Do you still have those isotopic fingerprints we collected back when this whole thing began?"|142|0
units.english: "Not quite," she says, "but we've found the bombers. Apparently the whole thing was sponsored by the Syndicate. Do you still have those isotopic fingerprints we collected back when this whole thing began?"
units.italian: "Non proprio," dice, "ma abbiamo trovato gli attentatori. A quanto pare l'intera cosa era sponsorizzata dal Sindacato. Hai ancora quelle impronte isotopiche che avevamo raccolto quando è cominciato tutto?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|	Ijs quickly finds the data and collects his equipment. "I'll just have to let them know I need a substitute for a while," he says.|143|0
units.english: Ijs quickly finds the data and collects his equipment. "I'll just have to let them know I need a substitute for a while," he says.
units.italian: Ijs trova rapidamente i dati e raccoglie la sua attrezzatura. "Dovrò solo far sapere che mi serve un supplente per un po'," dice.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|	Back at the spaceport, you meet up with Raven. "Here's the deal," she says. "We need to get to <planet>, destroy any Syndicate ships that are watching, and then land and hope we have time to collect evidence before more of them arrive. Unless you've got a ramscoop, we may need to bribe our way onto a few Syndicate worlds to refuel. And of course, I'll be counting on you to help keep my ship safe. Any questions?"|144|0
units.english: Back at the spaceport, you meet up with Raven. "Here's the deal," she says. "We need to get to <planet>, destroy any Syndicate ships that are watching, and then land and hope we have time to collect evidence before more of them arrive. Unless you've got a ramscoop, we may need to bribe our way onto a few Syndicate worlds to refuel. And of course, I'll be counting on you to help keep my ship safe. Any questions?"
units.italian: Tornati allo spazioporto, vi incontrate con Raven. "Ecco come stanno le cose," dice. "Dobbiamo arrivare su <planet>, distruggere tutte le navi del Sindacato che ci osservano, poi atterrare e sperare di avere il tempo di raccogliere prove prima che ne arrivino altre. A meno che tu non abbia un ramscoop, potremmo dover corrompere qualcuno per entrare in alcuni mondi del Sindacato a fare rifornimento. E naturalmente conto su di te per tenere al sicuro la mia nave. Domande?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|	"No, I'm ready to go!"|146|0
units.english: "No, I'm ready to go!"
units.italian: "No, sono pronto a partire!"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|	"Won't they have destroyed any evidence long before we get there?"|148|0
units.english: "Won't they have destroyed any evidence long before we get there?"
units.italian: "Non avranno distrutto tutte le prove molto prima che arriviamo?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|	"Probably," she says, "but if they did any testing there, we should be able to pick up the residue. Or at least, my people will be able to, because they've got military grade Navy equipment."|149|0
units.english: "Probably," she says, "but if they did any testing there, we should be able to pick up the residue. Or at least, my people will be able to, because they've got military grade Navy equipment."
units.italian: "Probabilmente," dice, "ma se lì hanno fatto dei test, dovremmo riuscire a captare i residui. O almeno, la mia gente ci riuscirà, perché ha equipaggiamento militare della Marina."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|	"So do we," says Ijs, sheepishly.|150|0
units.english: "So do we," says Ijs, sheepishly.
units.italian: "Anche noi," dice Ijs, imbarazzato.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|	Raven looks surprised for a moment, then says, "Never mind, I'm sure there's a good story of how you got your hands on that equipment, but it can wait for another time. Let's get moving."|151|0
units.english: Raven looks surprised for a moment, then says, "Never mind, I'm sure there's a good story of how you got your hands on that equipment, but it can wait for another time. Let's get moving."
units.italian: Raven sembra sorpresa per un momento, poi dice: "Non importa, sono sicura che ci sia una bella storia su come vi siete procurati quell'equipaggiamento, ma può aspettare un'altra volta. Muoviamoci."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|	As you and the others start walking to the landing pads, Raven approaches you. "Captain, are you sure you're ready to head to <planet>?"|157|0
units.english: As you and the others start walking to the landing pads, Raven approaches you. "Captain, are you sure you're ready to head to <planet>?"
units.italian: Mentre tu e gli altri cominciate a camminare verso le piazzole, Raven ti si avvicina. "Capitano, sei sicuro di essere pronto ad andare su <planet>?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|	"Absolutely. I could blow up a thousand Syndicate fleets in my sleep."|159|0
units.english: "Absolutely. I could blow up a thousand Syndicate fleets in my sleep."
units.italian: "Assolutamente. Potrei far saltare in aria mille flotte del Sindacato nel sonno."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|	"I'm worried about fighting Syndicate ships on the way there."|160|0
units.english: "I'm worried about fighting Syndicate ships on the way there."
units.italian: "Mi preoccupa combattere le navi del Sindacato lungo la strada."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|	Raven smirks. "It would be nice to strongarm our way through Syndicate space. But, in case Syndicate forces prove to be too much and we're forced to flee, I'd suggest swapping out your hyperdrive for a scram drive. Syndicate Quicksilvers are notoriously agile, and their Proton Guns make it nearly impossible to jump with a regular hyperdrive.|162|0
units.english: Raven smirks. "It would be nice to strongarm our way through Syndicate space. But, in case Syndicate forces prove to be too much and we're forced to flee, I'd suggest swapping out your hyperdrive for a scram drive. Syndicate Quicksilvers are notoriously agile, and their Proton Guns make it nearly impossible to jump with a regular hyperdrive.
units.italian: Raven sogghigna. "Sarebbe bello aprirci la strada con la forza nello spazio del Sindacato. Ma, nel caso le forze del Sindacato si rivelassero troppo superiori e fossimo costretti a fuggire, suggerirei di sostituire il tuo iperpropulsore con un motore scram. I Quicksilver del Sindacato sono notoriamente agili, e i loro cannoni protonici rendono quasi impossibile saltare con un iperpropulsore normale.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|	"That is indeed a danger. Syndicate Quicksilvers are notoriously agile, and if they swarm us, their Proton Guns will push you around and prevent regular hyperdrives from jumping."|165|0
units.english: "That is indeed a danger. Syndicate Quicksilvers are notoriously agile, and if they swarm us, their Proton Guns will push you around and prevent regular hyperdrives from jumping."
units.italian: "È davvero un pericolo. I Quicksilver del Sindacato sono notoriamente agili, e se ci si avventano addosso, i loro cannoni protonici ti spingeranno qua e là e impediranno agli iperpropulsori normali di saltare."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|	"Is there any way to outspeed their Quicksilvers?"|167|0
units.english: "Is there any way to outspeed their Quicksilvers?"
units.italian: "C'è un modo per essere più veloci dei loro Quicksilver?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|	"Do we have to destroy every Quicksilver we encounter, then?"|168|0
units.english: "Do we have to destroy every Quicksilver we encounter, then?"
units.italian: "Dobbiamo davvero distruggere ogni Quicksilver che incontriamo?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|	"In a larger warship? That would be unlikely," Raven replies, "but there's another method of escaping them that's much easier."|170|0
units.english: "In a larger warship? That would be unlikely," Raven replies, "but there's another method of escaping them that's much easier."
units.italian: "Su una nave da guerra più grande? Sarebbe improbabile," risponde Raven, "ma c'è un altro metodo per sfuggirgli, molto più semplice."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|	"Not necessarily. Just because a regular hyperdrive wouldn't be able to jump doesn't mean there's no way to escape a Quicksilver."|173|0
units.english: "Not necessarily. Just because a regular hyperdrive wouldn't be able to jump doesn't mean there's no way to escape a Quicksilver."
units.italian: "Non necessariamente. Solo perché un iperpropulsore normale non riuscirebbe a saltare non significa che non ci sia modo di sfuggire a un Quicksilver."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|	You ask, "What do you mean?"|175|0
units.english: You ask, "What do you mean?"
units.italian: Chiedi: "Che cosa vuoi dire?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|	Raven says, "I suggest you swap your hyperdrive for a scram drive. Unlike a hyperdrive, you don't need to be perfectly still when using a scram drive, letting you jump even if you're getting shoved by weapons fire."|176|0
units.english: Raven says, "I suggest you swap your hyperdrive for a scram drive. Unlike a hyperdrive, you don't need to be perfectly still when using a scram drive, letting you jump even if you're getting shoved by weapons fire."
units.italian: Raven dice: "Ti suggerisco di sostituire il tuo iperpropulsore con un motore scram. A differenza di un iperpropulsore, con un motore scram non devi essere perfettamente fermo, così puoi saltare anche se vieni spinto dai colpi delle armi."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|	"Thanks for the advice."|179|0
units.english: "Thanks for the advice."
units.italian: "Grazie del consiglio."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|	"Wait, how did you know that I don't have a scram drive?"|180|0
units.english: "Wait, how did you know that I don't have a scram drive?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, come facevi a sapere che non ho un motore scram?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|	"Don't thank me," says Raven. "I'm just looking out for myself. After all, if you get blown up, they're probably going to try and kill me next." She winks before heading towards her Gunboat.|182|0
units.english: "Don't thank me," says Raven. "I'm just looking out for myself. After all, if you get blown up, they're probably going to try and kill me next." She winks before heading towards her Gunboat.
units.italian: "Non ringraziarmi," dice Raven. "Sto solo badando a me stessa. Dopotutto, se ti fanno saltare in aria, probabilmente proveranno a uccidere me dopo." Ti fa l'occhiolino e si avvia verso la sua cannoniera.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|	Raven puts a finger to her mouth and winks as she turns towards her own Gunboat.|185|0
units.english: Raven puts a finger to her mouth and winks as she turns towards her own Gunboat.
units.italian: Raven si mette un dito sulla bocca e fa l'occhiolino voltandosi verso la sua cannoniera.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|	You guide Ijs and the others back to your ship and prepare to set course for <planet>.|188|0
units.english: You guide Ijs and the others back to your ship and prepare to set course for <planet>.
units.italian: Riporti Ijs e gli altri alla tua nave e ti prepari a fare rotta per <planet>.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1B|dialog|197|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you've either left Raven's ship behind, or failed to destroy some of the Syndicate ships watching you.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma o hai lasciato indietro la nave di Raven, o non sei riuscito a distruggere alcune delle navi del Sindacato che ti osservavano.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1C|name|213|0
units.english: Bring evidence to <planet>
units.italian: Porta le prove su <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1C|description|214|0
units.english: Travel to <planet>, without you or Raven being killed by the Syndicate, to present your evidence and Sawyer's confession to Parliament.
units.italian: Recati su <planet>, senza che tu o Raven venga ucciso dal Sindacato, per presentare le tue prove e la confessione di Sawyer al Parlamento.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1C|log|226|0
units.english: Collected atmospheric samples from Mutiny, a planet deep in Syndicate space, and verified that a nuclear test has been performed here using isotopes that match those from the attacks on Geminus and Martini. Also found carefully hidden signs of an underground test site.
units.italian: Hai raccolto campioni atmosferici da Mutiny, un pianeta nel cuore dello spazio del Sindacato, e hai verificato che lì è stato eseguito un test nucleare con isotopi che corrispondono a quelli degli attentati a Geminus e Martini. Hai anche trovato segni accuratamente nascosti di un sito di test sotterraneo.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1C|You skim low over the surface of <origin>, with the airlock slightly open to allow Ijs to collect atmospheric samples. He's dressed in a pressure suit, and over the suit's radio he says, "Any residue that's here will be very faint. Just a few more minutes."|228|0
units.english: You skim low over the surface of <origin>, with the airlock slightly open to allow Ijs to collect atmospheric samples. He's dressed in a pressure suit, and over the suit's radio he says, "Any residue that's here will be very faint. Just a few more minutes."
units.italian: Sorvoli radente la superficie di <origin>, con il portello leggermente aperto perché Ijs possa raccogliere campioni atmosferici. È vestito con una tuta pressurizzata, e via radio dice: "Qualsiasi residuo ci sia qui sarà molto debole. Ancora qualche minuto."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1C|	Sawyer directs you to the site where the secret development took place. Nothing is left but a wide and slightly overgrown clearing. After checking your radar and seeing no incoming ships, you risk landing. Sawyer says that there were buildings here a few years ago, but now not even their foundations remain, and a sensor sweep for metallic objects turns up nothing, not even as small as a single nail.|229|0
units.english: Sawyer directs you to the site where the secret development took place. Nothing is left but a wide and slightly overgrown clearing. After checking your radar and seeing no incoming ships, you risk landing. Sawyer says that there were buildings here a few years ago, but now not even their foundations remain, and a sensor sweep for metallic objects turns up nothing, not even as small as a single nail.
units.italian: Sawyer ti indica il sito dove è avvenuto lo sviluppo segreto. Non resta altro che una radura ampia e un po' inselvatichita. Dopo aver controllato il radar e visto che non arrivano navi, rischi di atterrare. Sawyer dice che qui c'erano degli edifici qualche anno fa, ma ora non restano nemmeno le fondamenta, e una scansione dei sensori alla ricerca di oggetti metallici non trova nulla, nemmeno un chiodo.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1C|	However, Ijs points out a few subtle signs of human habitation. "A clearing like this would normally form in a fire," he says, "but notice, no fire scars on the trees on the edges of the clearing."|230|0
units.english: However, Ijs points out a few subtle signs of human habitation. "A clearing like this would normally form in a fire," he says, "but notice, no fire scars on the trees on the edges of the clearing."
units.italian: Però Ijs nota alcuni segni sottili di presenza umana. "Una radura come questa normalmente si formerebbe con un incendio," dice, "ma guarda: nessuna cicatrice di fuoco sugli alberi ai margini della radura."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1C|	Raven says, "And our geophysical radar is picking up structures underground. Several deep shafts, and rock that's been stressed and fractured by a large explosion. They did a good job of hiding everything else, but if you scar a planet that badly, it doesn't go away. The stones speak."|231|0
units.english: Raven says, "And our geophysical radar is picking up structures underground. Several deep shafts, and rock that's been stressed and fractured by a large explosion. They did a good job of hiding everything else, but if you scar a planet that badly, it doesn't go away. The stones speak."
units.italian: Raven dice: "E il nostro radar geofisico sta rilevando strutture sotterranee. Diversi pozzi profondi, e roccia che è stata sollecitata e fratturata da una grande esplosione. Hanno nascosto bene tutto il resto, ma se ferisci così tanto un pianeta, la ferita non sparisce. Le pietre parlano."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1C|	As you continue inspecting the site, suddenly Raven's copilot shouts out the door of her Gunboat at you. "Syndicate ships have entered the system! We need to get back to Earth with the evidence, quickly!"|232|0
units.english: As you continue inspecting the site, suddenly Raven's copilot shouts out the door of her Gunboat at you. "Syndicate ships have entered the system! We need to get back to Earth with the evidence, quickly!"
units.italian: Mentre continuate a ispezionare il sito, all'improvviso il copilota di Raven vi grida dalla porta della sua cannoniera. "Navi del Sindacato sono entrate nel sistema! Dobbiamo tornare sulla Terra con le prove, e in fretta!"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 1C|dialog|241|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left Raven's ship behind! Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro la nave di Raven! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2|name|268|0
units.english: Visit to the Deep
units.italian: Visita al Deep

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2|description|269|0
units.english: One of the representatives from the Deep gave you a note requesting that you visit them on <destination>. Travel there with Katya, Ijs, Sawyer, and Raven.
units.italian: Uno dei rappresentanti del Deep ti ha dato un biglietto in cui chiede di andare a trovarli su <destination>. Va' lì con Katya, Ijs, Sawyer e Raven.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2|dialog|286|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left Raven's ship behind! Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro la nave di Raven! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2|log|290|0
units.english: Parliament still refuses to believe that the Syndicate could have been behind the attacks; the Syndicate has far too much power and influence in the government of the Republic. But, the people of the Deep might be more open to the defector's story.
units.italian: Il Parlamento continua a rifiutarsi di credere che il Sindacato possa essere dietro gli attentati; il Sindacato ha fin troppo potere e influenza nel governo della Repubblica. Ma la gente del Deep potrebbe essere più aperta alla storia del disertore.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2|As you came fleeing out of Syndicate space with their ships in hot pursuit, you couldn't help noticing that no Republic ships moved to help you or attack your pursuers. Apparently, they are not ready to strike the Syndicate until Parliament has made a decision. As you are waiting for Parliament to hear your evidence, Katya asks you quietly, "So, how are you feeling about our chances here?"|293|0
units.english: As you came fleeing out of Syndicate space with their ships in hot pursuit, you couldn't help noticing that no Republic ships moved to help you or attack your pursuers. Apparently, they are not ready to strike the Syndicate until Parliament has made a decision. As you are waiting for Parliament to hear your evidence, Katya asks you quietly, "So, how are you feeling about our chances here?"
units.italian: Mentre fuggivate dallo spazio del Sindacato con le loro navi alle calcagna, non hai potuto fare a meno di notare che nessuna nave della Repubblica si è mossa per aiutarvi o per attaccare i vostri inseguitori. A quanto pare non sono pronti a colpire il Sindacato finché il Parlamento non avrà deciso. Mentre aspetti che il Parlamento ascolti le tue prove, Katya ti chiede sottovoce: "Allora, come ti senti sulle nostre possibilità qui?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2|	"I think our evidence is undeniable. There's no way we could fail to convince them."|295|0
units.english: "I think our evidence is undeniable. There's no way we could fail to convince them."
units.italian: "Penso che le nostre prove siano innegabili. Non c'è modo che non riusciamo a convincerli."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2|	"I'm worried about how much power the Syndicate has in Parliament. What if they refuse to believe us?"|297|0
units.english: "I'm worried about how much power the Syndicate has in Parliament. What if they refuse to believe us?"
units.italian: "Mi preoccupa quanto potere abbia il Sindacato in Parlamento. E se si rifiutassero di crederci?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2|	You continue to feel optimistic as Sawyer presents his story and his evidence, corroborated by the additional data collected by Ijs and by Raven's team. But as the members of Parliament begin questioning Sawyer, nearly all their questions sound more like an attack on him than an attempt to learn more about the Syndicate's involvement in the terrorist attacks.|301|0
units.english: You continue to feel optimistic as Sawyer presents his story and his evidence, corroborated by the additional data collected by Ijs and by Raven's team. But as the members of Parliament begin questioning Sawyer, nearly all their questions sound more like an attack on him than an attempt to learn more about the Syndicate's involvement in the terrorist attacks.
units.italian: Continui a sentirti ottimista mentre Sawyer presenta la sua storia e le sue prove, corroborate dai dati aggiuntivi raccolti da Ijs e dalla squadra di Raven. Ma quando i membri del Parlamento cominciano a interrogare Sawyer, quasi tutte le loro domande suonano più come un attacco a lui che come un tentativo di saperne di più sul coinvolgimento del Sindacato negli attentati terroristici.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2|	Your pessimism turns out to be justified. The hearing begins well enough, with Sawyer's testimony and the additional evidence collected by Ijs and by Raven's team. But when the floor is opened for questions, nearly every question the members of Parliament ask seems intended not to get to the bottom of the terrorist plot, but to attack or discredit Sawyer.|305|0
units.english: Your pessimism turns out to be justified. The hearing begins well enough, with Sawyer's testimony and the additional evidence collected by Ijs and by Raven's team. But when the floor is opened for questions, nearly every question the members of Parliament ask seems intended not to get to the bottom of the terrorist plot, but to attack or discredit Sawyer.
units.italian: Il tuo pessimismo si rivela giustificato. L'udienza comincia abbastanza bene, con la testimonianza di Sawyer e le prove aggiuntive raccolte da Ijs e dalla squadra di Raven. Ma quando si apre la discussione, quasi ogni domanda che i membri del Parlamento fanno sembra pensata non per arrivare in fondo alla trama terroristica, ma per attaccare o screditare Sawyer.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2|	You can't help but realize how many people here represent Syndicate worlds. One of them, an older man, asks, "What possible reason would the Syndicate have to launch such an attack?"|309|0
units.english: You can't help but realize how many people here represent Syndicate worlds. One of them, an older man, asks, "What possible reason would the Syndicate have to launch such an attack?"
units.italian: Non puoi fare a meno di notare quante persone qui rappresentino mondi del Sindacato. Uno di loro, un uomo anziano, chiede: "Quale ragione possibile avrebbe il Sindacato di lanciare un attacco del genere?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2|	Sawyer says, "They have complex mathematical models of the galactic economy, and those models predicted a coming recession, the worst in centuries. This war forestalled that recession. From the perspective of someone who values economic growth above all else, war was a better alternative than recession."|310|0
units.english: Sawyer says, "They have complex mathematical models of the galactic economy, and those models predicted a coming recession, the worst in centuries. This war forestalled that recession. From the perspective of someone who values economic growth above all else, war was a better alternative than recession."
units.italian: Sawyer dice: "Hanno modelli matematici complessi dell'economia galattica, e quei modelli prevedevano una recessione in arrivo, la peggiore da secoli. Questa guerra ha sventato quella recessione. Dal punto di vista di chi mette la crescita economica sopra ogni altra cosa, la guerra era un'alternativa migliore della recessione."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2|	"That's utter nonsense," says the man. "That's the sort of absurd conspiracy theory that someone with no understanding of business would invent."|311|0
units.english: "That's utter nonsense," says the man. "That's the sort of absurd conspiracy theory that someone with no understanding of business would invent."
units.italian: "È una follia totale," dice l'uomo. "È il tipo di teoria del complotto assurda che inventerebbe qualcuno che non capisce niente di affari."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2|	The rest of the hearing is little better, but as you are leaving one of the representatives from the Deep shakes your hand, and you feel a piece of paper being pressed into your palm. You pocket it quietly and open it once you have returned to your ship. It says, "Visit us on Valhalla."|312|0
units.english: The rest of the hearing is little better, but as you are leaving one of the representatives from the Deep shakes your hand, and you feel a piece of paper being pressed into your palm. You pocket it quietly and open it once you have returned to your ship. It says, "Visit us on Valhalla."
units.italian: Il resto dell'udienza non va molto meglio, ma mentre te ne stai andando uno dei rappresentanti del Deep ti stringe la mano, e senti che ti viene premuto un pezzo di carta nel palmo. Te lo infili in tasca senza dire niente e lo apri quando sei tornato alla tua nave. Dice: "Venite a trovarci su Valhalla."

units.id: mission:FW Navy Out Of Rastaban|You receive a brief message from Alondo: "Good news, Captain! As a gesture of good faith the Navy is beginning to pull out of Rastaban and Delta Sagittarii. Those worlds will revert to our control soon. Be sure to tell the others. And, tell Katya I'm very glad she's free and am looking forward to seeing her." You pass on his message to Katya and Ijs.|327|0
units.english: You receive a brief message from Alondo: "Good news, Captain! As a gesture of good faith the Navy is beginning to pull out of Rastaban and Delta Sagittarii. Those worlds will revert to our control soon. Be sure to tell the others. And, tell Katya I'm very glad she's free and am looking forward to seeing her." You pass on his message to Katya and Ijs.
units.italian: Ricevi un breve messaggio da Alondo: "Buone notizie, Capitano! Come gesto di buona fede la Marina sta cominciando a ritirarsi da Rastaban e Delta Sagittarii. Quei mondi torneranno presto sotto il nostro controllo. Assicurati di dirlo agli altri. E dì a Katya che sono molto contento che sia libera e che non vedo l'ora di vederla." Trasmetti il suo messaggio a Katya e Ijs.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2A|name|347|0
units.english: Oathkeepers on Farpoint
units.italian: Gli Oathkeepers su Farpoint

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2A|description|348|0
units.english: Travel to <destination> to meet with the Navy Oathkeepers. Raven's ship will continue to travel with you.
units.italian: Recati su <destination> per incontrare gli Oathkeepers della Marina. La nave di Raven continuerà a viaggiare con te.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2A|log|361|0
units.english: The governor of Valhalla, in the Deep, has proposed a "police action" to arrest one or more of the Syndicate leaders and bring them to justice. It will be a secret joint operation between the Free Worlds, the Deep, and the Oathkeepers.
units.italian: Il governatore di Valhalla, nel Deep, ha proposto un'"azione di polizia" per arrestare uno o più dei capi del Sindacato e portarli davanti alla giustizia. Sarà un'operazione congiunta segreta fra le Free Worlds, il Deep e gli Oathkeepers.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2A|When you land on Valhalla, a man shows up at your ship and introduces himself as Edrick Flint, the governor of Valhalla. He invites all of you to join him for dinner at his home, which turns out to be an apartment on the twenty-third floor of one of the downtown skyscrapers. There, he introduces you to several other regional governors and authorities.|363|0
units.english: When you land on Valhalla, a man shows up at your ship and introduces himself as Edrick Flint, the governor of Valhalla. He invites all of you to join him for dinner at his home, which turns out to be an apartment on the twenty-third floor of one of the downtown skyscrapers. There, he introduces you to several other regional governors and authorities.
units.italian: Quando atterri su Valhalla, un uomo si presenta alla tua nave e si presenta come Edrick Flint, il governatore di Valhalla. Invita tutti voi a cenare a casa sua, che si rivela essere un appartamento al ventitreesimo piano di uno dei grattacieli del centro. Lì vi presenta a diversi altri governatori e autorità regionali.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2A|	"You may be aware," Edrick says, "that the Deep was self-governing before the formation of the Republic. Indeed, during some of the darkest centuries of the space age, the Deep stood out as a beacon of civilization, a place where piracy was not tolerated and all travelers were safe. When we joined the Republic, we retained the authority to police our own territory, and that authority includes the right to track down fugitives who have fled beyond our usual jurisdiction."|364|0
units.english: "You may be aware," Edrick says, "that the Deep was self-governing before the formation of the Republic. Indeed, during some of the darkest centuries of the space age, the Deep stood out as a beacon of civilization, a place where piracy was not tolerated and all travelers were safe. When we joined the Republic, we retained the authority to police our own territory, and that authority includes the right to track down fugitives who have fled beyond our usual jurisdiction."
units.italian: "Forse saprete," dice Edrick, "che il Deep si autogovernava prima della formazione della Repubblica. Anzi, durante alcuni dei secoli più bui dell'era spaziale, il Deep si distinse come un faro di civiltà, un luogo dove la pirateria non era tollerata e tutti i viaggiatori erano al sicuro. Quando ci unimmo alla Repubblica, mantenemmo l'autorità di vigilare sul nostro territorio, e quell'autorità include il diritto di rintracciare i fuggitivi che si sono allontanati dalla nostra giurisdizione abituale."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2A|	"You're suggesting a 'police action' against the Syndicate?"|366|0
units.english: "You're suggesting a 'police action' against the Syndicate?"
units.italian: "Stai proponendo un'azione di polizia contro il Sindacato?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2A|	"Wait, before we talk details, are you saying that you believe Sawyer's testimony against the Syndicate?"|368|0
units.english: "Wait, before we talk details, are you saying that you believe Sawyer's testimony against the Syndicate?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, prima di parlare dei dettagli, stai dicendo che credi alla testimonianza di Sawyer contro il Sindacato?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2A|	"Everyone believes him," says one of the other governors, "throughout human space, and in Parliament too. We can all see that the evidence is undeniable. What people don't agree on is how to respond to that evidence."|369|0
units.english: "Everyone believes him," says one of the other governors, "throughout human space, and in Parliament too. We can all see that the evidence is undeniable. What people don't agree on is how to respond to that evidence."
units.italian: "Ci credono tutti," dice uno degli altri governatori, "in tutto lo spazio umano, e anche in Parlamento. Vediamo tutti che le prove sono innegabili. Quello su cui la gente non è d'accordo è come rispondere a quelle prove."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2A|	"We want to see justice done," says Edrick. "Our proposal is that a fleet under our jurisdiction, but joined by Free Worlds and Oathkeeper vessels, will travel into the Core and arrest at least one of the Syndicate masterminds behind the terrorist attacks. Such an action would satisfy the technical requirements of legality provided that immediately prior to the arrest, one of our courts hears Sawyer's testimony and pronounces that Syndicate individual guilty."|371|0
units.english: "We want to see justice done," says Edrick. "Our proposal is that a fleet under our jurisdiction, but joined by Free Worlds and Oathkeeper vessels, will travel into the Core and arrest at least one of the Syndicate masterminds behind the terrorist attacks. Such an action would satisfy the technical requirements of legality provided that immediately prior to the arrest, one of our courts hears Sawyer's testimony and pronounces that Syndicate individual guilty."
units.italian: "Vogliamo che sia fatta giustizia," dice Edrick. "La nostra proposta è che una flotta sotto la nostra giurisdizione, ma affiancata da navi delle Free Worlds e degli Oathkeepers, entri nel Nucleo e arresti almeno uno dei mandanti del Sindacato dietro gli attentati terroristici. Un'azione del genere soddisferebbe i requisiti tecnici di legalità, purché immediatamente prima dell'arresto uno dei nostri tribunali ascolti la testimonianza di Sawyer e dichiari colpevole quel singolo individuo del Sindacato."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2A|	"'Technically legal' sounds to me like a euphemism for 'something we know full well is going to get us into trouble.'"|373|0
units.english: "'Technically legal' sounds to me like a euphemism for 'something we know full well is going to get us into trouble.'"
units.italian: "'Tecnicamente legale' mi suona come un eufemismo per 'qualcosa che sappiamo benissimo che ci metterà nei guai'."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2A|	"How exactly is a fleet of warships going to travel through Syndicate space without a massive battle?"|374|0
units.english: "How exactly is a fleet of warships going to travel through Syndicate space without a massive battle?"
units.italian: "Come farà esattamente una flotta di navi da guerra ad attraversare lo spazio del Sindacato senza una battaglia enorme?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2A|	Ijs laughs at that. "Relax, Captain. I've been doing 'technically legal' stuff for years. It only occasionally goes disastrously wrong. But governor, if the Syndicate sees you coming, you'll need a full-scale war fleet, not just a handful of ships."|377|0
units.english: Ijs laughs at that. "Relax, Captain. I've been doing 'technically legal' stuff for years. It only occasionally goes disastrously wrong. But governor, if the Syndicate sees you coming, you'll need a full-scale war fleet, not just a handful of ships."
units.italian: Ijs ride a quella domanda. "Rilassati, Capitano. Faccio cose 'tecnicamente legali' da anni. Solo occasionalmente finiscono in un disastro. Ma governatore, se il Sindacato vi vede arrivare, vi servirà una flotta da guerra su scala completa, non solo una manciata di navi."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2A|	"That's why the fleet will be composed of ships from three different organizations," says Edrick. "You will find a reason to travel to Earth with perhaps one of your fancy new Dreadnoughts as an escort. When you arrive, there will just happen to be an Oathkeeper patrol passing through the same system. And a merchant convoy from the Deep. With its own set of escorts, of course."|379|0
units.english: "That's why the fleet will be composed of ships from three different organizations," says Edrick. "You will find a reason to travel to Earth with perhaps one of your fancy new Dreadnoughts as an escort. When you arrive, there will just happen to be an Oathkeeper patrol passing through the same system. And a merchant convoy from the Deep. With its own set of escorts, of course."
units.italian: "È per questo che la flotta sarà composta da navi di tre organizzazioni diverse," dice Edrick. "Troverai un motivo per andare sulla Terra con, diciamo, uno dei vostri nuovi e sofisticati Dreadnought come scorta. Quando arrivi, ci sarà per caso una pattuglia di Oathkeepers di passaggio nello stesso sistema. E un convoglio mercantile dal Deep. Con la sua scorta, naturalmente."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2A|	"We'd need to know exactly where and on what planet our target lives, prior to entering Syndicate space," says Katya. "And, if you want to have a court trial immediately prior to the arrest, it sounds like Sawyer will need to stay here."|380|0
units.english: "We'd need to know exactly where and on what planet our target lives, prior to entering Syndicate space," says Katya. "And, if you want to have a court trial immediately prior to the arrest, it sounds like Sawyer will need to stay here."
units.italian: "Dovremmo sapere esattamente dove e su quale pianeta vive il nostro bersaglio, prima di entrare nello spazio del Sindacato," dice Katya. "E se volete un processo davanti a un tribunale immediatamente prima dell'arresto, sembra che Sawyer debba restare qui."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2A|	"Indeed," says Edrick, "but I assure you, he is safer from the Syndicate here than anywhere else in human space, your own territory included. As for locating a target, that's why the Oathkeepers have requested that you visit them on Farpoint."|381|0
units.english: "Indeed," says Edrick, "but I assure you, he is safer from the Syndicate here than anywhere else in human space, your own territory included. As for locating a target, that's why the Oathkeepers have requested that you visit them on Farpoint."
units.italian: "Esatto," dice Edrick, "ma ti assicuro che qui è al sicuro dal Sindacato più che in qualsiasi altro posto dello spazio umano, compreso il vostro territorio. Quanto a localizzare un bersaglio, è per questo che gli Oathkeepers hanno chiesto che andiate a trovarli su Farpoint."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2A|	The rest of the evening is a more casual time for conversation, with plenty of good food and wine.|384|0
units.english: The rest of the evening is a more casual time for conversation, with plenty of good food and wine.
units.italian: Il resto della serata è un momento più informale per conversare, con abbondanza di buon cibo e vino.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2A|	The rest of the evening is a more casual time for conversation, with plenty of good food and wine. Alondo sends you a message to inform you that Tarazed has decided to officially join the Free Worlds after having received word of the Parliament hearing, news that brings joy to Katya and Ijs.|388|0
units.english: The rest of the evening is a more casual time for conversation, with plenty of good food and wine. Alondo sends you a message to inform you that Tarazed has decided to officially join the Free Worlds after having received word of the Parliament hearing, news that brings joy to Katya and Ijs.
units.italian: Il resto della serata è un momento più informale per conversare, con abbondanza di buon cibo e vino. Alondo ti manda un messaggio per informarti che Tarazed ha deciso di unirsi ufficialmente alle Free Worlds dopo aver saputo dell'udienza in Parlamento, notizia che riempie di gioia Katya e Ijs.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2A|	At one point, Edrick pulls you aside and says, "I've requested that you be granted access to some of the new technology that was developed here during the course of the war. In particular, feel free to visit the outfitter here and install a ramscoop; you will need one for your next mission. And also, take this." He hands you a data card. "It's a copy of Sawyer's evidence, in case something happens here. Keep it very, very safe."|390|0
units.english: At one point, Edrick pulls you aside and says, "I've requested that you be granted access to some of the new technology that was developed here during the course of the war. In particular, feel free to visit the outfitter here and install a ramscoop; you will need one for your next mission. And also, take this." He hands you a data card. "It's a copy of Sawyer's evidence, in case something happens here. Keep it very, very safe."
units.italian: A un certo punto Edrick ti tira da parte e dice: "Ho chiesto che ti sia concesso l'accesso ad alcune delle nuove tecnologie sviluppate qui nel corso della guerra. In particolare, sentiti libero di passare dal banco degli equipaggiamenti e installare un ramscoop; ti servirà per la tua prossima missione. E prendi anche questo." Ti porge una scheda dati. "È una copia delle prove di Sawyer, nel caso succeda qualcosa qui. Tienila al sicuro, molto al sicuro."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2A|dialog|399|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left Raven's ship behind! Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro la nave di Raven! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2B|name|404|0
units.english: Travel to Stormhold
units.italian: Va' su Stormhold

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2B|description|405|0
units.english: Sawyer has named several Syndicate executives who were definitely part of the plot. Travel to the lawless world of Stormhold, where you will be able to purchase information about where those executives live.
units.italian: Sawyer ha fatto i nomi di diversi dirigenti del Sindacato che facevano sicuramente parte del complotto. Va' sul mondo senza legge di Stormhold, dove potrai comprare informazioni su dove abitano quei dirigenti.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2B|On Farpoint, you are met by none other than the famous leader of the Oathkeepers, Admiral William Danforth. Even among the Free Worlds Danforth is spoken of with respect due to his courage and levelheadedness in battle and his leadership of countless humanitarian missions.|421|0
units.english: On Farpoint, you are met by none other than the famous leader of the Oathkeepers, Admiral William Danforth. Even among the Free Worlds Danforth is spoken of with respect due to his courage and levelheadedness in battle and his leadership of countless humanitarian missions.
units.italian: Su Farpoint ti accoglie nientemeno che il famoso capo degli Oathkeepers, l'ammiraglio William Danforth. Anche fra le Free Worlds si parla di Danforth con rispetto, per il suo coraggio e la sua lucidità in battaglia e per aver guidato innumerevoli missioni umanitarie.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2B|On Farpoint, you are met by Admiral Danforth, the leader of the Oathkeepers who previously assisted you to drive the Alphas and their mercenary fleet away from Poisonwood. He is glad to see you again, and you express your sympathy over the loss of Commander Nguyen; Danforth tells you that his killer was never found.|424|0
units.english: On Farpoint, you are met by Admiral Danforth, the leader of the Oathkeepers who previously assisted you to drive the Alphas and their mercenary fleet away from Poisonwood. He is glad to see you again, and you express your sympathy over the loss of Commander Nguyen; Danforth tells you that his killer was never found.
units.italian: Su Farpoint ti accoglie l'ammiraglio Danforth, il capo degli Oathkeepers che in precedenza ti aveva aiutato a scacciare gli Alphas e la loro flotta mercenaria da Poisonwood. È contento di rivederti, e tu gli esprimi il tuo cordoglio per la perdita del comandante Nguyen; Danforth ti dice che il suo assassino non è mai stato trovato.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2B|	Ijs and Katya introduce themselves to Danforth, and Katya says, "Sir, I was a child on Hope when the colony was evacuated. Your ship carried my family to safety, and I've never forgotten how every night during our journey, you would walk through the cargo bay where we were staying and check to make sure all our needs were met. I've never had a chance before now to thank you in person."|426|0
units.english: Ijs and Katya introduce themselves to Danforth, and Katya says, "Sir, I was a child on Hope when the colony was evacuated. Your ship carried my family to safety, and I've never forgotten how every night during our journey, you would walk through the cargo bay where we were staying and check to make sure all our needs were met. I've never had a chance before now to thank you in person."
units.italian: Ijs e Katya si presentano a Danforth, e Katya dice: "Signore, ero una bambina su Hope quando la colonia è stata evacuata. La sua nave ha portato la mia famiglia in salvo, e non ho mai dimenticato che ogni notte, durante il viaggio, lei passava nella stiva dove alloggiavamo per controllare che avessimo tutto il necessario. Non ho mai avuto occasione, prima d'ora, di ringraziarla di persona."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2B|	Danforth is surprised. "Councilor Reynolds," he says, "thank you. I followed your career in Parliament with some interest, but it is a shame that we never met in person until now. But I am glad we have this chance to work together at last."|427|0
units.english: Danforth is surprised. "Councilor Reynolds," he says, "thank you. I followed your career in Parliament with some interest, but it is a shame that we never met in person until now. But I am glad we have this chance to work together at last."
units.italian: Danforth è sorpreso. "Consigliera Reynolds," dice, "grazie. Ho seguito la sua carriera in Parlamento con un certo interesse, ma è un peccato che non ci siamo mai incontrati di persona fino a ora. Sono però contento che abbiamo finalmente questa occasione di lavorare insieme."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2B|	Raven says, "Governor Edrick mentioned a plan for tracking down the Syndicate executives who were behind the attacks in the Castor and Pollux systems."|428|0
units.english: Raven says, "Governor Edrick mentioned a plan for tracking down the Syndicate executives who were behind the attacks in the Castor and Pollux systems."
units.italian: Raven dice: "Il governatore Edrick ha accennato a un piano per rintracciare i dirigenti del Sindacato che erano dietro gli attacchi nei sistemi Castor e Pollux."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2B|	"Indeed," says Danforth. "Southeast of here is a region of uninhabited star systems, a sort of back entrance into Syndicate space. Few ships travel through there, because there is nowhere to refuel, but with a ramscoop or enough fuel capacity, travel is possible. One of the first inhabited worlds on the other side is the lawless world of Stormhold. There, you can surely find a contact who knows enough about the inner workings of the Syndicate to tell you the home of at least a few of our targets... for a price." He hands Katya a large stack of credit chips.|429|0
units.english: "Indeed," says Danforth. "Southeast of here is a region of uninhabited star systems, a sort of back entrance into Syndicate space. Few ships travel through there, because there is nowhere to refuel, but with a ramscoop or enough fuel capacity, travel is possible. One of the first inhabited worlds on the other side is the lawless world of Stormhold. There, you can surely find a contact who knows enough about the inner workings of the Syndicate to tell you the home of at least a few of our targets... for a price." He hands Katya a large stack of credit chips.
units.italian: "Esatto," dice Danforth. "A sud-est da qui c'è una regione di sistemi stellari disabitati, una specie di porta di servizio nello spazio del Sindacato. Poche navi la attraversano, perché non c'è dove fare rifornimento, ma con un ramscoop o abbastanza capacità di carburante il viaggio è possibile. Uno dei primi mondi abitati dall'altra parte è il mondo senza legge di Stormhold. Lì troverai di sicuro un contatto che sa abbastanza dei meccanismi interni del Sindacato da dirti dove abitano almeno alcuni dei nostri bersagli... a un prezzo." Porge a Katya un bel mucchio di schede di credito.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2B|	Raven says, "I'm going to stay here with the Oathkeepers. Captain <last>, it's been a pleasure working with you. We're counting on you to fetch us this information and return here as quickly as possible."|430|0
units.english: Raven says, "I'm going to stay here with the Oathkeepers. Captain <last>, it's been a pleasure working with you. We're counting on you to fetch us this information and return here as quickly as possible."
units.italian: Raven dice: "Io resto qui con gli Oathkeepers. Capitano <last>, è stato un piacere lavorare con te. Contiamo su di te perché ci procuri queste informazioni e torni qui il prima possibile."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2B|dialog|433|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Katya and Mr. Eyes hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Katya e Mr. Eyes non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2C|name|438|0
units.english: Return to Farpoint
units.italian: Torna su Farpoint

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2C|description|439|0
units.english: Return to <planet> with information about the whereabouts of certain Syndicate executives. Travel via the back route so that the Syndicate is not alerted to your presence.
units.italian: Torna su <planet> con le informazioni su dove si trovano alcuni dirigenti del Sindacato. Viaggia per la via secondaria, così che il Sindacato non venga avvisato della tua presenza.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2C|log|452|0
units.english: Visited a village on a lawless world in northern Syndicate space, and purchased information on the whereabouts of several of the Syndicate executives who were implicated in the terrorist attacks.
units.italian: Hai visitato un villaggio su un mondo senza legge nello spazio settentrionale del Sindacato, e hai comprato informazioni su dove si trovano diversi dirigenti del Sindacato implicati negli attentati terroristici.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2C|You land near one of the small villages on Stormhold, and after handing out a few small bribes from the money Danforth gave you, finally one of the villagers recalls that a local gang of pirates is led by a former Syndicate manager. With some trepidation, you fly to his stronghold, and he agrees to "do business" with you.|454|0
units.english: You land near one of the small villages on Stormhold, and after handing out a few small bribes from the money Danforth gave you, finally one of the villagers recalls that a local gang of pirates is led by a former Syndicate manager. With some trepidation, you fly to his stronghold, and he agrees to "do business" with you.
units.italian: Atterri vicino a uno dei piccoli villaggi di Stormhold e, dopo aver distribuito qualche piccola bustarella con il denaro che ti ha dato Danforth, alla fine uno degli abitanti ricorda che una banda locale di pirati è guidata da un ex dirigente del Sindacato. Con una certa apprensione voli fino alla sua roccaforte, e lui accetta di "fare affari" con te.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2C|	Katya shows him Sawyer's list of names. "So, these are the bad boys, huh?" he says. Clearly the news of Sawyer's revelations has spread even to this remote world. He looks through the list, and is able to tell you where three of the five men live. "I'd love to see all these bastards taken down," he says.|455|0
units.english: Katya shows him Sawyer's list of names. "So, these are the bad boys, huh?" he says. Clearly the news of Sawyer's revelations has spread even to this remote world. He looks through the list, and is able to tell you where three of the five men live. "I'd love to see all these bastards taken down," he says.
units.italian: Katya gli mostra la lista di nomi di Sawyer. "Quindi questi sono i cattivi, eh?" dice. Chiaramente la notizia delle rivelazioni di Sawyer si è diffusa anche su questo mondo remoto. Scorre la lista ed è in grado di dirti dove abitano tre dei cinque uomini. "Mi piacerebbe vedere tutti quei bastardi sistemati," dice.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2C|	You give him the rest of Danforth's money and thank him for helping you - and ask that he keep your visit secret. "No problem," he says. As you are leaving, he adds, "Also, Mister Springborn... you're my hero, man. Glad you're still finding ways to pester the Syndicate." Ijs seems pleasantly surprised to be recognized.|456|0
units.english: You give him the rest of Danforth's money and thank him for helping you - and ask that he keep your visit secret. "No problem," he says. As you are leaving, he adds, "Also, Mister Springborn... you're my hero, man. Glad you're still finding ways to pester the Syndicate." Ijs seems pleasantly surprised to be recognized.
units.italian: Gli dai il resto del denaro di Danforth e lo ringrazi per l'aiuto, chiedendogli di mantenere segreta la tua visita. "Nessun problema," dice. Mentre ve ne andate, aggiunge: "E anche, signor Springborn... lei è il mio eroe. Sono contento che trovi ancora il modo di tormentare il Sindacato." Ijs sembra piacevolmente sorpreso di essere riconosciuto.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation 2C|dialog|459|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Katya and Mr. Eyes hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Katya e Mr. Eyes non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Defend Farpoint|name|465|0
units.english: Defend Farpoint
units.italian: Difendi Farpoint

units.id: mission:FW Defend Farpoint|description|466|0
units.english: Assist the Oathkeepers in defending <planet> from a pirate attack, then land back on the planet.
units.italian: Aiuta gli Oathkeepers a difendere <planet> da un attacco pirata, poi atterra di nuovo sul pianeta.

units.id: mission:FW Defend Farpoint|When you land back on Farpoint, Danforth eagerly meets you and asks what information you were able to obtain. You tell him. "So," he says, "one executive on Foundry, and one on Hephaestus. Both of those are core Syndicate planets, with billions of people on them. No way that would work. But this financial guy, Alexander Soylent... your contact says he lives on a giant yacht that sails around the ocean on Nimbus. Now, that's a much more inviting target. And from what Sawyer says, the Syndicate's financial arm were the ones who decided war would be beneficial in the first place."|478|0
units.english: When you land back on Farpoint, Danforth eagerly meets you and asks what information you were able to obtain. You tell him. "So," he says, "one executive on Foundry, and one on Hephaestus. Both of those are core Syndicate planets, with billions of people on them. No way that would work. But this financial guy, Alexander Soylent... your contact says he lives on a giant yacht that sails around the ocean on Nimbus. Now, that's a much more inviting target. And from what Sawyer says, the Syndicate's financial arm were the ones who decided war would be beneficial in the first place."
units.italian: Quando atterri di nuovo su Farpoint, Danforth ti viene incontro con impazienza e chiede quali informazioni sei riuscito a ottenere. Gliele riferisci. "Quindi," dice, "un dirigente su Foundry, e uno su Hephaestus. Entrambi pianeti centrali del Sindacato, con miliardi di persone sopra. Non funzionerebbe mai. Ma questo tipo delle finanze, Alexander Soylent... il tuo contatto dice che vive su uno yacht gigantesco che naviga per l'oceano su Nimbus. Questo, invece, è un bersaglio molto più invitante. E da quanto dice Sawyer, è stato proprio il braccio finanziario del Sindacato a decidere che la guerra sarebbe stata vantaggiosa."

units.id: mission:FW Defend Farpoint|	As you're talking, one of Danforth's officers runs into the room. "Sir," he says, "we're detecting a pirate fleet incoming."|479|0
units.english: As you're talking, one of Danforth's officers runs into the room. "Sir," he says, "we're detecting a pirate fleet incoming."
units.italian: Mentre state parlando, uno degli ufficiali di Danforth irrompe nella stanza. "Signore," dice, "rileviamo una flotta pirata in arrivo."

units.id: mission:FW Defend Farpoint|	Danforth swears. "This is my real job, of course," he explains, "defending the North from pirate invasion. This isn't the first attack we've had to repulse, and lately Parliament has been finding reasons to reassign my best ships elsewhere. Captain <last>, would you be willing to join the defense fleet? We'll finish this conversation once they've been driven off."|480|0
units.english: Danforth swears. "This is my real job, of course," he explains, "defending the North from pirate invasion. This isn't the first attack we've had to repulse, and lately Parliament has been finding reasons to reassign my best ships elsewhere. Captain <last>, would you be willing to join the defense fleet? We'll finish this conversation once they've been driven off."
units.italian: Danforth impreca. "Questo è il mio vero lavoro, naturalmente," spiega, "difendere il Nord dall'invasione dei pirati. Non è il primo attacco che dobbiamo respingere, e ultimamente il Parlamento trova sempre motivi per riassegnare altrove le mie navi migliori. Capitano <last>, saresti disposto a unirti alla flotta di difesa? Finiremo questa conversazione una volta respinti."

units.id: mission:FW Defend Farpoint|	You hurry to your ship and join the defenders...|481|0
units.english: You hurry to your ship and join the defenders...
units.italian: Ti precipiti alla tua nave e ti unisci ai difensori...

units.id: mission:FW Defend Farpoint|dialog|536|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but there are still Pirate ships circling overhead. You should take off and help finish them off.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ci sono ancora navi pirata che girano là sopra. Dovresti decollare e aiutare a finirle.

units.id: mission:FW Embassy 1|name|543|0
units.english: Ambassadors from Earth
units.italian: Ambasciatori dalla Terra

units.id: mission:FW Embassy 1|description|544|0
units.english: The Republic has agreed to set up an embassy to the Free Worlds. Travel to Earth to meet the ambassadors and escort them to Free space.
units.italian: La Repubblica ha accettato di istituire un'ambasciata presso le Free Worlds. Va' sulla Terra per incontrare gli ambasciatori e scortarli nello spazio delle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Embassy 1|As you are landing, Katya tells you, "<first>, we just received a message from the Free Worlds Senate. They've arranged for a Republic embassy to be set up on Bourne, and a Free Worlds embassy on Earth. We've been asked to meet the ambassadors on Earth and escort them to Bourne."|558|0
units.english: As you are landing, Katya tells you, "<first>, we just received a message from the Free Worlds Senate. They've arranged for a Republic embassy to be set up on Bourne, and a Free Worlds embassy on Earth. We've been asked to meet the ambassadors on Earth and escort them to Bourne."
units.italian: Mentre stai atterrando, Katya ti dice: "<first>, abbiamo appena ricevuto un messaggio dal Senato delle Free Worlds. Hanno organizzato l'istituzione di un'ambasciata della Repubblica su Bourne, e di un'ambasciata delle Free Worlds sulla Terra. Ci hanno chiesto di incontrare gli ambasciatori sulla Terra e di scortarli fino a Bourne."

units.id: mission:FW Embassy 1|	A few minutes later, Admiral Danforth arrives at your ship. "Captain <last>," he says, "I'd like to thank you for your assistance." He hands you a million-credit chip.|559|0
units.english: A few minutes later, Admiral Danforth arrives at your ship. "Captain <last>," he says, "I'd like to thank you for your assistance." He hands you a million-credit chip.
units.italian: Qualche minuto dopo, l'ammiraglio Danforth arriva alla tua nave. "Capitano <last>," dice, "vorrei ringraziarti per il tuo aiuto." Ti porge una scheda da un milione di crediti.

units.id: mission:FW Embassy 1|	"Thank you, sir."|561|0
units.english: "Thank you, sir."
units.italian: "Grazie, signore."

units.id: mission:FW Embassy 1|	"Wow, this is the biggest planetary defense bounty I've ever heard of."|563|0
units.english: "Wow, this is the biggest planetary defense bounty I've ever heard of."
units.italian: "Cavolo, questa è la taglia di difesa planetaria più alta di cui abbia mai sentito parlare."

units.id: mission:FW Embassy 1|	"That's purely for you as a private captain, to compensate you for your assistance," he says. "I wouldn't want you to think that I am in any way giving financial support to the Free Worlds, since that would be illegal."|564|0
units.english: "That's purely for you as a private captain, to compensate you for your assistance," he says. "I wouldn't want you to think that I am in any way giving financial support to the Free Worlds, since that would be illegal."
units.italian: "È esclusivamente per te come capitano privato, per compensarti del tuo aiuto," dice. "Non vorrei che pensassi che sto in qualche modo dando un sostegno finanziario alle Free Worlds, perché sarebbe illegale."

units.id: mission:FW Embassy 1|	"Of course not, sir," you say. "Thank you."|565|0
units.english: "Of course not, sir," you say. "Thank you."
units.italian: "Certamente no, signore," dici. "Grazie."

units.id: mission:FW Embassy 1|	"Don't mention it," he says, with a wink. "And now, I think it's best that you head to Earth and pick up those ambassadors. From what I hear, now that Raven is not traveling with you, people are beginning to ask questions about what this Free Worlds captain is doing flying all around Republic space unescorted."|567|0
units.english: "Don't mention it," he says, with a wink. "And now, I think it's best that you head to Earth and pick up those ambassadors. From what I hear, now that Raven is not traveling with you, people are beginning to ask questions about what this Free Worlds captain is doing flying all around Republic space unescorted."
units.italian: "Non c'è di che," dice, con un occhiolino. "E ora credo che sia meglio che tu vada sulla Terra a prendere quegli ambasciatori. Da quanto sento, ora che Raven non viaggia più con te, la gente comincia a chiedersi che cosa ci faccia questo capitano delle Free Worlds a volare per tutto lo spazio della Repubblica senza scorta."

units.id: mission:FW Embassy 1|dialog|570|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Katya and Mr. Eyes hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Katya e Mr. Eyes non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Embassy 1B|name|576|0
units.english: Ambassadors to Bourne
units.italian: Ambasciatori per Bourne

units.id: mission:FW Embassy 1B|description|577|0
units.english: Escort this luxury vessel carrying Republic ambassadors to the Free Worlds capital of <destination>.
units.italian: Scorta questa nave di lusso che trasporta gli ambasciatori della Repubblica fino alla capitale delle Free Worlds, <destination>.

units.id: mission:FW Embassy 1B|Unfortunately, the Republic ambassadors turn out to match all your worst stereotypes of Republic diplomats: dressed in gaudy, impractical clothing, and carrying an absurd amount of luggage. At first you are worried about whether you have enough space for them, but one of them explains that they would not dream of traveling in your dirty old ship; they will be traveling in style, in a Star Queen luxury liner, and your only duty is to ensure their safety. You have little choice but to acquiesce, even though you think they would be far safer on your own ship.|594|0
units.english: Unfortunately, the Republic ambassadors turn out to match all your worst stereotypes of Republic diplomats: dressed in gaudy, impractical clothing, and carrying an absurd amount of luggage. At first you are worried about whether you have enough space for them, but one of them explains that they would not dream of traveling in your dirty old ship; they will be traveling in style, in a Star Queen luxury liner, and your only duty is to ensure their safety. You have little choice but to acquiesce, even though you think they would be far safer on your own ship.
units.italian: Purtroppo gli ambasciatori della Repubblica corrispondono a tutti i tuoi peggiori stereotipi sui diplomatici della Repubblica: vestiti con abiti sgargianti e poco pratici, e con una quantità assurda di bagagli. All'inizio ti preoccupi di avere abbastanza spazio per loro, ma uno di loro spiega che non si sognerebbero mai di viaggiare sulla tua vecchia nave sporca; viaggeranno con stile, su un transatlantico di lusso Star Queen, e il tuo unico compito è garantire la loro sicurezza. Non hai altra scelta che acconsentire, anche se pensi che sarebbero molto più al sicuro sulla tua nave.

units.id: mission:FW Embassy 1B|Unfortunately, the Republic ambassadors turn out to match all your worst stereotypes of Republic diplomats: dressed in gaudy, impractical clothing, and carrying an absurd amount of luggage. At first you are worried about whether you have enough space for them, but one of them explains that they would not dream of traveling in your dirty old ship; they will be traveling in style, in a Star Queen luxury liner, and your only duty is to ensure their safety. Despite boasting state-of-the-art facilities, you have little choice but to acquiesce. Perhaps they'd rather travel with a Republic-staffed crew, even if they would be far safer on your own ship.|597|0
units.english: Unfortunately, the Republic ambassadors turn out to match all your worst stereotypes of Republic diplomats: dressed in gaudy, impractical clothing, and carrying an absurd amount of luggage. At first you are worried about whether you have enough space for them, but one of them explains that they would not dream of traveling in your dirty old ship; they will be traveling in style, in a Star Queen luxury liner, and your only duty is to ensure their safety. Despite boasting state-of-the-art facilities, you have little choice but to acquiesce. Perhaps they'd rather travel with a Republic-staffed crew, even if they would be far safer on your own ship.
units.italian: Purtroppo gli ambasciatori della Repubblica corrispondono a tutti i tuoi peggiori stereotipi sui diplomatici della Repubblica: vestiti con abiti sgargianti e poco pratici, e con una quantità assurda di bagagli. All'inizio ti preoccupi di avere abbastanza spazio per loro, ma uno di loro spiega che non si sognerebbero mai di viaggiare sulla tua vecchia nave sporca; viaggeranno con stile, su un transatlantico di lusso Star Queen, e il tuo unico compito è garantire la loro sicurezza. Nonostante si vanti di strutture all'avanguardia, non hai altra scelta che acconsentire. Forse preferiscono viaggiare con un equipaggio della Repubblica, anche se sarebbero molto più al sicuro sulla tua nave.

units.english: star queen
units.italian: star queen
