Despite operating your own Star Queen luxury liner, you have little choice but to acquiesce. Perhaps they'd rather travel with a Republic-staffed crew, even if they would be far safer on your own ship.
units.italian: Purtroppo gli ambasciatori della Repubblica corrispondono a tutti i tuoi peggiori stereotipi sui diplomatici della Repubblica: vestiti con abiti sgargianti e poco pratici, e con una quantità assurda di bagagli. All'inizio ti preoccupi di avere abbastanza spazio per loro, ma uno di loro spiega che non si sognerebbero mai di viaggiare sulla tua vecchia nave sporca; viaggeranno con stile, su un transatlantico di lusso Star Queen, e il tuo unico compito è garantire la loro sicurezza. Nonostante tu stesso abbia un transatlantico di lusso Star Queen, non hai altra scelta che acconsentire. Forse preferiscono viaggiare con un equipaggio della Repubblica, anche se sarebbero molto più al sicuro sulla tua nave.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation Break|name|616|0
units.english: Katya and Ijs to <planet>
units.italian: Katya e Ijs per <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation Break|description|617|0
units.english: Bring Katya and Ijs to <destination> for a well-deserved sabbatical. Then you will be free to spend some time upgrading your ship while you wait for the Senate to select a team of ambassadors.
units.italian: Porta Katya e Ijs su <destination> per un sabbatico ben meritato. Poi sarai libero di passare un po' di tempo a migliorare la tua nave mentre aspetti che il Senato scelga una squadra di ambasciatori.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation Break|log|627|0
units.english: Dropped off a team of Republic diplomats on Bourne. It seems like for now, the ceasefire is holding, and public opinion is slowly turning to favor the Free Worlds rather than the Syndicate. But the Syndicate leaders must still be brought to justice. The Council will be in touch when they are ready to help launch an attack on the Syndicate.
units.italian: Hai lasciato una squadra di diplomatici della Repubblica su Bourne. Sembra che per ora il cessate il fuoco tenga, e che l'opinione pubblica si stia lentamente orientando a favore delle Free Worlds piuttosto che del Sindacato. Ma i capi del Sindacato vanno comunque portati davanti alla giustizia. Il Consiglio ti contatterà quando sarà pronto ad aiutare a lanciare un attacco al Sindacato.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation Break|From the way Alondo's eyes light up when he sees Katya, you can tell that all he wants to do right now is to get caught up with her and celebrate her freedom. But he plays the part of a good diplomat, escorting the Republic ambassadors to their new quarters. Along the way he makes pleasant small talk with them, complimenting their style and sophistication. Knowing him as well as you do, you can tell he is saving up his more scathing comments about them until they are out of earshot.|629|0
units.english: From the way Alondo's eyes light up when he sees Katya, you can tell that all he wants to do right now is to get caught up with her and celebrate her freedom. But he plays the part of a good diplomat, escorting the Republic ambassadors to their new quarters. Along the way he makes pleasant small talk with them, complimenting their style and sophistication. Knowing him as well as you do, you can tell he is saving up his more scathing comments about them until they are out of earshot.
units.italian: Da come si illuminano gli occhi di Alondo quando vede Katya, capisci che in questo momento vorrebbe solo mettersi al passo con lei e festeggiare la sua libertà. Ma recita bene la parte del buon diplomatico, scortando gli ambasciatori della Repubblica ai loro nuovi alloggi. Lungo la strada fa conversazione garbata con loro, complimentandosi con il loro stile e la loro raffinatezza. Conoscendolo come lo conosci, capisci che sta conservando i commenti più taglienti su di loro per quando non saranno a portata di orecchio.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation Break|	The moment they are dealt with he gives Katya a hug and says, "Katya! So good to have you back with us. The Council has five members once more. I assume you've been told about Tomek's... departure, and <first>'s promotion?" She nods.|630|0
units.english: The moment they are dealt with he gives Katya a hug and says, "Katya! So good to have you back with us. The Council has five members once more. I assume you've been told about Tomek's... departure, and <first>'s promotion?" She nods.
units.italian: Nel momento in cui se ne sono andati, abbraccia Katya e dice: "Katya! Che bello averti di nuovo con noi. Il Consiglio ha di nuovo cinque membri. Immagino ti abbiano detto della... partenza di Tomek, e della promozione di <first>?" Lei annuisce.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation Break|	Alondo says, "Unfortunately, we don't have any ambassadors of our own picked out yet. The Senate insists on selecting them, and you wouldn't believe how slowly Senate deliberations move. They've interviewed half a dozen candidates so far, and found none to their liking. It pains me to say this, but we may have succeeded in creating a bureaucracy every bit as inefficient as the one we rebelled against."|631|0
units.english: Alondo says, "Unfortunately, we don't have any ambassadors of our own picked out yet. The Senate insists on selecting them, and you wouldn't believe how slowly Senate deliberations move. They've interviewed half a dozen candidates so far, and found none to their liking. It pains me to say this, but we may have succeeded in creating a bureaucracy every bit as inefficient as the one we rebelled against."
units.italian: Alondo dice: "Purtroppo non abbiamo ancora scelto ambasciatori nostri. Il Senato insiste sul selezionarli, e non crederesti a quanto lentamente procedano le deliberazioni del Senato. Finora hanno intervistato una mezza dozzina di candidati, e nessuno è stato di loro gradimento. Mi dispiace dirlo, ma potremmo essere riusciti a creare una burocrazia inefficiente esattamente quanto quella contro cui ci siamo ribellati."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation Break|	"No problem. The important thing is, we're at peace, so their decisions can take as long as they need to."|633|0
units.english: "No problem. The important thing is, we're at peace, so their decisions can take as long as they need to."
units.italian: "Nessun problema. L'importante è che siamo in pace, quindi le loro decisioni possono prendersi tutto il tempo che vogliono."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation Break|	"Have you volunteered to be one of the ambassadors? You're an obvious choice."|635|0
units.english: "Have you volunteered to be one of the ambassadors? You're an obvious choice."
units.italian: "Ti sei offerto come ambasciatore? Saresti una scelta ovvia."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation Break|	"What do we do while we're waiting?"|637|0
units.english: "What do we do while we're waiting?"
units.italian: "Che cosa facciamo mentre aspettiamo?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation Break|	"At peace for now," says Ijs, "but so far a peace without justice. When the time is ripe, we will strike against the Syndicate."|641|0
units.english: "At peace for now," says Ijs, "but so far a peace without justice. When the time is ripe, we will strike against the Syndicate."
units.italian: "In pace per ora," dice Ijs, "ma finora è una pace senza giustizia. Quando il momento sarà maturo, colpiremo il Sindacato."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation Break|	Alondo laughs. "No, that's no work for me," he says. "The ambassadors, as prestigious as their role may seem, are little more than a symbolic gesture. And being cooped up in an embassy on a single planet while things of importance are taking place elsewhere is hardly a job I aspire to."|645|0
units.english: Alondo laughs. "No, that's no work for me," he says. "The ambassadors, as prestigious as their role may seem, are little more than a symbolic gesture. And being cooped up in an embassy on a single planet while things of importance are taking place elsewhere is hardly a job I aspire to."
units.italian: Alondo ride. "No, non è un lavoro per me," dice. "Gli ambasciatori, per quanto prestigioso possa sembrare il loro ruolo, sono poco più che un gesto simbolico. E restare chiuso in un'ambasciata su un solo pianeta mentre altrove succedono cose importanti non è certo il lavoro a cui aspiro."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation Break|	"So, what will we do while we're waiting for the Senate to pick the ambassadors?" you ask.|646|0
units.english: "So, what will we do while we're waiting for the Senate to pick the ambassadors?" you ask.
units.italian: "Allora, che cosa faremo mentre aspettiamo che il Senato scelga gli ambasciatori?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation Break|	Alondo says, "We should use this time of peace well, to prepare for another battle ahead. Those Syndicate ships on New Tibet had equipment I've never seen before, and who knows what else the Syndicate has up their sleeves - especially if they've begun producing nuclear weapons. Captain <last>, you should take this time to make sure your ship is as well armed as possible for our next strike. Ijs and Katya, what will you do with this time?"|650|0
units.english: Alondo says, "We should use this time of peace well, to prepare for another battle ahead. Those Syndicate ships on New Tibet had equipment I've never seen before, and who knows what else the Syndicate has up their sleeves - especially if they've begun producing nuclear weapons. Captain <last>, you should take this time to make sure your ship is as well armed as possible for our next strike. Ijs and Katya, what will you do with this time?"
units.italian: Alondo dice: "Dovremmo usare bene questo tempo di pace, per prepararci alla prossima battaglia. Quelle navi del Sindacato su New Tibet avevano equipaggiamento che non avevo mai visto, e chissà che altro hanno in serbo, soprattutto se hanno cominciato a produrre armi nucleari. Capitano <last>, dovresti approfittare di questo tempo per assicurarti che la tua nave sia armata il meglio possibile per il nostro prossimo colpo. Ijs e Katya, voi che cosa farete in questo tempo?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation Break|	Katya glances at Ijs and then says, "I would certainly welcome a small sabbatical, and a chance to spend time together and catch up on all we've missed. Professor Springborn, do you think the Conservatory would extend your leave of absence long enough for us to make a trip to <planet>?"|651|0
units.english: Katya glances at Ijs and then says, "I would certainly welcome a small sabbatical, and a chance to spend time together and catch up on all we've missed. Professor Springborn, do you think the Conservatory would extend your leave of absence long enough for us to make a trip to <planet>?"
units.italian: Katya lancia un'occhiata a Ijs e poi dice: "Accoglierei senz'altro un piccolo sabbatico, e l'occasione di passare del tempo insieme e recuperare tutto quello che ci siamo persi. Professor Springborn, pensa che il Conservatorio le prolungherebbe il congedo abbastanza perché possiamo fare un viaggio su <planet>?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation Break|	Ijs laughs. "That sounds wonderful, Councilor," he says. "<first>, do you think you could bring us there on your way to wherever you go next?"|652|0
units.english: Ijs laughs. "That sounds wonderful, Councilor," he says. "<first>, do you think you could bring us there on your way to wherever you go next?"
units.italian: Ijs ride. "Mi sembra meraviglioso, consigliera," dice. "<first>, pensi di poterci portare lì mentre vai verso la tua prossima destinazione?"

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation Break|	You tell him you would be glad to, and you all get ready for yet another journey together.|653|0
units.english: You tell him you would be glad to, and you all get ready for yet another journey together.
units.italian: Gli dici che ne sarai felice, e vi preparate tutti a un altro viaggio insieme.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation Break|dialog|657|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Katya and Mr. Eyes hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Katya e Mr. Eyes non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation Break|You drop Ijs and Katya off on Skymoot, and wish them well. They both seem eager for a chance to relax, enjoy one another's company, and forget about matters of galactic importance for a while. "We'll see you soon, <first>," says Katya. "Just be sure your ship is in good fighting shape when the time comes to bring the Syndicate to justice."|661|0
units.english: You drop Ijs and Katya off on Skymoot, and wish them well. They both seem eager for a chance to relax, enjoy one another's company, and forget about matters of galactic importance for a while. "We'll see you soon, <first>," says Katya. "Just be sure your ship is in good fighting shape when the time comes to bring the Syndicate to justice."
units.italian: Lasci Ijs e Katya su Skymoot e auguri loro ogni bene. Sembrano entrambi impazienti di avere l'occasione di rilassarsi, godersi la compagnia l'uno dell'altra e dimenticare per un po' le questioni di importanza galattica. "Ci vediamo presto, <first>," dice Katya. "Assicurati solo che la tua nave sia in buone condizioni di combattimento quando arriverà il momento di portare il Sindacato davanti alla giustizia."

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation Break Ends|name|666|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Torna su <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation Break Ends|description|667|0
units.english: Rejoin Ijs, Katya, and Alondo on <destination>.
units.italian: Raggiungi di nuovo Ijs, Katya e Alondo su <destination>.

units.id: mission:FW Reconciliation Break Ends|You receive a coded message from Alondo: "The Senate has finished selecting the ambassadors, and all is in readiness for our other work as well. Please meet us back on <planet> as soon as you can."|678|0
units.english: You receive a coded message from Alondo: "The Senate has finished selecting the ambassadors, and all is in readiness for our other work as well. Please meet us back on <planet> as soon as you can."
units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio in codice da Alondo: "Il Senato ha finito di selezionare gli ambasciatori, e tutto è pronto anche per il nostro altro lavoro. Per favore raggiungici su <planet> il prima possibile."

units.id: mission:FW Embassy 1C|name|685|0
units.english: Ambassadors to Earth
units.italian: Ambasciatori sulla Terra

units.id: mission:FW Embassy 1C|description|686|0
units.english: Escort a Dreadnought carrying Free Worlds ambassadors to Earth. This Dreadnought will then take part in your combined "police action" against the Syndicate.
units.italian: Scorta un Dreadnought che trasporta gli ambasciatori delle Free Worlds fino alla Terra. Questo Dreadnought prenderà poi parte alla nostra "azione di polizia" congiunta contro il Sindacato.

units.id: mission:FW Embassy 1C|blocked|692|0
units.english: You do not have bunks available for Ijs and Katya. Return here when you do.
units.italian: Non hai cuccette disponibili per Ijs e Katya. Torna qui quando ne avrai.

units.id: mission:FW Embassy 1C|When you land on Bourne you discover that Katya and Ijs have already been back there for a week. Alondo is with them, too. "We just couldn't stay away from the action for long," says Ijs.|700|0
units.english: When you land on Bourne you discover that Katya and Ijs have already been back there for a week. Alondo is with them, too. "We just couldn't stay away from the action for long," says Ijs.
units.italian: Quando atterri su Bourne scopri che Katya e Ijs sono già tornati lì da una settimana. Anche Alondo è con loro. "Non riuscivamo a stare lontani dall'azione a lungo," dice Ijs.

units.id: mission:FW Embassy 1C|	The Star Queen luxury liner that brought the Earth ambassadors to Bourne is still parked in a somewhat out-of-the-way hangar. "Don't worry, Captain," says Katya, "there's no way our ambassadors would travel in something as gaudy as that. They've requisitioned a Dreadnought instead. A good ship to remind the people of Earth that we have a strong fleet of our own."|701|0
units.english: The Star Queen luxury liner that brought the Earth ambassadors to Bourne is still parked in a somewhat out-of-the-way hangar. "Don't worry, Captain," says Katya, "there's no way our ambassadors would travel in something as gaudy as that. They've requisitioned a Dreadnought instead. A good ship to remind the people of Earth that we have a strong fleet of our own."
units.italian: Il transatlantico di lusso Star Queen che ha portato gli ambasciatori della Terra su Bourne è ancora parcheggiato in un hangar un po' fuori mano. "Non preoccuparti, Capitano," dice Katya, "non c'è modo che i nostri ambasciatori viaggino su qualcosa di così sgargiante. Hanno requisito un Dreadnought, invece. Una buona nave per ricordare alla gente della Terra che abbiamo una flotta nostra e forte."

units.id: mission:FW Embassy 1C|	"Not to mention," says Ijs, "a good ship to take part in our strike against the Syndicate."|702|0
units.english: "Not to mention," says Ijs, "a good ship to take part in our strike against the Syndicate."
units.italian: "Per non parlare," dice Ijs, "di una buona nave per prendere parte al nostro colpo contro il Sindacato."

units.id: mission:FW Embassy 1C|	Alondo introduces you to the Free Worlds ambassadors who will be returning to Earth. "I've already contacted Governor Flint and Admiral Danforth," he says. "Their ships will be arriving in the Sol system about the same time as yours. Good luck, Captain." You help Ijs and Katya load their luggage onto your ship, and tell the Dreadnought carrying the ambassadors to be ready to follow you.|703|0
units.english: Alondo introduces you to the Free Worlds ambassadors who will be returning to Earth. "I've already contacted Governor Flint and Admiral Danforth," he says. "Their ships will be arriving in the Sol system about the same time as yours. Good luck, Captain." You help Ijs and Katya load their luggage onto your ship, and tell the Dreadnought carrying the ambassadors to be ready to follow you.
units.italian: Alondo ti presenta gli ambasciatori delle Free Worlds che torneranno sulla Terra. "Ho già contattato il governatore Flint e l'ammiraglio Danforth," dice. "Le loro navi arriveranno nel sistema Sol più o meno nello stesso momento in cui arriverai tu. Buona fortuna, Capitano." Aiuti Ijs e Katya a caricare i bagagli sulla tua nave, e dici al Dreadnought che trasporta gli ambasciatori di tenersi pronto a seguirti.

units.id: mission:FW Embassy 1C|dialog|712|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left the ambassadors behind! Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro gli ambasciatori! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivino in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1|name|753|0
units.english: Raid on Nimbus
units.italian: Incursione su Nimbus

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1|description|754|0
units.english: Travel to <destination> along with ships from the Oathkeepers, the Deep, and the Free Worlds, to capture Alexander Soylent, a Syndicate executive. Do not allow your escorts to be destroyed.
units.italian: Recati su <destination> insieme a navi degli Oathkeepers, del Deep e delle Free Worlds per catturare Alexander Soylent, un dirigente del Sindacato. Non permettere che le tue scorte vengano distrutte.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1|log|766|0
units.english: Preparing to invade Syndicate space with a joint strike force made up of Free Worlds, Deep security, and Oathkeeper ships. The plan is to capture one of the Syndicate executives and bring him to trial.
units.italian: Ti stai preparando a invadere lo spazio del Sindacato con una forza d'attacco congiunta composta da navi delle Free Worlds, della sicurezza del Deep e degli Oathkeepers. Il piano è catturare uno dei dirigenti del Sindacato e portarlo davanti a un tribunale.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1|You land on Earth and make a show of being very busy ensuring that the Free Worlds ambassadors are comfortable and well cared for, until finally you receive a secure message from Edrick. He tells you that the convoy from the Deep is landing on Mars right now, and an Oathkeeper Cruiser is visiting the shipyard on Luna. As soon as you are ready, you can take off, and travel together into the heart of Syndicate space.|768|0
units.english: You land on Earth and make a show of being very busy ensuring that the Free Worlds ambassadors are comfortable and well cared for, until finally you receive a secure message from Edrick. He tells you that the convoy from the Deep is landing on Mars right now, and an Oathkeeper Cruiser is visiting the shipyard on Luna. As soon as you are ready, you can take off, and travel together into the heart of Syndicate space.
units.italian: Atterri sulla Terra e fai mostra di essere molto impegnato ad assicurarti che gli ambasciatori delle Free Worlds siano comodi e ben accuditi, finché alla fine ricevi un messaggio riservato da Edrick. Ti dice che il convoglio dal Deep sta atterrando su Marte proprio ora, e che un incrociatore degli Oathkeepers è in visita al cantiere su Luna. Appena sei pronto puoi decollare, e viaggiare insieme nel cuore dello spazio del Sindacato.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1|	You make an excuse to depart, and return to your ship. "Well," says Ijs, "this is it. If we're lucky, they won't see us coming, but no matter what, getting back out of Syndicate space will be a nightmare. Good luck, all."|769|0
units.english: You make an excuse to depart, and return to your ship. "Well," says Ijs, "this is it. If we're lucky, they won't see us coming, but no matter what, getting back out of Syndicate space will be a nightmare. Good luck, all."
units.italian: Trovi una scusa per andartene e torni alla tua nave. "Beh," dice Ijs, "ci siamo. Se siamo fortunati non ci vedranno arrivare, ma in ogni caso riuscire a uscire dallo spazio del Sindacato sarà un incubo. Buona fortuna a tutti."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1|dialog|772|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left one of your escorts! Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro una delle tue scorte! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivino in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1B|name|809|0
units.english: Escape to <planet>
units.italian: Fuga verso <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1B|description|810|0
units.english: You have captured the Syndicate executive Alexander Soylent. Now, bring him safely to <planet>, where he will face trial.
units.italian: Hai catturato il dirigente del Sindacato Alexander Soylent. Ora portalo sano e salvo su <planet>, dove affronterà il processo.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1B|As you approach the planet, your ships spread out and begin scanning the ocean surface for a yacht matching the description you were given. After a few tense moments of wondering if Soylent is off-world at the moment, you find the ship.|822|0
units.english: As you approach the planet, your ships spread out and begin scanning the ocean surface for a yacht matching the description you were given. After a few tense moments of wondering if Soylent is off-world at the moment, you find the ship.
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini al pianeta, le tue navi si dispongono e cominciano a scansionare la superficie dell'oceano in cerca di uno yacht corrispondente alla descrizione che ti hanno dato. Dopo qualche momento di tensione, chiedendoti se Soylent sia fuori dal pianeta in questo momento, trovi la nave.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1B|	With neither deflector shields nor any weaponry that you can see, the yacht clearly poses no threat to an armed starship. The Aerie that Edrick sent launches its four fighters; when they land on the yacht's deck, armed police officers emerge. Meanwhile your fleet is ready to open fire at the first sign of resistance.|823|0
units.english: With neither deflector shields nor any weaponry that you can see, the yacht clearly poses no threat to an armed starship. The Aerie that Edrick sent launches its four fighters; when they land on the yacht's deck, armed police officers emerge. Meanwhile your fleet is ready to open fire at the first sign of resistance.
units.italian: Senza scudi deflettori né armi visibili, lo yacht chiaramente non rappresenta una minaccia per un'astronave armata. L'Aerie che Edrick ha mandato lancia i suoi quattro caccia; quando atterrano sul ponte dello yacht, ne scendono ufficiali di polizia armati. Nel frattempo la tua flotta è pronta ad aprire il fuoco al primo segno di resistenza.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1B|	The officers soon radio you that they have found Soylent, and they bring him aboard your ship. Amid all the confusion, you notice a figure in diving gear who jumps off the rear of the yacht and disappears beneath the waves - one of Soylent's men, trying to escape. But since his leader is now in your custody, and your mission is accomplished, you see no reason to chase after him.|824|0
units.english: The officers soon radio you that they have found Soylent, and they bring him aboard your ship. Amid all the confusion, you notice a figure in diving gear who jumps off the rear of the yacht and disappears beneath the waves - one of Soylent's men, trying to escape. But since his leader is now in your custody, and your mission is accomplished, you see no reason to chase after him.
units.italian: Gli ufficiali ti comunicano via radio di aver trovato Soylent, e lo portano a bordo della tua nave. In tutta la confusione, noti una figura in muta subacquea che salta dalla parte posteriore dello yacht e scompare sotto le onde: uno degli uomini di Soylent, che cerca di scappare. Ma dato che il suo capo è ormai in tua custodia e la missione è compiuta, non vedi motivo di inseguirlo.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1B|	The Oathkeeper captain sends you a brief message: "Your first priority is to reach the Deep with the prisoner. Our crew is prepared to serve as a rearguard, staying behind if necessary to ensure that you survive. Good luck, Captain."|825|0
units.english: The Oathkeeper captain sends you a brief message: "Your first priority is to reach the Deep with the prisoner. Our crew is prepared to serve as a rearguard, staying behind if necessary to ensure that you survive. Good luck, Captain."
units.italian: Il capitano degli Oathkeepers ti manda un breve messaggio: "La tua prima priorità è raggiungere il Deep con il prigioniero. Il nostro equipaggio è pronto a fare da retroguardia, restando indietro se necessario per assicurarsi che tu sopravviva. Buona fortuna, Capitano."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1B|dialog|828|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Katya and Mr. Eyes hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Katya e Mr. Eyes non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1B|There is a warning light on your ship's main control panel that has never turned on. It is a relic of the dark age of galactic travel, part of a sensor system that is built into every starship, to detect incoming nuclear warheads. You had almost forgotten it even existed, because you have never seen it flash.|952|0
units.english: There is a warning light on your ship's main control panel that has never turned on. It is a relic of the dark age of galactic travel, part of a sensor system that is built into every starship, to detect incoming nuclear warheads. You had almost forgotten it even existed, because you have never seen it flash.
units.italian: Sul pannello di controllo principale della tua nave c'è una spia di allarme che non si è mai accesa. È un residuo dell'età oscura dei viaggi galattici, parte di un sistema di sensori incorporato in ogni astronave, per rilevare le testate nucleari in avvicinamento. Avevi quasi dimenticato che esistesse, perché non l'hai mai vista lampeggiare.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1B|	It begins flashing now.|953|0
units.english: It begins flashing now.
units.italian: Ora comincia a lampeggiare.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1B|There is a warning light on your ship's main control panel that has never turned on. It is a relic of the dark age of galactic travel, part of a sensor system that is built into every starship, to detect incoming nuclear warheads. You had almost forgotten it even existed, because you have never seen it flash.|956|0
units.english: There is a warning light on your ship's main control panel that has never turned on. It is a relic of the dark age of galactic travel, part of a sensor system that is built into every starship, to detect incoming nuclear warheads. You had almost forgotten it even existed, because you have never seen it flash.

Avevi quasi dimenticato che esistesse, perché non l'hai mai vista lampeggiare.

units.english: It begins flashing now.
units.italian: Ora comincia a lampeggiare.

It is a relic of the dark age of galactic travel, part of a sensor system that is built into every starship, to detect incoming nuclear warheads.
