units.english: There is a warning light on your ship's main control panel that has never turned on. It is a relic of the dark age of galactic travel, part of a sensor system that is built into every starship, to detect incoming nuclear warheads. You had almost forgotten it even existed, because you have never seen it flash.
units.italian: Sul pannello di controllo principale della tua nave c'è una spia di allarme che non si è mai accesa. È un residuo dell'età oscura dei viaggi galattici, parte di un sistema di sensori incorporato in ogni astronave, per rilevare le testate nucleari in avvicinamento. Avevi quasi dimenticato che esistesse, perché non l'hai mai vista lampeggiare.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1B|	It begins flashing now.|961|0
units.english: It begins flashing now.
units.italian: Ora comincia a lampeggiare.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1C|name|967|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Torna su <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1C|description|968|0
units.english: The Syndicate is massing a fleet in the Sol system. Return to <planet> to rendezvous with the Free Worlds fleet in order to be ready to defend Earth if it is attacked.
units.italian: Il Sindacato sta radunando una flotta nel sistema Sol. Torna su <planet> per incontrarti con la flotta delle Free Worlds, così da essere pronto a difendere la Terra se viene attaccata.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1C|log|979|0
units.english: Succeeded in capturing a Syndicate executive named Alexander Soylent, but the Syndicate has responded by sending a massive fleet to Sol, supposedly to "protect" Earth but more likely to put pressure on Parliament and the people of Earth to side with the Syndicate.
units.italian: Sei riuscito a catturare un dirigente del Sindacato di nome Alexander Soylent, ma il Sindacato ha risposto mandando una flotta enorme nel Sol, presumibilmente per "proteggere" la Terra, ma più probabilmente per fare pressione sul Parlamento e sulla gente della Terra perché si schierino con il Sindacato.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1C|Edrick meets you soon after you land, and oversees the transfer of your captive to a local, well-defended jail. You tell him about your narrow escape from Syndicate space, and the fact that the Syndicate used nuclear weapons against your fleet, in violation of the rules of war that humankind has abided by for centuries.|982|0
units.english: Edrick meets you soon after you land, and oversees the transfer of your captive to a local, well-defended jail. You tell him about your narrow escape from Syndicate space, and the fact that the Syndicate used nuclear weapons against your fleet, in violation of the rules of war that humankind has abided by for centuries.
units.italian: Edrick ti incontra poco dopo l'atterraggio e sovrintende al trasferimento del tuo prigioniero in una prigione locale ben difesa. Gli racconti della tua fuga per un soffio dallo spazio del Sindacato, e del fatto che il Sindacato ha usato armi nucleari contro la tua flotta, violando le regole di guerra che l'umanità rispetta da secoli.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1C|	"Unfortunately," says Edrick, "all the other witnesses to that event were allied with the Syndicate, so people will believe whatever they want to believe. Already the Syndicate is spreading stories about a renegade fleet of rebels and extremists that attacked one of their worlds in an assassination attempt on one of their leaders. Worse, they've taken this as an excuse to send a massive Syndicate fleet to the Sol system - to defend Earth from attack, they say."|983|0
units.english: "Unfortunately," says Edrick, "all the other witnesses to that event were allied with the Syndicate, so people will believe whatever they want to believe. Already the Syndicate is spreading stories about a renegade fleet of rebels and extremists that attacked one of their worlds in an assassination attempt on one of their leaders. Worse, they've taken this as an excuse to send a massive Syndicate fleet to the Sol system - to defend Earth from attack, they say."
units.italian: "Purtroppo," dice Edrick, "tutti gli altri testimoni di quell'evento erano alleati del Sindacato, quindi la gente crederà a quello che vuole credere. Il Sindacato sta già diffondendo storie su una flotta rinnegata di ribelli ed estremisti che ha attaccato uno dei loro mondi in un tentativo di assassinare uno dei loro capi. Peggio ancora, hanno preso questo come scusa per mandare una flotta enorme del Sindacato nel sistema Sol: per difendere la Terra da un attacco, dicono."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1C|	"Sounds more like the goal is to intimidate Parliament into siding with the Syndicate."|985|0
units.english: "Sounds more like the goal is to intimidate Parliament into siding with the Syndicate."
units.italian: "Mi sembra più che l'obiettivo sia intimidire il Parlamento perché si schieri con il Sindacato."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1C|	"Are they attacking the Republic ships, or are they still technically at peace?"|987|0
units.english: "Are they attacking the Republic ships, or are they still technically at peace?"
units.italian: "Stanno attaccando le navi della Repubblica, o sono ancora tecnicamente in pace?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1C|	"We should attack them immediately, before they are able to harm anyone on Earth."|989|0
units.english: "We should attack them immediately, before they are able to harm anyone on Earth."
units.italian: "Dovremmo attaccarli subito, prima che riescano a fare del male a qualcuno sulla Terra."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1C|	"Indeed," he says.|993|0
units.english: "Indeed," he says.
units.italian: "Esatto," dice.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1C|	"Apparently no one is shooting at anyone else," says Edrick, "but that could change at any minute. You may be aware that there is very little love for the Syndicate among Navy admirals. The only thing keeping the Navy from attacking the Syndicate now is the Navy's devotion to order and obedience; they won't start a new war without Parliament's approval, and of course that approval is unlikely with Syndicate warships circling overhead."|996|0
units.english: "Apparently no one is shooting at anyone else," says Edrick, "but that could change at any minute. You may be aware that there is very little love for the Syndicate among Navy admirals. The only thing keeping the Navy from attacking the Syndicate now is the Navy's devotion to order and obedience; they won't start a new war without Parliament's approval, and of course that approval is unlikely with Syndicate warships circling overhead."
units.italian: "A quanto pare nessuno sta sparando a nessun altro," dice Edrick, "ma la cosa potrebbe cambiare da un momento all'altro. Forse saprai che fra gli ammiragli della Marina c'è molto poco affetto per il Sindacato. L'unica cosa che trattiene la Marina dall'attaccare il Sindacato adesso è la sua devozione all'ordine e all'obbedienza; non comincerà una nuova guerra senza l'approvazione del Parlamento, e naturalmente quell'approvazione è improbabile con le navi da guerra del Sindacato che girano sopra la testa."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1C|	"That would be a terrible idea," he says. "First, it would play right into their narrative. And second, humanity is on the very brink now of shattering into half a dozen different splinters: the Deep, the Free Worlds, the Navy, the Syndicate each on their own against the rest. I don't want to be the one who gives the order that causes that to happen."|999|0
units.english: "That would be a terrible idea," he says. "First, it would play right into their narrative. And second, humanity is on the very brink now of shattering into half a dozen different splinters: the Deep, the Free Worlds, the Navy, the Syndicate each on their own against the rest. I don't want to be the one who gives the order that causes that to happen."
units.italian: "Sarebbe un'idea terribile," dice. "Primo, farebbe esattamente il gioco della loro versione dei fatti. E secondo, l'umanità è ormai sul punto di frantumarsi in una mezza dozzina di schegge: il Deep, le Free Worlds, la Marina, il Sindacato, ognuno per conto proprio contro gli altri. Non voglio essere io a dare l'ordine che provoca questo."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1C|	Katya says, "It sounds like if the Free Worlds enters Sol, we'll be the spark that sets off an explosion. So, we'll have to trust the Deep, or the Navy, or someone else to try to defuse the situation. Meanwhile, I suggest we return to Free space and muster our entire fleet, to assist the Navy against the Syndicate if it comes to that. JJ ought to be on <planet>; we can meet up with him there."|1003|0
units.english: Katya says, "It sounds like if the Free Worlds enters Sol, we'll be the spark that sets off an explosion. So, we'll have to trust the Deep, or the Navy, or someone else to try to defuse the situation. Meanwhile, I suggest we return to Free space and muster our entire fleet, to assist the Navy against the Syndicate if it comes to that. JJ ought to be on <planet>; we can meet up with him there."
units.italian: Katya dice: "A quanto pare, se le Free Worlds entrano nel Sol, saremo la scintilla che fa esplodere tutto. Quindi dovremo fidarci del Deep, o della Marina, o di qualcun altro, perché provi a disinnescare la situazione. Nel frattempo suggerisco di tornare nello spazio delle Free Worlds e radunare tutta la nostra flotta, per assistere la Marina contro il Sindacato se si arriverà a questo. JJ dovrebbe essere su <planet>; possiamo incontrarlo lì."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Capture 1C|dialog|1006|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Katya and Mr. Eyes hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Katya e Mr. Eyes non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 1|name|1012|0
units.english: What happened to Rand?
units.italian: Che fine ha fatto Rand?

units.id: mission:FW Pug 1|description|1013|0
units.english: Try to determine why communications with Rand in the Zeta Aquilae system were cut off.
units.italian: Cerca di capire perché le comunicazioni con Rand, nel sistema Zeta Aquilae, siano state interrotte.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 1|log|1024|0
units.english: All communications with Rand, which recently joined the Free Worlds but is close to Syndicate territory, have been cut off. It is possible that this is the beginning of a Syndicate invasion.
units.italian: Tutte le comunicazioni con Rand, che si è da poco unito alle Free Worlds ma è vicino al territorio del Sindacato, sono state interrotte. È possibile che sia l'inizio di un'invasione del Sindacato.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 1|As soon as you land on <origin>, JJ comes running up to your ship. "<first>," he says, "we have serious trouble. A few minutes ago I received a distress call from Rand, then their transmission was cut off. I'm afraid the Syndicate may be expanding into our space."|1031|0
units.english: As soon as you land on <origin>, JJ comes running up to your ship. "<first>," he says, "we have serious trouble. A few minutes ago I received a distress call from Rand, then their transmission was cut off. I'm afraid the Syndicate may be expanding into our space."
units.italian: Appena atterri su <origin>, JJ ti corre incontro verso la nave. "<first>," dice, "abbiamo un problema serio. Qualche minuto fa ho ricevuto una chiamata di soccorso da Rand, poi la loro trasmissione è stata interrotta. Temo che il Sindacato si stia espandendo nel nostro spazio."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 1|	"Is our fleet ready to respond?"|1033|0
units.english: "Is our fleet ready to respond?"
units.italian: "La nostra flotta è pronta a rispondere?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 1|	"What should we do?"|1034|0
units.english: "What should we do?"
units.italian: "Che cosa dovremmo fare?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 1|	"Our fleet is still scattered throughout this quadrant," he says, "and I'll need Katya to command a part of it. Right now I just need you to travel to Rand, if possible, and find out what's going on. It could just be a communications malfunction, but I seriously doubt it. Meanwhile, Katya and Ijs can help me with organizing the fleet."|1035|0
units.english: "Our fleet is still scattered throughout this quadrant," he says, "and I'll need Katya to command a part of it. Right now I just need you to travel to Rand, if possible, and find out what's going on. It could just be a communications malfunction, but I seriously doubt it. Meanwhile, Katya and Ijs can help me with organizing the fleet."
units.italian: "La nostra flotta è ancora sparpagliata per questo quadrante," dice, "e avrò bisogno di Katya per comandarne una parte. Per ora mi serve solo che tu vada su Rand, se possibile, e scopra che cosa succede. Potrebbe essere solo un guasto alle comunicazioni, ma ne dubito seriamente. Nel frattempo Katya e Ijs possono aiutarmi a organizzare la flotta."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 1|Based on your previous maps of this sector, there should be a hyperspace link from here to the Rasalhague system. But your sensors show nothing. Something has severed the link.|1042|0
units.english: Based on your previous maps of this sector, there should be a hyperspace link from here to the Rasalhague system. But your sensors show nothing. Something has severed the link.
units.italian: In base alle tue mappe precedenti di questo settore, dovrebbe esserci un collegamento iperspaziale da qui al sistema Rasalhague. Ma i tuoi sensori non mostrano niente. Qualcosa ha reciso il collegamento.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 1|The Ascella system used to be linked to Rasalhague and Zeta Aquilae, but no longer. Either the Syndicate has discovered the ability to alter hyperspace links, and is using it to block the Free Worlds from interfering with them, or you have a much stranger problem on your hands...|1045|0
units.english: The Ascella system used to be linked to Rasalhague and Zeta Aquilae, but no longer. Either the Syndicate has discovered the ability to alter hyperspace links, and is using it to block the Free Worlds from interfering with them, or you have a much stranger problem on your hands...
units.italian: Il sistema Ascella era collegato a Rasalhague e a Zeta Aquilae, ma non più. O il Sindacato ha scoperto come alterare i collegamenti iperspaziali, e li usa per impedire alle Free Worlds di interferire con loro, o hai tra le mani un problema molto più strano...

units.id: mission:FW Pug 1|Upon jumping to the Zeta Aquilae system, you can see that the hyperspace link that should exist to Ascella is no longer present. Instead, there is a new link going north, toward a star that never had any links before...|1051|0
units.english: Upon jumping to the Zeta Aquilae system, you can see that the hyperspace link that should exist to Ascella is no longer present. Instead, there is a new link going north, toward a star that never had any links before...
units.italian: Saltando nel sistema Zeta Aquilae, vedi che il collegamento iperspaziale che dovrebbe esistere verso Ascella non c'è più. Al suo posto ce n'è uno nuovo che va a nord, verso una stella che non aveva mai avuto collegamenti...

units.id: mission:FW Pug 1 Tundra|log|1062|0
units.english: No one on Tundra, which is one of Rand's neighbors, has any idea how the hyperspace link was cut off. They wonder if this might have something to do with a star system near Rand that was inaccessible by hyperdrive.
units.italian: Nessuno su Tundra, che è uno dei vicini di Rand, ha idea di come sia stato reciso il collegamento iperspaziale. Si chiedono se c'entri qualcosa un sistema stellare vicino a Rand che era inaccessibile con l'iperspazio.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 1 Tundra|You land on Tundra and ask around to see if anyone knows why the hyperspace link to Rasalhague is gone. Everyone is talking about it, but no one seems to have a believable theory. "Maybe that odd star out past Rasalhague, the one you can't jump to, went nova," suggests one captain.|1064|0
units.english: You land on Tundra and ask around to see if anyone knows why the hyperspace link to Rasalhague is gone. Everyone is talking about it, but no one seems to have a believable theory. "Maybe that odd star out past Rasalhague, the one you can't jump to, went nova," suggests one captain.
units.italian: Atterri su Tundra e chiedi in giro se qualcuno sa perché il collegamento iperspaziale verso Rasalhague è sparito. Ne parlano tutti, ma nessuno sembra avere una teoria credibile. "Magari quella strana stella oltre Rasalhague, quella dove non si può saltare, è esplosa come una nova," suggerisce un capitano.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 1 Tundra|	You also talk with several people who mention that the northern lights have been spectacular the last few days, unlike anything they had ever seen before.|1065|0
units.english: You also talk with several people who mention that the northern lights have been spectacular the last few days, unlike anything they had ever seen before.
units.italian: Parli anche con diverse persone che ti raccontano che le aurore boreali sono state spettacolari negli ultimi giorni, come non ne avevano mai viste.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 1 Arabia|log|1076|0
units.english: No one on Arabia knows what has caused hyperspace links in this region of space to suddenly disappear. There are stories of graviton surges and an alien ship, but they may all just be rumors.
units.italian: Nessuno su Arabia sa che cosa abbia fatto sparire improvvisamente i collegamenti iperspaziali in questa regione dello spazio. Ci sono storie di picchi di gravitoni e di una nave aliena, ma potrebbero essere solo voci.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 1 Arabia|You land on Arabia and try to find someone who knows what is going on, but everyone seems just as confused as you are. The spaceport authorities say that their sensors picked up a massive graviton surge when the hyperlinks collapsed, but they are not sure whether the surge caused the collapse, or was a result of it.|1078|0
units.english: You land on Arabia and try to find someone who knows what is going on, but everyone seems just as confused as you are. The spaceport authorities say that their sensors picked up a massive graviton surge when the hyperlinks collapsed, but they are not sure whether the surge caused the collapse, or was a result of it.
units.italian: Atterri su Arabia e cerchi qualcuno che sappia che cosa succede, ma tutti sembrano confusi quanto te. Le autorità dello spazioporto dicono che i loro sensori hanno rilevato un picco enorme di gravitoni quando gli ipercollegamenti sono collassati, ma non sono sicure se il picco abbia causato il collasso o ne sia stato la conseguenza.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 1 Arabia|	One merchant captain claims that he was in orbit at the time, and he saw a ship unlike anything he'd ever seen before, that appeared and then disappeared in a flash "just like those Quarg ships do." You aren't sure whether or not to believe him.|1079|0
units.english: One merchant captain claims that he was in orbit at the time, and he saw a ship unlike anything he'd ever seen before, that appeared and then disappeared in a flash "just like those Quarg ships do." You aren't sure whether or not to believe him.
units.italian: Un capitano mercantile sostiene di essere stato in orbita in quel momento, e di aver visto una nave diversa da qualsiasi cosa avesse mai visto, che è comparsa e poi è sparita in un lampo "proprio come fanno quelle navi dei Quarg". Non sei sicuro se credergli o no.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 1 Return|You receive an urgent message from JJ: "Captain <last>, return to New Tibet at once! We've received word that the Syndicate is somehow severing their hyperspace connections to the rest of human space. We're calling an emergency Council meeting, to convene as soon as you arrive here."|1092|0
units.english: You receive an urgent message from JJ: "Captain <last>, return to New Tibet at once! We've received word that the Syndicate is somehow severing their hyperspace connections to the rest of human space. We're calling an emergency Council meeting, to convene as soon as you arrive here."
units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio urgente da JJ: "Capitano <last>, torna subito su New Tibet! Ci è arrivata notizia che il Sindacato sta in qualche modo recidendo i suoi collegamenti iperspaziali con il resto dello spazio umano. Convocheremo una riunione d'emergenza del Consiglio, che si terrà appena arriverai qui."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2|name|1099|0
units.english: Meet with Parliament
units.italian: Incontra il Parlamento

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2|description|1100|0
units.english: Travel with Alondo to Earth to meet with Parliament. They are now much more willing to meet with you given how real the Syndicate threat seems.
units.italian: Va' sulla Terra con Alondo per incontrare il Parlamento. Ora sono molto più disposti a incontrarti, dato quanto sembra reale la minaccia del Sindacato.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2|blocked|1108|0
units.english: As you are landing, Alondo contacts you and asks, "Do you have a bunk free for me?" You do not, so you will need to free one up in order to continue this mission.
units.italian: Mentre stai atterrando, Alondo ti contatta e chiede: "Hai una cuccetta libera per me?" Non ce l'hai, quindi dovrai liberarne una per continuare questa missione.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2|log|1113|0
units.english: The Syndicate may be cutting off the hyperspace links that join their territory to the rest of human space, in order to escape being punished for their crimes. People are worried that they will try to take over even more territory, including Earth itself.
units.italian: Il Sindacato potrebbe stare recidendo i collegamenti iperspaziali che uniscono il suo territorio al resto dello spazio umano, per sottrarsi alla punizione dei suoi crimini. La gente teme che proveranno a prendere ancora più territorio, compresa la Terra stessa.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2|By the time you arrive, Alondo and Freya have joined JJ and Katya on New Tibet; the entire Council is present. "Here's the story," says JJ. "A few weeks ago, hyperspace links on the edge of Syndicate space began collapsing. We weren't sure why. Then, more recently, the Syndicate fleet that had been occupying the Sol system retreated to Syndicate space - and the moment the last of their ships left, the hyperspace link disappeared behind them. We think the Syndicate has found a way to alter hyperspace links and is using it to wall themselves in, to escape retribution from the rest of humanity now that their guilt is so conclusively proven."|1115|0
units.english: By the time you arrive, Alondo and Freya have joined JJ and Katya on New Tibet; the entire Council is present. "Here's the story," says JJ. "A few weeks ago, hyperspace links on the edge of Syndicate space began collapsing. We weren't sure why. Then, more recently, the Syndicate fleet that had been occupying the Sol system retreated to Syndicate space - and the moment the last of their ships left, the hyperspace link disappeared behind them. We think the Syndicate has found a way to alter hyperspace links and is using it to wall themselves in, to escape retribution from the rest of humanity now that their guilt is so conclusively proven."
units.italian: Quando arrivi, Alondo e Freya si sono già uniti a JJ e Katya su New Tibet; il Consiglio è al completo. "Ecco la storia," dice JJ. "Qualche settimana fa i collegamenti iperspaziali al margine dello spazio del Sindacato hanno cominciato a collassare. Non sapevamo perché. Poi, più di recente, la flotta del Sindacato che occupava il sistema Sol si è ritirata nello spazio del Sindacato, e nel momento in cui l'ultima delle loro navi se n'è andata, il collegamento iperspaziale è sparito dietro di loro. Crediamo che il Sindacato abbia trovato un modo per alterare i collegamenti iperspaziali e lo stia usando per murarsi dentro, per sfuggire alla punizione del resto dell'umanità ora che la sua colpevolezza è così definitivamente dimostrata."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2|	"Why don't we just let them go, then?"|1117|0
units.english: "Why don't we just let them go, then?"
units.italian: "Perché allora non lasciamo che se ne vadano?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2|	"What is the Republic planning to do in response?"|1119|0
units.english: "What is the Republic planning to do in response?"
units.italian: "Che cosa ha intenzione di fare la Repubblica in risposta?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2|	Freya says, "Somehow, they managed to annex several of our systems in the process of walling themselves off - our two best suppliers of heavy metals. That suggests that any of our systems on the border with the Syndicate may be taken over, and made completely inaccessible to us, at any time. That's not a risk we can take."|1123|0
units.english: Freya says, "Somehow, they managed to annex several of our systems in the process of walling themselves off - our two best suppliers of heavy metals. That suggests that any of our systems on the border with the Syndicate may be taken over, and made completely inaccessible to us, at any time. That's not a risk we can take."
units.italian: Freya dice: "In qualche modo sono riusciti ad annettere diversi nostri sistemi mentre si muravano dentro: i nostri due migliori fornitori di metalli pesanti. Il che significa che qualsiasi nostro sistema al confine con il Sindacato può essere preso e reso del tutto inaccessibile per noi, in qualsiasi momento. Non è un rischio che possiamo correre."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2|	"And it's not just that," says Katya. "Think of how many workers are on Syndicate worlds right now, having left their families on a different planet in order to go earn money in a Syndicate factory for a few years. Imagine a future where those families are forever divided."|1124|0
units.english: "And it's not just that," says Katya. "Think of how many workers are on Syndicate worlds right now, having left their families on a different planet in order to go earn money in a Syndicate factory for a few years. Imagine a future where those families are forever divided."
units.italian: "E non è solo questo," dice Katya. "Pensa a quanti lavoratori ci sono ora sui mondi del Sindacato, che hanno lasciato le loro famiglie su un altro pianeta per andare a guadagnare in una fabbrica del Sindacato per qualche anno. Immagina un futuro in cui quelle famiglie restano divise per sempre."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2|	"They're in a panic," says Katya. "Earth is on the very boundary of the area that was cut off, and that means at any moment, they could choose to cut off humanity's homeworld from the rest of human space. And we don't even know if it is possible to restore the links once they have been cut."|1128|0
units.english: "They're in a panic," says Katya. "Earth is on the very boundary of the area that was cut off, and that means at any moment, they could choose to cut off humanity's homeworld from the rest of human space. And we don't even know if it is possible to restore the links once they have been cut."
units.italian: "Sono nel panico," dice Katya. "La Terra è proprio al confine dell'area che è stata tagliata fuori, il che significa che da un momento all'altro potrebbero decidere di tagliare il mondo d'origine dell'umanità dal resto dello spazio umano. E non sappiamo nemmeno se sia possibile ripristinare i collegamenti una volta recisi."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2|	"According to our embassy," says Alondo, "all communications links with Syndicate space have been cut. The Net relies on hyperspace links to transmit messages, and there are no transmitter relays in the uninhabited systems that now form the only remaining link to Syndicate space."|1132|0
units.english: "According to our embassy," says Alondo, "all communications links with Syndicate space have been cut. The Net relies on hyperspace links to transmit messages, and there are no transmitter relays in the uninhabited systems that now form the only remaining link to Syndicate space."
units.italian: "Secondo la nostra ambasciata," dice Alondo, "tutti i collegamenti di comunicazione con lo spazio del Sindacato sono stati tagliati. La Rete si basa sui collegamenti iperspaziali per trasmettere i messaggi, e non ci sono ripetitori nei sistemi disabitati che ora costituiscono l'unico collegamento rimasto con lo spazio del Sindacato."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2|	JJ says, "The Senate has agreed that we must put our differences with the Republic aside, and meet with Parliament immediately to deal with this crisis. <first>, we're asking you and Alondo to go to Earth, and lend your assistance as you see fit. Any questions?"|1133|0
units.english: JJ says, "The Senate has agreed that we must put our differences with the Republic aside, and meet with Parliament immediately to deal with this crisis. <first>, we're asking you and Alondo to go to Earth, and lend your assistance as you see fit. Any questions?"
units.italian: JJ dice: "Il Senato ha convenuto che dobbiamo mettere da parte le nostre divergenze con la Repubblica e incontrare subito il Parlamento per affrontare questa crisi. <first>, chiediamo a te e ad Alondo di andare sulla Terra e dare il vostro contributo come ritenete giusto. Domande?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2|	"No, I'm ready to go."|1135|0
units.english: "No, I'm ready to go."
units.italian: "No, sono pronto a partire."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2|	"How do we know the Syndicate is really behind this?"|1137|0
units.english: "How do we know the Syndicate is really behind this?"
units.italian: "Come sappiamo che il Sindacato è davvero dietro a tutto questo?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2|	"We don't," says JJ, "but this all certainly plays out very well for them; their section of the galaxy has suddenly become a very defensible enclave. And the timing of that fleet leaving, and then the link closing - it's too much to be a coincidence. But we can't learn anything for sure by staying here talking; you must go to Earth."|1139|0
units.english: "We don't," says JJ, "but this all certainly plays out very well for them; their section of the galaxy has suddenly become a very defensible enclave. And the timing of that fleet leaving, and then the link closing - it's too much to be a coincidence. But we can't learn anything for sure by staying here talking; you must go to Earth."
units.italian: "Non lo sappiamo," dice JJ, "ma tutta questa storia si incastra molto bene per loro; la loro parte di galassia è diventata all'improvviso un'enclave molto difendibile. E la coincidenza fra la partenza di quella flotta e la chiusura del collegamento è troppo grossa. Ma non scopriremo niente di certo restando qui a parlare; devi andare sulla Terra."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2|dialog|1142|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Alondo hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Alondo non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2A|name|1155|0
units.english: Reason with the Syndicate
units.italian: Ragiona con il Sindacato

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2A|description|1156|0
units.english: Travel with Alondo to meet with the Syndicate leaders on Foundry, determine their intentions, and convince them not to completely seal themselves off from human space. Hurry, before they cut the last link.
units.italian: Va' con Alondo a incontrare i capi del Sindacato su Foundry, stabilisci le loro intenzioni e convincili a non isolarsi del tutto dallo spazio umano. Sbrigati, prima che taglino l'ultimo collegamento.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2A|log|1168|0
units.english: Agreed to travel to Syndicate space through the one remaining hyperspace path that is still open, through the uninhabited star systems to the north.
units.italian: Hai accettato di viaggiare nello spazio del Sindacato attraverso l'unica via iperspaziale ancora aperta, passando per i sistemi stellari disabitati a nord.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2A|A palpable sense of fear and near-panic hangs over the spaceport on Earth. At any minute, this system that serves as the very hub of human government could disappear into the same unknown abyss that has swallowed up its neighbors.|1170|0
units.english: A palpable sense of fear and near-panic hangs over the spaceport on Earth. At any minute, this system that serves as the very hub of human government could disappear into the same unknown abyss that has swallowed up its neighbors.
units.italian: Un senso palpabile di paura e quasi di panico aleggia sullo spazioporto della Terra. Da un momento all'altro, questo sistema che è il fulcro stesso del governo umano potrebbe sparire nello stesso abisso sconosciuto che ha inghiottito i suoi vicini.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2A|	Parliament is eager now to meet with you, and to receive whatever assistance you may be able to offer. As Alondo stands in front of the chamber asking the members of Parliament for more information, they answer him with respect and deference, far different from how you have been treated here in the past. You learn that although one link remains open to Syndicate space, no one has dared to travel through it. Given the pace at which the other links were cut, they fear that the one remaining link will disappear any day now.|1171|0
units.english: Parliament is eager now to meet with you, and to receive whatever assistance you may be able to offer. As Alondo stands in front of the chamber asking the members of Parliament for more information, they answer him with respect and deference, far different from how you have been treated here in the past. You learn that although one link remains open to Syndicate space, no one has dared to travel through it. Given the pace at which the other links were cut, they fear that the one remaining link will disappear any day now.
units.italian: Il Parlamento ora è impaziente di incontrarti e di ricevere qualsiasi aiuto tu possa offrire. Mentre Alondo sta davanti alla sala e chiede ai membri del Parlamento più informazioni, loro gli rispondono con rispetto e deferenza, molto diversi da come sei stato trattato qui in passato. Scopri che, anche se un collegamento verso lo spazio del Sindacato resta aperto, nessuno ha osato attraversarlo. Dato il ritmo con cui gli altri collegamenti sono stati tagliati, temono che quello rimasto sparirà da un giorno all'altro.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2A|	As the conversation continues, it eventually becomes clear why you have been called here: the Republic wants you to take on the risk none of them is willing to face, and travel through to Syndicate space to reason with their leaders.|1172|0
units.english: As the conversation continues, it eventually becomes clear why you have been called here: the Republic wants you to take on the risk none of them is willing to face, and travel through to Syndicate space to reason with their leaders.
units.italian: Mentre la conversazione continua, alla fine diventa chiaro perché sei stato chiamato qui: la Repubblica vuole che ti assuma il rischio che nessuno di loro è disposto ad affrontare, e che attraversi lo spazio del Sindacato per ragionare con i loro capi.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2A|	"If this is what it takes to keep human space from being torn into fragments, I will risk my ship to go meet with the Syndicate."|1174|0
units.english: "If this is what it takes to keep human space from being torn into fragments, I will risk my ship to go meet with the Syndicate."
units.italian: "Se è questo che serve per impedire che lo spazio umano venga fatto a pezzi, rischio la mia nave per andare a incontrare il Sindacato."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2A|	"This sounds like a job for the Navy, not for me. I can't risk being trapped in hostile Syndicate space forever."|1176|0
units.english: "This sounds like a job for the Navy, not for me. I can't risk being trapped in hostile Syndicate space forever."
units.italian: "Mi sembra un lavoro per la Marina, non per me. Non posso rischiare di restare intrappolato per sempre nello spazio ostile del Sindacato."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2A|	"This sounds like a job for the Navy, not for me. I don't want to face the entire hostile Syndicate."|1180|0
units.english: "This sounds like a job for the Navy, not for me. I don't want to face the entire hostile Syndicate."
units.italian: "Mi sembra un lavoro per la Marina, non per me. Non voglio affrontare l'intero Sindacato ostile."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2A|	"Did the Syndicate communicate anything to you before the links were cut that might help us guess at their intentions?"|1184|0
units.english: "Did the Syndicate communicate anything to you before the links were cut that might help us guess at their intentions?"
units.italian: "Il Sindacato vi ha comunicato qualcosa prima che i collegamenti fossero tagliati, che possa aiutarci a indovinare le loro intenzioni?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2A|	One of the members of Parliament says, "It's all terribly confusing. Our sources in Syndicate space were reporting massive fleet movements just before it happened. We also heard rumors of Syndicate fleets fighting each other. Some sort of internal power struggle."|1186|0
units.english: One of the members of Parliament says, "It's all terribly confusing. Our sources in Syndicate space were reporting massive fleet movements just before it happened. We also heard rumors of Syndicate fleets fighting each other. Some sort of internal power struggle."
units.italian: Uno dei membri del Parlamento dice: "È tutto terribilmente confuso. Le nostre fonti nello spazio del Sindacato riferivano enormi movimenti di flotte appena prima che succedesse. Abbiamo anche sentito voci di flotte del Sindacato che si combattevano fra loro. Una specie di lotta interna per il potere."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2A|	Another man speaks up and adds, "We had also been aware for some time that the Syndicate had gained access to alien technology, through encounters with a nomadic alien species currently inhabiting the galactic core. They may have found a way to use that technology to alter the links." From the surprised expressions on the faces of many of the other members of Parliament, it's clear that this information is new to them.|1187|0
units.english: Another man speaks up and adds, "We had also been aware for some time that the Syndicate had gained access to alien technology, through encounters with a nomadic alien species currently inhabiting the galactic core. They may have found a way to use that technology to alter the links." From the surprised expressions on the faces of many of the other members of Parliament, it's clear that this information is new to them.
units.italian: Un altro uomo prende la parola e aggiunge: "Sapevamo anche, da un po' di tempo, che il Sindacato era riuscito ad accedere a tecnologia aliena, attraverso incontri con una specie aliena nomade che abita attualmente il nucleo galattico. Potrebbero aver trovato il modo di usare quella tecnologia per alterare i collegamenti." Dalle espressioni sorprese sui volti di molti altri membri del Parlamento, è chiaro che questa informazione è nuova per loro.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2A|	"Very well, we will accept this mission."|1189|0
units.english: "Very well, we will accept this mission."
units.italian: "Molto bene, accettiamo questa missione."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2A|	"Sorry, I'm not willing to risk my ship over this."|1191|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not willing to risk my ship over this."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non sono disposto a rischiare la mia nave per questo."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2A|	Alondo says, quietly but firmly, "Captain <last>, the Senate has asked you to assist the Republic in this matter, and the Council agrees. I know the risk is great, but you swore to serve the Free Worlds, and the Free Worlds are now commanding you to take this mission."|1195|0
units.english: Alondo says, quietly but firmly, "Captain <last>, the Senate has asked you to assist the Republic in this matter, and the Council agrees. I know the risk is great, but you swore to serve the Free Worlds, and the Free Worlds are now commanding you to take this mission."
units.italian: Alondo dice, piano ma con fermezza: "Capitano <last>, il Senato ti ha chiesto di assistere la Repubblica in questa faccenda, e il Consiglio è d'accordo. So che il rischio è grande, ma hai giurato di servire le Free Worlds, e le Free Worlds ora ti ordinano di assumerti questa missione."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2A|	"Very well," you say, "I accept. But I'm afraid of what will happen when we reach Syndicate space."|1196|0
units.english: "Very well," you say, "I accept. But I'm afraid of what will happen when we reach Syndicate space."
units.italian: "Molto bene," dici, "accetto. Ma temo quello che succederà quando arriveremo nello spazio del Sindacato."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2A|	Parliament thanks you for your willingness to serve, and you and Alondo hurry back to your ship. "There's no telling how long the link will remain open," he says. "So, we must hurry to the Syndicate headquarters on <planet> immediately."|1199|0
units.english: Parliament thanks you for your willingness to serve, and you and Alondo hurry back to your ship. "There's no telling how long the link will remain open," he says. "So, we must hurry to the Syndicate headquarters on <planet> immediately."
units.italian: Il Parlamento ti ringrazia per la disponibilità a servire, e tu e Alondo vi affrettate a tornare alla nave. "Non si può sapere quanto resterà aperto il collegamento," dice. "Quindi dobbiamo sbrigarci ad arrivare al quartier generale del Sindacato su <planet>."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2A|dialog|1207|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Alondo hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Alondo non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2A Visit|Oddly, when you land on <origin> you find that the people here are in as much of a state of confusion and fear as back on Earth. Either no one knows what is going on and why they have been nearly cut off from the rest of human space, or every single person you talk to is united in a conspiracy to feign ignorance. They urge you to continue your journey to meet with the Syndicate executives on Foundry. "Maybe you can talk some sense into them," says one merchant captain. "First the nukes, and now this. The extremist faction within the Syndicate is getting out of hand."|1228|0
units.english: Oddly, when you land on <origin> you find that the people here are in as much of a state of confusion and fear as back on Earth. Either no one knows what is going on and why they have been nearly cut off from the rest of human space, or every single person you talk to is united in a conspiracy to feign ignorance. They urge you to continue your journey to meet with the Syndicate executives on Foundry. "Maybe you can talk some sense into them," says one merchant captain. "First the nukes, and now this. The extremist faction within the Syndicate is getting out of hand."
units.italian: Stranamente, quando atterri su <origin> scopri che la gente qui è in uno stato di confusione e paura pari a quello della Terra. O nessuno sa che cosa succede e perché sono stati quasi tagliati fuori dal resto dello spazio umano, o ogni singola persona con cui parli è unita in un complotto per fingere ignoranza. Ti esortano a proseguire il viaggio per incontrare i dirigenti del Sindacato su Foundry. "Magari riesci a far ragionare qualcuno di loro," dice un capitano mercantile. "Prima le testate nucleari, e ora questo. La fazione estremista dentro il Sindacato sta sfuggendo di mano."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|name|1235|0
units.english: Install a Jump Drive
units.italian: Installa un motore di salto

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|description|1236|0
units.english: Travel to the Syndicate world of Hephaestus, where the Syndicate Systems personnel have been instructed to install a jump drive on your ship, so that you can investigate the systems that the Pug has cut off.
units.italian: Recati sul mondo del Sindacato di Hephaestus, dove al personale della Syndicate Systems è stato ordinato di installare un motore di salto sulla tua nave, così che tu possa indagare sui sistemi che i Pug hanno tagliato fuori.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|log|1247|0
units.english: The Syndicate CEO, Alastair Korban, claims that the disappearing hyperspace links are not their doing, and that in fact they are under attack by aliens. In fact, they say that the Syndicate has had contact with two different alien species in this region - raiders and scavengers known as the Korath coming from the galactic core, and an enigmatic and irrational species named the Pug who occupy the system adjacent to the ones that recently got cut off from human space.
units.italian: L'amministratore delegato del Sindacato, Alastair Korban, sostiene che la sparizione dei collegamenti iperspaziali non è opera loro, e che in realtà sono sotto attacco da parte di alieni. Anzi, dicono che il Sindacato ha avuto contatti con due diverse specie aliene in questa regione: predoni e saccheggiatori noti come Korath, provenienti dal nucleo galattico, e una specie enigmatica e irrazionale chiamata Pug, che occupa il sistema adiacente a quelli recentemente tagliati fuori dallo spazio umano.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|log|1248|0
units.english: By plundering the Korath raiders, the Syndicate has acquired some jump drives, which allow a ship to travel between systems that are not connected by hyperspace links. They are willing to part with one of these jump drives in order to prove the truth of their story to the rest of humanity.
units.italian: Saccheggiando i predoni Korath, il Sindacato ha acquisito alcuni motori di salto, che permettono a una nave di viaggiare fra sistemi non collegati da vie iperspaziali. Sono disposti a cederne uno per dimostrare al resto dell'umanità la verità della loro storia.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|log|1249|0
units.english: CEO of the Syndicate Corporation for over two decades, Alastair Korban's tenure of the megacorporation has been capped by soaring profits owing to the human civil war. However, Korban has confirmed in speech what Sawyer brought forward to the Free Worlds and the Republic; that a "certain extremist faction" of the Syndicate were behind the bombings on Martini and Geminus.
units.italian: Amministratore delegato della Syndicate Corporation per oltre vent'anni, il mandato di Alastair Korban alla guida della megacorporazione è stato coronato da profitti in forte crescita grazie alla guerra civile umana. Korban però ha confermato a voce quello che Sawyer aveva portato alle Free Worlds e alla Repubblica: che una "certa fazione estremista" del Sindacato era dietro gli attentati su Martini e Geminus.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|As you are coming in for a landing you announce yourselves to the spaceport authorities as diplomatic representatives of the Free Worlds and the Republic. The moment you land, a Syndicate employee meets you and escorts you to their headquarters, to the incredibly fancy corner office of Alastair Korban, the CEO of the entire Syndicate Corporation. "I'm very glad you've come," says Alastair. "It seems unlikely that we can defeat this attack unless we work together."|1251|0
units.english: As you are coming in for a landing you announce yourselves to the spaceport authorities as diplomatic representatives of the Free Worlds and the Republic. The moment you land, a Syndicate employee meets you and escorts you to their headquarters, to the incredibly fancy corner office of Alastair Korban, the CEO of the entire Syndicate Corporation. "I'm very glad you've come," says Alastair. "It seems unlikely that we can defeat this attack unless we work together."
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini per atterrare, vi annunciate alle autorità dello spazioporto come rappresentanti diplomatici delle Free Worlds e della Repubblica. Appena atterri, un dipendente del Sindacato vi incontra e vi scorta al loro quartier generale, nell'incredibilmente elegante ufficio d'angolo di Alastair Korban, l'amministratore delegato dell'intera Syndicate Corporation. "Sono molto contento che siate venuti," dice Alastair. "Sembra improbabile che possiamo sconfiggere questo attacco, a meno che non lavoriamo insieme."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|	"Wait," says Alondo, "you're saying this whole thing is not the Syndicate's doing?"|1252|0
units.english: "Wait," says Alondo, "you're saying this whole thing is not the Syndicate's doing?"
units.italian: "Aspetta," dice Alondo, "stai dicendo che tutta questa storia non è opera del Sindacato?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|	Alastair seems taken aback. "Of course not. Seal off valuable trade routes? Why would we do that?"|1253|0
units.english: Alastair seems taken aback. "Of course not. Seal off valuable trade routes? Why would we do that?"
units.italian: Alastair sembra colto di sorpresa. "Certo che no. Sigillare rotte commerciali preziose? Perché mai dovremmo?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|	"We thought you were walling yourselves off to escape prosecution for your acts of terrorism."|1255|0
units.english: "We thought you were walling yourselves off to escape prosecution for your acts of terrorism."
units.italian: "Pensavamo che vi steste murando dentro per sfuggire al processo per i vostri atti di terrorismo."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|	"If it isn't you, then who is it?"|1256|0
units.english: "If it isn't you, then who is it?"
units.italian: "Se non siete voi, allora chi è?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|	Alastair says, "That terrorism was the action of a certain extremist faction that we have since purged from our ranks, and we were in the process of hunting down the perpetrators. Your raid on Nimbus interrupted those plans and gave the others a chance to go into hiding, but we will see to it that they, too, are brought to justice. But now, we need to put the past behind us and figure out how to work together against our common foe."|1259|0
units.english: Alastair says, "That terrorism was the action of a certain extremist faction that we have since purged from our ranks, and we were in the process of hunting down the perpetrators. Your raid on Nimbus interrupted those plans and gave the others a chance to go into hiding, but we will see to it that they, too, are brought to justice. But now, we need to put the past behind us and figure out how to work together against our common foe."
units.italian: Alastair dice: "Quel terrorismo è stato l'azione di una certa fazione estremista che da allora abbiamo epurato dalle nostre file, e stavamo dando la caccia ai responsabili. La vostra incursione su Nimbus ha interrotto quei piani e ha dato agli altri la possibilità di nascondersi, ma faremo in modo che anche loro siano portati davanti alla giustizia. Ma ora dobbiamo lasciarci il passato alle spalle e capire come lavorare insieme contro il nostro nemico comune."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|	"I think you're lying. You had years to turn over those extremists, and you did not."|1261|0
units.english: "I think you're lying. You had years to turn over those extremists, and you did not."
units.italian: "Penso che stiate mentendo. Avete avuto anni per consegnare quegli estremisti, e non l'avete fatto."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|	"Very well. Who is this common foe? You seem to know more than we do."|1262|0
units.english: "Very well. Who is this common foe? You seem to know more than we do."
units.italian: "Molto bene. Chi è questo nemico comune? Sembra che sappiate più di noi."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|	"We are deeply, deeply sorry for the actions of these extremists," says Alastair, "and for our own inaction in turning them in. We had hoped that we could deal with them internally, without it becoming public knowledge that we were connected with them. That was a foolish choice for us to make, and we are more than willing to make whatever reparations you demand."|1265|0
units.english: "We are deeply, deeply sorry for the actions of these extremists," says Alastair, "and for our own inaction in turning them in. We had hoped that we could deal with them internally, without it becoming public knowledge that we were connected with them. That was a foolish choice for us to make, and we are more than willing to make whatever reparations you demand."
units.italian: "Siamo profondamente, profondamente dispiaciuti per le azioni di questi estremisti," dice Alastair, "e per la nostra inazione nel consegnarli. Speravamo di poterci occupare di loro internamente, senza che diventasse di dominio pubblico il fatto che eravamo collegati a loro. È stata una scelta sciocca da parte nostra, e siamo più che disposti a fare qualsiasi riparazione chiediate."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|	"You are aware that you started a war, right? Every Navy or Free Worlds militia member who died fighting each other is your responsibility."|1267|0
units.english: "You are aware that you started a war, right? Every Navy or Free Worlds militia member who died fighting each other is your responsibility."
units.italian: "Siete consapevoli di aver iniziato una guerra, vero? Ogni membro della Marina o della milizia delle Free Worlds morto combattendo contro altri è una vostra responsabilità."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|	"Okay, we'll deal with that later. For now, tell us everything you know about whoever is attacking you."|1268|0
units.english: "Okay, we'll deal with that later. For now, tell us everything you know about whoever is attacking you."
units.italian: "Va bene, ce ne occuperemo dopo. Per ora, diteci tutto quello che sapete su chi vi sta attaccando."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|	"<first>, enough," says Alondo. "We'll sort out the reparations later. For now, we need to know who is severing the hyperspace links."|1271|0
units.english: "<first>, enough," says Alondo. "We'll sort out the reparations later. For now, we need to know who is severing the hyperspace links."
units.italian: "<first>, basta così," dice Alondo. "Le riparazioni le sistemeremo dopo. Per ora dobbiamo sapere chi sta recidendo i collegamenti iperspaziali."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|	"They are called the Pug," says Alastair, "an irrational alien species that previously inhabited a single star system in between Syndicate and Republic space. They have since expanded their territory to include all the human systems neighboring their own star, and have essentially made those human worlds into their slaves."|1274|0
units.english: "They are called the Pug," says Alastair, "an irrational alien species that previously inhabited a single star system in between Syndicate and Republic space. They have since expanded their territory to include all the human systems neighboring their own star, and have essentially made those human worlds into their slaves."
units.italian: "Si chiamano Pug," dice Alastair, "una specie aliena irrazionale che prima abitava un solo sistema stellare fra lo spazio del Sindacato e quello della Repubblica. Da allora hanno esteso il loro territorio fino a includere tutti i sistemi umani vicini alla loro stella, e hanno di fatto reso schiavi quei mondi umani."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|	"How do you know this?" asks Alondo.|1275|0
units.english: "How do you know this?" asks Alondo.
units.italian: "Come fate a saperlo?" chiede Alondo.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|	Alastair pauses for a minute as if trying to figure out the best way to explain himself, then says, "One of our ships traveled to the occupied systems, using a jump drive that we... acquired... from another alien species." He seems to realize how unlikely that sounds, and backpedals. "For years we've been dealing with occasional raids from a species called the Korath. As best we can tell, they're nomadic scavengers and pirates who currently inhabit the galactic core. Over the years we have disabled several of their ships and stolen their jump drives."|1276|0
units.english: Alastair pauses for a minute as if trying to figure out the best way to explain himself, then says, "One of our ships traveled to the occupied systems, using a jump drive that we... acquired... from another alien species." He seems to realize how unlikely that sounds, and backpedals. "For years we've been dealing with occasional raids from a species called the Korath. As best we can tell, they're nomadic scavengers and pirates who currently inhabit the galactic core. Over the years we have disabled several of their ships and stolen their jump drives."
units.italian: Alastair tace per un minuto, come se cercasse il modo migliore di giustificarsi, poi dice: "Una delle nostre navi è andata nei sistemi occupati, usando un motore di salto che abbiamo... acquisito... da un'altra specie aliena." Sembra rendersi conto di quanto suoni improbabile, e fa marcia indietro. "Da anni abbiamo a che fare con incursioni occasionali di una specie chiamata Korath. Per quanto possiamo capire, sono saccheggiatori e pirati nomadi che abitano attualmente il nucleo galattico. Nel corso degli anni abbiamo messo fuori uso diverse loro navi e rubato i loro motori di salto."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|	"Did it not occur to you that attacking the Korath might anger other alien species?"|1278|0
units.english: "Did it not occur to you that attacking the Korath might anger other alien species?"
units.italian: "Non vi è venuto in mente che attaccare i Korath potesse far arrabbiare altre specie aliene?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|	"Wait, now there are two different alien species involved? Your story is getting even more convoluted and unbelievable."|1280|0
units.english: "Wait, now there are two different alien species involved? Your story is getting even more convoluted and unbelievable."
units.italian: "Aspetta, ora ci sono due specie aliene diverse coinvolte? La tua storia diventa sempre più contorta e incredibile."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|	"That is unlikely. The equipment we stole from the Korath is most likely something they stole from someone else."|1284|0
units.english: "That is unlikely. The equipment we stole from the Korath is most likely something they stole from someone else."
units.italian: "È improbabile. L'equipaggiamento che abbiamo rubato ai Korath è molto probabilmente qualcosa che loro hanno rubato a qualcun altro."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|	"Yes," he says, "it is a very convoluted mess. Which is why we need your help."|1288|0
units.english: "Yes," he says, "it is a very convoluted mess. Which is why we need your help."
units.italian: "Sì," dice, "è un pasticcio molto contorto. Ed è per questo che abbiamo bisogno del vostro aiuto."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|	"Assuming you're telling the truth," says Alondo, "what sort of help do you need from us?"|1292|0
units.english: "Assuming you're telling the truth," says Alondo, "what sort of help do you need from us?"
units.italian: "Supponendo che diciate la verità," dice Alondo, "che tipo di aiuto vi serve da noi?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|	Alastair says, "We have only seven jump drives, so whatever fleet attacks the Pug can only contain seven ships. Unless the Quarg or someone else will give you more drives, I suppose. So those ships must be stronger than any ship we have here in Syndicate space, because the Pug are very strong. They obliterated our fleet that had been occupying the Sol system, even though that fleet was armed with the majority of our nuclear arsenal."|1293|0
units.english: Alastair says, "We have only seven jump drives, so whatever fleet attacks the Pug can only contain seven ships. Unless the Quarg or someone else will give you more drives, I suppose. So those ships must be stronger than any ship we have here in Syndicate space, because the Pug are very strong. They obliterated our fleet that had been occupying the Sol system, even though that fleet was armed with the majority of our nuclear arsenal."
units.italian: Alastair dice: "Abbiamo solo sette motori di salto, quindi qualsiasi flotta attacchi i Pug può contenere solo sette navi. A meno che i Quarg, o qualcun altro, non vi diano altri motori, immagino. Quindi quelle navi devono essere più forti di qualsiasi nave abbiamo qui nello spazio del Sindacato, perché i Pug sono molto forti. Hanno annientato la nostra flotta che occupava il sistema Sol, anche se quella flotta era armata con la maggior parte del nostro arsenale nucleare."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|	"You're saying you'll provide the jump drives, and we'll provide the ships? Sounds fair enough."|1295|0
units.english: "You're saying you'll provide the jump drives, and we'll provide the ships? Sounds fair enough."
units.italian: "Stai dicendo che voi fornite i motori di salto e noi le navi? Mi sembra giusto."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|	"Wait, you're saying that your fleet that was in orbit around Earth... was armed with nuclear weapons? Are you genocidal?"|1297|0
units.english: "Wait, you're saying that your fleet that was in orbit around Earth... was armed with nuclear weapons? Are you genocidal?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, stai dicendo che la vostra flotta in orbita intorno alla Terra... era armata con armi nucleari? Siete dei genocidi?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|	Alastair seems like the kind of person who seldom admits he is wrong, but your question definitely flusters him. "Okay, okay, I admit, we've been making one bad decision after another ever since... well, since that first bad decision. It just got out of control. We thought the Navy was going to raid us and put us all behind bars. We thought we needed a deterrent. It was stupid. I admit it, okay? Now please, let's just move on. We need your capital ships, and you need our jump drives."|1299|0
units.english: Alastair seems like the kind of person who seldom admits he is wrong, but your question definitely flusters him. "Okay, okay, I admit, we've been making one bad decision after another ever since... well, since that first bad decision. It just got out of control. We thought the Navy was going to raid us and put us all behind bars. We thought we needed a deterrent. It was stupid. I admit it, okay? Now please, let's just move on. We need your capital ships, and you need our jump drives."
units.italian: Alastair sembra il tipo di persona che ammette raramente di sbagliarsi, ma la tua domanda lo mette decisamente in imbarazzo. "Va bene, va bene, ammetto che abbiamo preso una decisione sbagliata dopo l'altra da quando... beh, da quella prima decisione sbagliata. Ci è semplicemente sfuggito di mano. Pensavamo che la Marina ci avrebbe fatto irruzione e messo tutti in prigione. Pensavamo di aver bisogno di un deterrente. È stato stupido. Lo ammetto, va bene? Ora, per favore, andiamo avanti. Noi abbiamo bisogno delle vostre navi capitali, e voi avete bisogno dei nostri motori di salto."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|	"Hold on," says Alondo, "I have one condition to add. You will give us one of your jump drives immediately. We will install it in our ship and verify that you are telling the truth about the Pug. If you are, we will work together until this threat is dealt with... and once it is dealt with, we will return our attention to bringing every member of the Syndicate who had a hand in those terrorist attacks to justice. That is our best and final offer." You nod in agreement.|1302|0
units.english: "Hold on," says Alondo, "I have one condition to add. You will give us one of your jump drives immediately. We will install it in our ship and verify that you are telling the truth about the Pug. If you are, we will work together until this threat is dealt with... and once it is dealt with, we will return our attention to bringing every member of the Syndicate who had a hand in those terrorist attacks to justice. That is our best and final offer." You nod in agreement.
units.italian: "Un momento," dice Alondo, "devo aggiungere una condizione. Ci darete subito uno dei vostri motori di salto. Lo installeremo sulla nostra nave e verificheremo che diciate la verità sui Pug. Se è così, lavoreremo insieme finché questa minaccia non sarà risolta... e una volta risolta, torneremo a occuparci di portare davanti alla giustizia ogni membro del Sindacato che ha avuto parte in quegli attentati terroristici. È la nostra migliore e ultima offerta." Fai un cenno di assenso.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|	It's clear that Alastair is none too happy about that deal, but he accepts it. "The jump drives are all being kept on Hephaestus," he says. "Our Systems division was trying to discover the secret behind them, with little success. If you travel there, I'll tell them to install one of the drives in your ship."|1303|0
units.english: It's clear that Alastair is none too happy about that deal, but he accepts it. "The jump drives are all being kept on Hephaestus," he says. "Our Systems division was trying to discover the secret behind them, with little success. If you travel there, I'll tell them to install one of the drives in your ship."
units.italian: È chiaro che Alastair non è affatto contento di quell'accordo, ma lo accetta. "I motori di salto sono tutti tenuti su Hephaestus," dice. "La nostra divisione Systems stava cercando di scoprirne il segreto, con scarso successo. Se andate lì, dirò loro di installare uno dei motori sulla vostra nave."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2B|dialog|1306|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Alondo hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Alondo non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2C: Hyperdrive|name|1312|0
units.english: Investigate the Pug
units.italian: Indaga sui Pug

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2C: Hyperdrive|description|1313|0
units.english: Travel to the Deneb system to investigate the Pug; if possible, make contact with them and determine what their goals and desires are.
units.italian: Recati nel sistema Deneb per indagare sui Pug; se possibile, mettiti in contatto con loro e stabilisci quali siano i loro obiettivi e i loro desideri.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2C: Hyperdrive|You are directed to land in a hangar some distance away from the spaceport, in a cluster of buildings owned by Syndicated Systems. A team of engineers meets you and quickly and efficiently removes your hyperdrive and replaces it with a strange, alien-looking device that you assume must be a jump drive. "Now, be careful with your fuel gauge," one of them tells you. "This thing guzzles twice as much fuel per jump as an ordinary hyperdrive, and you don't want to become stranded while outside human space."|1328|0
units.english: You are directed to land in a hangar some distance away from the spaceport, in a cluster of buildings owned by Syndicated Systems. A team of engineers meets you and quickly and efficiently removes your hyperdrive and replaces it with a strange, alien-looking device that you assume must be a jump drive. "Now, be careful with your fuel gauge," one of them tells you. "This thing guzzles twice as much fuel per jump as an ordinary hyperdrive, and you don't want to become stranded while outside human space."
units.italian: Ti dicono di atterrare in un hangar a una certa distanza dallo spazioporto, in un gruppo di edifici di proprietà della Syndicate Systems. Una squadra di ingegneri ti incontra e con rapidità ed efficienza rimuove il tuo iperpropulsore sostituendolo con uno strano congegno dall'aspetto alieno che supponi essere un motore di salto. "Ora, attento all'indicatore del carburante," ti dice uno di loro. "Questa cosa consuma il doppio del carburante per salto rispetto a un iperpropulsore normale, e non vuoi restare bloccato fuori dallo spazio umano."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2C: Hyperdrive|dialog|1335|0

units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Alondo non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

Una squadra di ingegneri ti incontra e con rapidità ed efficienza rimuove il tuo motore scram sostituendolo con uno strano congegno dall'aspetto alieno che supponi essere un motore di salto. units.italian: Indaga sui Pug

units.english: Travel to the Deneb system to investigate the Pug; if possible, make contact with them and determine what their goals and desires are.
units.italian: Recati nel sistema Deneb per indagare sui Pug; se possibile, mettiti in contatto con loro e stabilisci quali siano i loro obiettivi e i loro desideri.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2C: Jump Drive|You are directed to land in a hangar some distance away from the spaceport, in a cluster of buildings owned by Syndicated Systems. A team of engineers meets you and asks if they can look over your ship; a few minutes later, one of them says in surprise, "You've already got a jump drive! How did you manage that?" Since you don't need their equipment, they urge you to head directly for Pug space and continue your mission.|1389|0
units.english: You are directed to land in a hangar some distance away from the spaceport, in a cluster of buildings owned by Syndicated Systems. A team of engineers meets you and asks if they can look over your ship; a few minutes later, one of them says in surprise, "You've already got a jump drive! How did you manage that?" Since you don't need their equipment, they urge you to head directly for Pug space and continue your mission.
units.italian: Ti dicono di atterrare in un hangar a una certa distanza dallo spazioporto, in un gruppo di edifici di proprietà della Syndicate Systems. Una squadra di ingegneri ti incontra e chiede di dare un'occhiata alla tua nave; qualche minuto dopo uno di loro dice, sorpreso: "Avete già un motore di salto! Come avete fatto?" Dato che non ti serve il loro equipaggiamento, ti esortano a puntare dritto verso lo spazio dei Pug e a proseguire la missione.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2C: Jump Drive|dialog|1396|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Alondo hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Alondo non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Pug Jump Drive Check|Somehow, you've misplaced or lost the jump drive needed to continue the Free Worlds story! If you are unable to find your jump drive, you should revert to the autosave or another earlier snapshot of the game.|1410|0
units.english: Somehow, you've misplaced or lost the jump drive needed to continue the Free Worlds story! If you are unable to find your jump drive, you should revert to the autosave or another earlier snapshot of the game.
units.italian: In qualche modo hai perso o smarrito il motore di salto necessario per continuare la storia delle Free Worlds! Se non riesci a ritrovarlo, dovresti tornare al salvataggio automatico o a un'altra istantanea precedente del gioco.

units.id: mission:FW Pug Jump Drive Check|Alternatively, you could try to track down the Korath raiders that the Syndicate mentioned, and steal another jump drive from them, but it sounds like the Korath can put up quite a fight...|1411|0
units.english: Alternatively, you could try to track down the Korath raiders that the Syndicate mentioned, and steal another jump drive from them, but it sounds like the Korath can put up quite a fight...
units.italian: In alternativa potresti provare a rintracciare i predoni Korath di cui ha parlato il Sindacato, e rubare un altro motore di salto da loro, ma sembra che i Korath sappiano battersi duramente...

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2C: Side|log|1426|0
units.english: Visited one of the human worlds that has been captured by the Pug. The Pug do not seem to be mistreating the people here, but they have stationed armed guards throughout the spaceport.
units.italian: Hai visitato uno dei mondi umani conquistati dai Pug. I Pug non sembrano maltrattare la gente del posto, ma hanno disposto guardie armate in tutto lo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2C: Side|When you land at the spaceport on <origin>, you find no evidence of violent struggle; merchant captains are walking around freely, haggling for commodities, and conversing with each other just like in any other spaceport you have visited. However, the spaceport is also being patrolled by small groups of slender, bipedal, pale-skinned aliens who you assume are the Pug. Each one is holding a metal staff: probably some sort of weapon.|1428|0
units.english: When you land at the spaceport on <origin>, you find no evidence of violent struggle; merchant captains are walking around freely, haggling for commodities, and conversing with each other just like in any other spaceport you have visited. However, the spaceport is also being patrolled by small groups of slender, bipedal, pale-skinned aliens who you assume are the Pug. Each one is holding a metal staff: probably some sort of weapon.
units.italian: Quando atterri allo spazioporto su <origin>, non trovi traccia di violenza: i capitani mercantili camminano liberamente, contrattano merci e parlano fra loro come in qualsiasi altro spazioporto tu abbia visitato. Tuttavia lo spazioporto è anche pattugliato da piccoli gruppi di alieni snelli, bipedi e dalla pelle chiara, che supponi siano i Pug. Ognuno tiene in mano un bastone di metallo: probabilmente una specie di arma.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2C: Side|	Soon after you land, you spot a man making his way towards your ship, ducking behind other ships and crates every time a group of Pug look in his direction. If he is some sort of fugitive from them, it might be unwise to throw your lot in with him. On the other hand, he could have valuable information for you.|1429|0
units.english: Soon after you land, you spot a man making his way towards your ship, ducking behind other ships and crates every time a group of Pug look in his direction. If he is some sort of fugitive from them, it might be unwise to throw your lot in with him. On the other hand, he could have valuable information for you.
units.italian: Poco dopo l'atterraggio, scorgi un uomo che si fa strada verso la tua nave, nascondendosi dietro altre navi e casse ogni volta che un gruppo di Pug guarda nella sua direzione. Se è una specie di fuggitivo, potrebbe essere poco saggio schierarti con lui. D'altra parte, potrebbe avere informazioni preziose per te.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2C: Side|	(Stay around and talk to him.)|1431|0
units.english: (Stay around and talk to him.)
units.italian: (Resta qui e parlagli.)

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2C: Side|	(Take off before I draw the Pug's attention.)|1432|0
units.english: (Take off before I draw the Pug's attention.)
units.italian: (Decolla prima di attirare l'attenzione dei Pug.)

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2C: Side|You open your ship's hatch and allow him to come on board. "You came from outside, didn't you?" he says. "Outside of occupied space, I mean." You nod.|1435|0
units.english: You open your ship's hatch and allow him to come on board. "You came from outside, didn't you?" he says. "Outside of occupied space, I mean." You nod.
units.italian: Apri il portello della nave e lo lasci salire. "Venite da fuori, vero?" dice. "Voglio dire, da fuori dello spazio occupato." Fai un cenno.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2C: Side|	"What's going on here?" asks Alondo. "Who are these aliens?"|1436|0
units.english: "What's going on here?" asks Alondo. "Who are these aliens?"
units.italian: "Che cosa succede qui?" chiede Alondo. "Chi sono questi alieni?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2C: Side|	"I'm a planet-dweller," he says, "so the first I heard of it was when these ships unlike anything I'd ever seen before came down out of the sky, and hovered over the spaceport. Then they began transmitting radio messages on all frequencies, saying that this world is now a part of the Pug Protectorate, and that we must refrain from violence and give them a portion of the goods our world produces."|1437|0
units.english: "I'm a planet-dweller," he says, "so the first I heard of it was when these ships unlike anything I'd ever seen before came down out of the sky, and hovered over the spaceport. Then they began transmitting radio messages on all frequencies, saying that this world is now a part of the Pug Protectorate, and that we must refrain from violence and give them a portion of the goods our world produces."
units.italian: "Sono uno che vive sul pianeta," dice, "quindi la prima volta che ne ho sentito parlare è stato quando queste navi diverse da qualsiasi cosa avessi mai visto sono scese dal cielo e si sono fermate sopra lo spazioporto. Poi hanno cominciato a trasmettere messaggi radio su tutte le frequenze, dicendo che questo mondo ora fa parte del Protettorato Pug, e che dobbiamo astenerci dalla violenza e consegnare loro una parte dei beni che il nostro mondo produce."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2C: Side|label|1438|0
units.english: planet dweller questions
units.italian: planet dweller questions

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2C: Side|	"Did anyone try to resist them?"|1444|0
units.english: "Did anyone try to resist them?"
units.italian: "Qualcuno ha provato a resistergli?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2C: Side|	"What do you think their intentions are?"|1448|0
units.english: "What do you think their intentions are?"
units.italian: "Che intenzioni pensi che abbiano?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2C: Side|	"Did they explain why they cut you off from the rest of the galaxy?"|1452|0
units.english: "Did they explain why they cut you off from the rest of the galaxy?"
units.italian: "Hanno spiegato perché vi hanno tagliato fuori dal resto della galassia?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2C: Side|	"A few. Their ships aren't invulnerable; a merchant in an Argosy managed to take out one of their smaller ships when it was landed with its shields down, before they blew his ship out of the air in retaliation. And those staffs they're carrying shoot some kind of stun ray, but if you cut them, they bleed, same as any other creature." He pauses, then taps the knife that is holstered at his belt and says, "Except, they bleed blue. Pale milky blue."|1460|0
units.english: "A few. Their ships aren't invulnerable; a merchant in an Argosy managed to take out one of their smaller ships when it was landed with its shields down, before they blew his ship out of the air in retaliation. And those staffs they're carrying shoot some kind of stun ray, but if you cut them, they bleed, same as any other creature." He pauses, then taps the knife that is holstered at his belt and says, "Except, they bleed blue. Pale milky blue."
units.italian: "Qualcuno. Le loro navi non sono invulnerabili; un mercante su un'Argosy è riuscito a mettere fuori uso una delle loro navi più piccole mentre era atterrata con gli scudi spenti, prima che gli facessero saltare la nave per rappresaglia. E quei bastoni che portano sparano una specie di raggio stordente, ma se li tagli sanguinano, come qualsiasi altra creatura." Si ferma, poi tocca il coltello che porta alla cintura e dice: "Solo che sanguinano blu. Un blu latteo pallido."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2C: Side|	"Well, they want our resources, of course. And, they say they have come to bring a new era of peace and an end to all violence and conflict.
