I don't buy it, though; they saw that humanity was too divided to resist them, and they seized the opportunity to invade and plunder us. It's that simple."|1466|0
units.english: "Well, they want our resources, of course. And, they say they have come to bring a new era of peace and an end to all violence and conflict. I don't buy it, though; they saw that humanity was too divided to resist them, and they seized the opportunity to invade and plunder us. It's that simple."
units.italian: "Beh, vogliono le nostre risorse, naturalmente. E dicono di essere venuti a portare una nuova era di pace e a mettere fine a ogni violenza e conflitto. Io però non ci credo; hanno visto che l'umanità era troppo divisa per resistergli, e hanno colto l'occasione per invaderci e depredarci. È semplice così."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2C: Side|	"I'd think that would be obvious. With the hyperspace links cut, there's no way for anyone from outside to assist us. And they struck at a part of human space without much in the way of militias or bounty hunters or Navy protection. And the few half-decent warships that happened to be in system when they attacked have already been destroyed trying to fight them."|1472|0
units.english: "I'd think that would be obvious. With the hyperspace links cut, there's no way for anyone from outside to assist us. And they struck at a part of human space without much in the way of militias or bounty hunters or Navy protection. And the few half-decent warships that happened to be in system when they attacked have already been destroyed trying to fight them."
units.italian: "Direi che è ovvio. Con i collegamenti iperspaziali tagliati, non c'è modo per nessuno da fuori di aiutarci. E hanno colpito una parte dello spazio umano senza granché in fatto di milizie, cacciatori di taglie o protezione della Marina. E le poche navi da guerra decenti che si trovavano nel sistema quando hanno attaccato sono già state distrutte nel tentativo di combatterli."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2C: Side|	"Where did they come from originally?" asks Alondo.|1476|0
units.english: "Where did they come from originally?" asks Alondo.
units.italian: "Da dove vengono, in origine?" chiede Alondo.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2C: Side|	"From a star system that was always a neighbor of ours, but wasn't linked to us or to any other part of human space. We always just assumed it was an uninhabited system, but it turns out they were there all along, biding their time, waiting for a good opportunity to attack us."|1477|0
units.english: "From a star system that was always a neighbor of ours, but wasn't linked to us or to any other part of human space. We always just assumed it was an uninhabited system, but it turns out they were there all along, biding their time, waiting for a good opportunity to attack us."
units.italian: "Da un sistema stellare che è sempre stato nostro vicino, ma non era collegato a noi né a nessun'altra parte dello spazio umano. Abbiamo sempre pensato che fosse un sistema disabitato, ma a quanto pare erano lì da sempre, in attesa del momento buono per attaccarci."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2C: Side|	"Well," says Alondo, "they didn't attack us when we jumped into this system. Perhaps we should go to their home system and see what they have to say for themselves."|1478|0
units.english: "Well," says Alondo, "they didn't attack us when we jumped into this system. Perhaps we should go to their home system and see what they have to say for themselves."
units.italian: "Beh," dice Alondo, "non ci hanno attaccato quando siamo saltati in questo sistema. Forse dovremmo andare nel loro sistema natale e vedere che cosa hanno da dire per giustificarsi."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 2C: Pugglequat|This planet is clearly one of the native Pug worlds, and not a human world that has been occupied. The architecture is entirely alien, and you see no human ships or people here, only the aliens. But, it appears to be mostly a world for mining and factories; all the aliens are busy with their work, and none seem to speak your language or have any interest in talking with you; instead they gesture towards the sky, perhaps as a way of indicating that you should visit the other Pug planet in this system.|1491|0
units.english: This planet is clearly one of the native Pug worlds, and not a human world that has been occupied. The architecture is entirely alien, and you see no human ships or people here, only the aliens. But, it appears to be mostly a world for mining and factories; all the aliens are busy with their work, and none seem to speak your language or have any interest in talking with you; instead they gesture towards the sky, perhaps as a way of indicating that you should visit the other Pug planet in this system.
units.italian: Questo pianeta è chiaramente uno dei mondi nativi dei Pug, e non un mondo umano occupato. L'architettura è del tutto aliena, e non vedi navi né persone umane qui, solo gli alieni. Ma sembra per lo più un mondo di miniere e fabbriche; tutti gli alieni sono impegnati nel loro lavoro, e nessuno sembra parlare la tua lingua o avere interesse a parlare con te; ti fanno invece cenno verso il cielo, forse per indicare che dovresti visitare l'altro pianeta Pug in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3|name|1497|0
units.english: Bring news to Earth
units.italian: Porta notizie sulla Terra

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3|description|1498|0
units.english: Now that you have met with the Pug, travel to Earth and explain the situation to Parliament, and send word to the Free Worlds as well, so you can decide how to respond.
units.italian: Ora che hai incontrato i Pug, va' sulla Terra e spiega la situazione al Parlamento, e manda parola anche alle Free Worlds, così potrete decidere come rispondere.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3|log|1512|0
units.english: Located the Pug homeworld, and met with some of them. They say that they have annexed the neighboring systems into the Pug Protectorate in order to stop the human civil war. However, their idea of bringing peace seems to involve conquering human space and replacing the Republic with their own government.
units.italian: Hai localizzato il mondo natale dei Pug e hai incontrato alcuni di loro. Dicono di aver annesso i sistemi vicini al Protettorato Pug per fermare la guerra civile umana. Tuttavia la loro idea di portare la pace sembra implicare conquistare lo spazio umano e sostituire la Repubblica con il proprio governo.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3|log|1513|0
units.english: The Pug are aliens with barrel-shaped bodies, spindly legs, and milky blue blood. They claim to have intervened in the human civil war purely for the sake of preventing more bloodshed and helping humans to live together in peace.
units.italian: I Pug sono alieni dal corpo a botte, gambe esili e sangue blu latteo. Sostengono di essere intervenuti nella guerra civile umana solo per impedire altro spargimento di sangue e aiutare gli umani a vivere insieme in pace.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3|This is an entirely alien world. The buildings have strangely flowing, tapered shapes not unlike the Pug starships, and from orbit you count dozens of large cities covering a large portion of the land mass. If this were a human world, you would estimate its population at over a billion. You follow one of the Pug ships that is landing, and discover a large spaceport where a surprising number of human merchant ships are parked, in addition to the aliens.|1515|0
units.english: This is an entirely alien world. The buildings have strangely flowing, tapered shapes not unlike the Pug starships, and from orbit you count dozens of large cities covering a large portion of the land mass. If this were a human world, you would estimate its population at over a billion. You follow one of the Pug ships that is landing, and discover a large spaceport where a surprising number of human merchant ships are parked, in addition to the aliens.
units.italian: Questo è un mondo interamente alieno. Gli edifici hanno forme stranamente fluide e affusolate, non dissimili dalle astronavi Pug, e dall'orbita conti dozzine di grandi città che coprono buona parte della massa continentale. Se fosse un mondo umano, stimeresti la sua popolazione in oltre un miliardo di abitanti. Segui una delle navi Pug che sta atterrando e scopri un grande spazioporto dove, oltre agli alieni, è parcheggiato un numero sorprendente di navi mercantili umane.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3|	Elsewhere they have mostly ignored you, but here your ship is quickly approached by a small group of the pale-skinned, delicate aliens. The Pug are oddly proportioned, with long arms and legs but short, barrel-shaped torsos and large heads, and although they only have two legs, their gait is vaguely insectoid. "You came from outside," one of them says. "You are not pledged to the Protectorate. Do you wish to make your vow of loyalty and peacefulness at this time?"|1516|0
units.english: Elsewhere they have mostly ignored you, but here your ship is quickly approached by a small group of the pale-skinned, delicate aliens. The Pug are oddly proportioned, with long arms and legs but short, barrel-shaped torsos and large heads, and although they only have two legs, their gait is vaguely insectoid. "You came from outside," one of them says. "You are not pledged to the Protectorate. Do you wish to make your vow of loyalty and peacefulness at this time?"
units.italian: Altrove ti hanno per lo più ignorato, ma qui la tua nave viene subito avvicinata da un piccolo gruppo di alieni delicati e dalla pelle chiara. I Pug hanno proporzioni curiose: braccia e gambe lunghe, ma torsi corti a botte e teste grandi, e anche se hanno solo due gambe il loro passo è vagamente insettico. "Voi venite da fuori," dice uno di loro. "Non siete vincolati al Protettorato. Volete pronunciare ora il vostro voto di lealtà e di pace?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3|	"No, we are here to find out why you attacked us, and to demand that you leave us alone."|1518|0
units.english: "No, we are here to find out why you attacked us, and to demand that you leave us alone."
units.italian: "No, siamo qui per scoprire perché ci avete attaccato, e per pretendere che ci lasciate in pace."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3|	"We are willing to make peace, but only if you give us back control of our star systems."|1519|0
units.english: "We are willing to make peace, but only if you give us back control of our star systems."
units.italian: "Siamo disposti a fare la pace, ma solo se ci restituite il controllo dei nostri sistemi stellari."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3|	"We have no wish to harm you," says the alien. "In time you will come to recognize that. We intervened in your war only to bring peace and to keep your species from doing great harm to itself. And we must maintain control of these systems until we are certain that you will not continue fighting if the links are restored."|1520|0
units.english: "We have no wish to harm you," says the alien. "In time you will come to recognize that. We intervened in your war only to bring peace and to keep your species from doing great harm to itself. And we must maintain control of these systems until we are certain that you will not continue fighting if the links are restored."
units.italian: "Non abbiamo alcun desiderio di farvi del male," dice l'alieno. "Col tempo lo riconoscerete. Siamo intervenuti nella vostra guerra solo per portare la pace e impedire alla vostra specie di fare un grande male a se stessa. E dobbiamo mantenere il controllo di questi sistemi finché non saremo certi che non continuerete a combattere se i collegamenti vengono ripristinati."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3|	"If you wish us no harm, why did you slaughter the Syndicate fleet?"|1522|0
units.english: "If you wish us no harm, why did you slaughter the Syndicate fleet?"
units.italian: "Se non volete farci del male, perché avete massacrato la flotta del Sindacato?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3|	"You have no business invading our space and interfering in our affairs, regardless of your intentions."|1523|0
units.english: "You have no business invading our space and interfering in our affairs, regardless of your intentions."
units.italian: "Non avevate alcun diritto di invadere il nostro spazio e di intromettervi nei nostri affari, qualunque fossero le vostre intenzioni."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3|	"The fleet that was carrying nuclear weapons, weapons of genocide? The fleet that, when we demanded their surrender, instead attacked us with those weapons? We offered them a place in the Protectorate, but they chose violence instead, and so they perished by violence. That is justice."|1526|0
units.english: "The fleet that was carrying nuclear weapons, weapons of genocide? The fleet that, when we demanded their surrender, instead attacked us with those weapons? We offered them a place in the Protectorate, but they chose violence instead, and so they perished by violence. That is justice."
units.italian: "La flotta che trasportava armi nucleari, armi di genocidio? La flotta che, quando abbiamo chiesto la resa, ci ha invece attaccato con quelle armi? Abbiamo offerto loro un posto nel Protettorato, ma hanno scelto la violenza, e quindi sono periti di violenza. Questa è giustizia."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3|	Alondo says, "I still don't understand what makes you think you have the right to interfere in human affairs."|1527|0
units.english: Alondo says, "I still don't understand what makes you think you have the right to interfere in human affairs."
units.italian: Alondo dice: "Continuo a non capire che cosa vi faccia pensare di avere il diritto di intromettervi negli affari umani."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3|	"'Interfere'?" says the alien. "We have 'interfered' many times before, and always you have benefited. If you do not believe us, ask those who live in the place you call the Deep. We helped them defeat the twisted half-human beings that you created in your foolish attempts to improve your race's genetic code. We have helped keep those creatures in check in the centuries since then. And we have helped in many other ways."|1530|0
units.english: "'Interfere'?" says the alien. "We have 'interfered' many times before, and always you have benefited. If you do not believe us, ask those who live in the place you call the Deep. We helped them defeat the twisted half-human beings that you created in your foolish attempts to improve your race's genetic code. We have helped keep those creatures in check in the centuries since then. And we have helped in many other ways."
units.italian: "'Intromettervi'?" dice l'alieno. "Ci siamo 'intromessi' molte volte in passato, e sempre ne avete tratto vantaggio. Se non ci credete, chiedete a quelli che vivono nel posto che chiamate Deep. Li abbiamo aiutati a sconfiggere le esseri metà umani e distorti che avete creato nei vostri sciocchi tentativi di migliorare il codice genetico della vostra specie. Li abbiamo aiutati a tenere a bada quelle creature nei secoli successivi. E abbiamo aiutato in molti altri modi."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3|	"I'm from the Deep, and I've never heard of you before."|1532|0
units.english: "I'm from the Deep, and I've never heard of you before."
units.italian: "Io vengo da Deep, e non ho mai sentito parlare di voi."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3|	"What do you want from us in return?"|1535|0
units.english: "What do you want from us in return?"
units.italian: "Che cosa volete da noi in cambio?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3|	"What are you planning to do with these systems you have occupied?"|1537|0
units.english: "What are you planning to do with these systems you have occupied?"
units.italian: "Che cosa avete intenzione di fare con questi sistemi che avete occupato?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3|	"Then perhaps you know of the myths of 'elves,' and of the tradition of tributation," says the alien. "We had been content with protecting your species from afar, letting your kind take our accomplishments as your own, but it is clear further intervention is necessary."|1539|0
units.english: "Then perhaps you know of the myths of 'elves,' and of the tradition of tributation," says the alien. "We had been content with protecting your species from afar, letting your kind take our accomplishments as your own, but it is clear further intervention is necessary."
units.italian: "Allora forse conoscerete i miti degli 'elfi', e la tradizione della tributazione," dice l'alieno. "Ci bastava proteggere la vostra specie da lontano, lasciando che la vostra gente prendesse i nostri successi come propri, ma è chiaro che serve un intervento ulteriore."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3|	Alondo asks, "And what is this 'further intervention?'"|1540|0
units.english: Alondo asks, "And what is this 'further intervention?'"
units.italian: Alondo chiede: "E in che cosa consiste questo 'intervento ulteriore'?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3|	"We have brought peace to this region," says the alien, "and we will continue to spread peace until violence has come to an end throughout human space. That is our only desire. All that we ask in return is a portion of the goods your worlds produce, to help offset the cost of watching over and protecting so many human worlds. And after some time, we will again allow human beings autonomous control of certain parts of your territory, when you show yourselves capable of living peacefully."|1542|0
units.english: "We have brought peace to this region," says the alien, "and we will continue to spread peace until violence has come to an end throughout human space. That is our only desire. All that we ask in return is a portion of the goods your worlds produce, to help offset the cost of watching over and protecting so many human worlds. And after some time, we will again allow human beings autonomous control of certain parts of your territory, when you show yourselves capable of living peacefully."
units.italian: "Abbiamo portato la pace in questa regione," dice l'alieno, "e continueremo a diffondere la pace finché la violenza non sarà finita in tutto lo spazio umano. È il nostro unico desiderio. Tutto quello che chiediamo in cambio è una parte dei beni che i vostri mondi producono, per aiutarci a sostenere il costo del sorvegliare e proteggere così tanti mondi umani. E dopo un po', permetteremo di nuovo agli esseri umani il controllo autonomo di alcune parti del vostro territorio, quando dimostrerete di essere capaci di vivere in pace."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3|	"By 'spreading peace,' do you mean occupying more systems?" asks Alondo.|1543|0
units.english: "By 'spreading peace,' do you mean occupying more systems?" asks Alondo.
units.italian: "Con 'diffondere la pace' intendete occupare altri sistemi?" chiede Alondo.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3|	"We mean bringing an end to your war and your divisions," the alien says. "Those of your worlds and your people who have shown themselves unable to live peacefully, we must govern, to teach them peace. Any who attack us, we must destroy, because we are the bringers of peace, and whoever attacks us is not on the side of peace. And so we will send you back to your people now, to tell them that they have nothing to fear, and that they should await our peace and our protection."|1544|0
units.english: "We mean bringing an end to your war and your divisions," the alien says. "Those of your worlds and your people who have shown themselves unable to live peacefully, we must govern, to teach them peace. Any who attack us, we must destroy, because we are the bringers of peace, and whoever attacks us is not on the side of peace. And so we will send you back to your people now, to tell them that they have nothing to fear, and that they should await our peace and our protection."
units.italian: "Intendiamo mettere fine alla vostra guerra e alle vostre divisioni," dice l'alieno. "Quei mondi e quei popoli che si sono dimostrati incapaci di vivere in pace li dobbiamo governare, per insegnare loro la pace. Chiunque ci attacchi lo dobbiamo distruggere, perché noi portiamo la pace, e chi ci attacca non è dalla parte della pace. E ora vi manderemo indietro dalla vostra gente, a dirle che non ha nulla da temere, e che deve attendere la nostra pace e la nostra protezione."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3|	The aliens appear to think the conversation is over; they walk away and leave you puzzling over what they said. "We should report back to Earth," says Alondo. "This situation is far beyond what we can handle alone."|1545|0
units.english: The aliens appear to think the conversation is over; they walk away and leave you puzzling over what they said. "We should report back to Earth," says Alondo. "This situation is far beyond what we can handle alone."
units.italian: Gli alieni sembrano ritenere conclusa la conversazione; se ne vanno e vi lasciano a rimuginare su quello che hanno detto. "Dovremmo riferire alla Terra," dice Alondo. "Questa situazione va ben oltre quello che possiamo gestire da soli."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3|dialog|1548|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Alondo hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Alondo non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Deep|name|1554|0
units.english: Visit the Deep (optional)
units.italian: Visita il Deep (facoltativa)

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Deep|description|1555|0
units.english: The Pug hinted that they have helped the people of the Deep in the past. Talk to Edrick, the governor of Valhalla, to see what he knows about the Pug. (This mission is optional.)
units.italian: I Pug hanno alluso al fatto di aver aiutato in passato la gente del Deep. Parla con Edrick, il governatore di Valhalla, per sapere che cosa sa dei Pug. (Questa missione è facoltativa.)

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Deep|log|1564|0
units.english: The governor of Valhalla, in the Deep, says that the Pug secretly assisted the people of the Deep to fight against the Alphas centuries ago, during the Alpha Wars. He thinks that the Pug have humanity's best interests at heart, but agrees that they can't be allowed to overthrow the Republic.
units.italian: Il governatore di Valhalla, nel Deep, dice che secoli fa, durante le Guerre Alpha, i Pug aiutarono in segreto la gente del Deep a combattere contro gli Alphas. Pensa che i Pug abbiano a cuore il bene dell'umanità, ma concorda che non si può permettere loro di rovesciare la Repubblica.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Deep|log|1565|0
units.english: It is possible that the Pug secretly assisted the humans of the Deep centuries ago by providing them with weapons that helped to turn the tide of the Alpha Wars.
units.italian: È possibile che i Pug abbiano aiutato in segreto gli umani del Deep secoli fa, fornendo loro armi che contribuirono a ribaltare le sorti delle Guerre Alpha.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Deep|As you are coming in for a landing, you contact Edrick Flint and see if he's available to talk. A few minutes later, you and Alondo are sitting with him in his office in the government center. "I assume you've heard about the alien invasion?" says Alondo. Edrick nods. "The aliens claimed that they had dealt with the Deep in the past. Do you know anything about that?"|1567|0
units.english: As you are coming in for a landing, you contact Edrick Flint and see if he's available to talk. A few minutes later, you and Alondo are sitting with him in his office in the government center. "I assume you've heard about the alien invasion?" says Alondo. Edrick nods. "The aliens claimed that they had dealt with the Deep in the past. Do you know anything about that?"
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini per atterrare, contatti Edrick Flint per vedere se è disponibile a parlare. Qualche minuto dopo, tu e Alondo siete seduti con lui nel suo ufficio al centro direzionale. "Immagino che abbiate sentito dell'invasione aliena?" dice Alondo. Edrick annuisce. "Gli alieni hanno sostenuto di aver avuto a che fare con il Deep in passato. Ne sapete qualcosa?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Deep|	Edrick says, "Can you describe what these aliens look like?"|1568|0
units.english: Edrick says, "Can you describe what these aliens look like?"
units.italian: Edrick dice: "Potete descrivermi che aspetto hanno questi alieni?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Deep|	"Pale skin, delicate physique, most of them a little under two meters tall," says Alondo. "Long legs, short torsos. And they probably have blue blood."|1569|0
units.english: "Pale skin, delicate physique, most of them a little under two meters tall," says Alondo. "Long legs, short torsos. And they probably have blue blood."
units.italian: "Pelle chiara, corporatura delicata, quasi tutti poco sotto i due metri," dice Alondo. "Gambe lunghe, torsi corti. E probabilmente hanno il sangue blu."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Deep|	Edrick pauses for several seconds, then says, "Yes, we had contact with a species that matches that description, back during the Alpha Wars. Some of the folk traditions about 'elves' that still persist here in the Deep are a result of those encounters."|1570|0
units.english: Edrick pauses for several seconds, then says, "Yes, we had contact with a species that matches that description, back during the Alpha Wars. Some of the folk traditions about 'elves' that still persist here in the Deep are a result of those encounters."
units.italian: Edrick resta in silenzio per qualche secondo, poi dice: "Sì, abbiamo avuto contatti con una specie che corrisponde a quella descrizione, ai tempi delle Guerre Alpha. Alcune delle tradizioni popolari sugli 'elfi' che ancora sopravvivono qui nel Deep sono il risultato di quegli incontri."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Deep|	"Do you know what they wanted from humanity, back then?"|1572|0
units.english: "Do you know what they wanted from humanity, back then?"
units.italian: "Sapete che cosa volevano dall'umanità, allora?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Deep|	"What strengths and weaknesses do their ships have?"|1573|0
units.english: "What strengths and weaknesses do their ships have?"
units.italian: "Che punti di forza e che debolezze hanno le loro navi?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Deep|	"If the stories are true, all they wanted was to help us win the war against the Alphas," says Edrick. "They never asked for any payment, except that they borrowed some of our ships, packed them full of alien technology, and fought alongside our ships, masquerading as human ships. They also gave us beam weapon technology; five centuries later, we've only just reached the point where we understand that technology well enough to improve on it."|1576|0
units.english: "If the stories are true, all they wanted was to help us win the war against the Alphas," says Edrick. "They never asked for any payment, except that they borrowed some of our ships, packed them full of alien technology, and fought alongside our ships, masquerading as human ships. They also gave us beam weapon technology; five centuries later, we've only just reached the point where we understand that technology well enough to improve on it."
units.italian: "Se le storie sono vere, volevano solo aiutarci a vincere la guerra contro gli Alphas," dice Edrick. "Non hanno mai chiesto alcun pagamento, se non che gli prestassimo alcune delle nostre navi, che riempirono di tecnologia aliena, e che combattessero al fianco delle nostre navi fingendo di essere navi umane. Ci hanno anche dato la tecnologia delle armi a fascio; cinque secoli dopo, siamo appena arrivati al punto di capirla abbastanza da migliorarla."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Deep|	"What do you know about their warships?" asks Alondo.|1577|0
units.english: "What do you know about their warships?" asks Alondo.
units.italian: "Che cosa sai delle loro navi da guerra?" chiede Alondo.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Deep|	"I know that they had a technology that allowed their shields to recharge very quickly," says Edrick. "So to destroy one of their ships would require a considerable amount of concentrated firepower. But are you sure we need to fight them? My people have believed for generations that the 'elven folk' were a friendly species, not a hostile one."|1580|0
units.english: "I know that they had a technology that allowed their shields to recharge very quickly," says Edrick. "So to destroy one of their ships would require a considerable amount of concentrated firepower. But are you sure we need to fight them? My people have believed for generations that the 'elven folk' were a friendly species, not a hostile one."
units.italian: "So che avevano una tecnologia che permetteva ai loro scudi di ricaricarsi molto rapidamente," dice Edrick. "Quindi per distruggere una delle loro navi serve una quantità notevole di fuoco concentrato. Ma siete sicuri di doverli combattere? La mia gente crede da generazioni che la 'gente elfica' fosse una specie amica, non ostile."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Deep|	"They seem intent on taking over all of human space and forcing us to submit to their authority. So we must fight them."|1582|0
units.english: "They seem intent on taking over all of human space and forcing us to submit to their authority. So we must fight them."
units.italian: "Sembrano intenzionati a impadronirsi di tutto lo spazio umano e a costringerci a sottometterci alla loro autorità. Quindi dobbiamo combatterli."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Deep|	"It's possible that they think they are helping us right now, by interrupting our civil war, but all the same we must fight back."|1583|0
units.english: "It's possible that they think they are helping us right now, by interrupting our civil war, but all the same we must fight back."
units.italian: "È possibile che pensino di aiutarci in questo momento, interrompendo la nostra guerra civile, ma dobbiamo reagire comunque."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Deep|	Edrick looks disappointed at that. "I understand. I believe that they honestly think they are doing what is best for us, but clearly we cannot tolerate this invasion. Good luck, Captain." He dismisses you.|1584|0
units.english: Edrick looks disappointed at that. "I understand. I believe that they honestly think they are doing what is best for us, but clearly we cannot tolerate this invasion. Good luck, Captain." He dismisses you.
units.italian: Edrick sembra deluso da quella risposta. "Capisco. Credo che pensino davvero di fare il nostro bene, ma è chiaro che non possiamo tollerare questa invasione. Buona fortuna, Capitano." Vi congeda.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Quarg|name|1590|0
units.english: Visit the Quarg (optional)
units.italian: Visita i Quarg (facoltativa)

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Quarg|description|1591|0
units.english: Visit the Quarg on <planet> to see if they know anything about the Pug or are willing to help you fight them. (This mission is optional.)
units.italian: Visita i Quarg su <planet> per vedere se sanno qualcosa dei Pug o se sono disposti ad aiutarvi a combatterli. (Questa missione è facoltativa.)

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Quarg|log|1600|0
units.english: Learned from the Quarg that they have long been aware of the presence of the Pug in the Deneb system. Apparently the Pug are from another galaxy and possess such advanced technology that even the Quarg do not dare to interfere with them.
units.italian: Hai saputo dai Quarg che sono consapevoli da molto tempo della presenza dei Pug nel sistema Deneb. A quanto pare i Pug vengono da un'altra galassia e possiedono una tecnologia così avanzata che nemmeno i Quarg osano interferire con loro.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Quarg|log|1601|0
units.english: However, the Pug are known to treat warfare like a game, intentionally using weaker technology when fighting less advanced species in order to give them a fair chance at winning the battle. So, fighting them will not be a lost cause, but the Quarg are unwilling to provide any assistance.
units.italian: Tuttavia, è noto che i Pug trattano la guerra come un gioco, usando intenzionalmente tecnologia più debole quando combattono specie meno avanzate, per dare loro una possibilità equa di vincere la battaglia. Quindi combatterli non sarà una causa persa, ma i Quarg non sono disposti a fornire alcun aiuto.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Quarg|log|1602|0
units.english: The Quarg claim that the Pug treat warfare like a game. When battling another species, the Pug will limit themselves to ships and weapons that are weak enough that the other species has a chance of defeating them.
units.italian: I Quarg sostengono che i Pug trattano la guerra come un gioco. Quando combattono un'altra specie, i Pug si limitano a navi e armi abbastanza deboli perché l'altra specie abbia una possibilità di sconfiggerli.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Quarg|When you land on the station, Alondo says, "From what I understand of Quarg diplomacy, we're just supposed to ask any one of them to direct us to someone who can answer our questions." He walks up to a Quarg who is standing near your docking bay and says, "Excuse me, can you lead us to someone we can talk to?"|1604|0
units.english: When you land on the station, Alondo says, "From what I understand of Quarg diplomacy, we're just supposed to ask any one of them to direct us to someone who can answer our questions." He walks up to a Quarg who is standing near your docking bay and says, "Excuse me, can you lead us to someone we can talk to?"
units.italian: Quando atterrate sulla stazione, Alondo dice: "Da quello che ho capito della diplomazia dei Quarg, dobbiamo solo chiedere a uno di loro di indicarci qualcuno che possa rispondere alle nostre domande." Si avvicina a un Quarg che sta vicino alla vostra banchina di attracco e dice: "Scusate, potete portarci da qualcuno con cui parlare?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Quarg|	It nods and gestures for you to follow, and leads you to a nook in one of the main hallways, where another Quarg stands behind a desk. You are struck by how little you know about this species: are you speaking to a tour guide, or to a diplomat? Were you led to this individual because this is the governor of the station, or just because this is one who speaks human languages? The Quarg behind the desk says, "Do you have questions for me?"|1605|0
units.english: It nods and gestures for you to follow, and leads you to a nook in one of the main hallways, where another Quarg stands behind a desk. You are struck by how little you know about this species: are you speaking to a tour guide, or to a diplomat? Were you led to this individual because this is the governor of the station, or just because this is one who speaks human languages? The Quarg behind the desk says, "Do you have questions for me?"
units.italian: Annuisce e vi fa cenno di seguirlo, guidandovi in un angolo di uno dei corridoi principali, dove un altro Quarg sta dietro una scrivania. Ti colpisce quanto poco sappiate di questa specie: stai parlando con una guida turistica, o con un diplomatico? Ti hanno portato da questo individuo perché è il governatore della stazione, o solo perché è uno che parla le lingue umane? Il Quarg dietro la scrivania dice: "Avete domande per me?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Quarg|	"Can you help us to fight the Pug?"|1607|0
units.english: "Can you help us to fight the Pug?"
units.italian: "Potete aiutarci a combattere i Pug?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Quarg|	"Can you give us information about the Pug?"|1608|0
units.english: "Can you give us information about the Pug?"
units.italian: "Potete darci informazioni sui Pug?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Quarg|	"No," it says. Several stripes of skin on its gray face turn a dull red; you have heard that this might indicate sadness, or embarrassment, or possibly anger - one more thing about the Quarg that no one understands well. "Long ago we tried to resist the Pug," it says. "In retribution, they broke one of our rings." It points out the window of the station at the half-finished ringworld. "This ring is half complete, and it has taken a thousand of your years to build. The rings are our most precious creations, nearly impossible to destroy, but the Pug know how to twist and cut the fabric of space itself."|1611|0
units.english: "No," it says. Several stripes of skin on its gray face turn a dull red; you have heard that this might indicate sadness, or embarrassment, or possibly anger - one more thing about the Quarg that no one understands well. "Long ago we tried to resist the Pug," it says. "In retribution, they broke one of our rings." It points out the window of the station at the half-finished ringworld. "This ring is half complete, and it has taken a thousand of your years to build. The rings are our most precious creations, nearly impossible to destroy, but the Pug know how to twist and cut the fabric of space itself."
units.italian: "No," dice. Diverse strisce di pelle sul suo volto grigio diventano di un rosso spento; hai sentito che questo potrebbe indicare tristezza, o imbarazzo, o forse rabbia: un'altra cosa dei Quarg che nessuno capisce bene. "Molto tempo fa abbiamo provato a resistere ai Pug," dice. "Per rappresaglia hanno spezzato uno dei nostri anelli." Indica dalla finestra della stazione il mondo ad anello mezzo finito. "Questo anello è completo a metà, e ci sono voluti mille dei vostri anni per costruirlo. Gli anelli sono le nostre creazioni più preziose, quasi impossibili da distruggere, ma i Pug sanno come torcere e tagliare il tessuto dello spazio stesso."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Quarg|	"So you've encountered the Pug before?" asks Alondo.|1612|0
units.english: "So you've encountered the Pug before?" asks Alondo.
units.italian: "Quindi avete già incontrato i Pug?" chiede Alondo.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Quarg|	The Quarg is silent for a long moment. "The Pug have meddled with the affairs of many species in this galaxy," it says, "but they are not native to it. They came here through artificial wormholes: a technology that not even the Drak possess. Their actions are unpredictable. They claim to be acting on a special knowledge of future events, but we do not know if that knowledge is genuine or only an excuse to play tricks on other species."|1615|0
units.english: The Quarg is silent for a long moment. "The Pug have meddled with the affairs of many species in this galaxy," it says, "but they are not native to it. They came here through artificial wormholes: a technology that not even the Drak possess. Their actions are unpredictable. They claim to be acting on a special knowledge of future events, but we do not know if that knowledge is genuine or only an excuse to play tricks on other species."
units.italian: Il Quarg resta in silenzio a lungo. "I Pug si sono intromessi negli affari di molte specie di questa galassia," dice, "ma non sono nativi di qui. Sono arrivati per mezzo di wormhole artificiali: una tecnologia che nemmeno i Drak possiedono. Le loro azioni sono imprevedibili. Sostengono di agire secondo una conoscenza speciale degli eventi futuri, ma non sappiamo se quella conoscenza sia autentica o solo una scusa per giocare tiri ad altre specie."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Quarg|	"If they're so advanced, do we have any chance of defeating them?"|1617|0
units.english: "If they're so advanced, do we have any chance of defeating them?"
units.italian: "Se sono così avanzati, abbiamo qualche possibilità di sconfiggerli?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Quarg|	"Do you think the Drak would join us in fighting them?"|1619|0
units.english: "Do you think the Drak would join us in fighting them?"
units.italian: "Pensi che i Drak si unirebbero a noi per combatterli?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Quarg|	"Yes," it says. "In battle the Pug always respond with just enough force that their opponent has a fair chance at victory."|1623|0
units.english: "Yes," it says. "In battle the Pug always respond with just enough force that their opponent has a fair chance at victory."
units.italian: "Sì," dice. "In battaglia i Pug rispondono sempre con la forza appena sufficiente perché il loro avversario abbia una possibilità equa di vittoria."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Quarg|	Alondo is confused. "What do you mean?" he asks.|1624|0
units.english: Alondo is confused. "What do you mean?" he asks.
units.italian: Alondo è confuso. "Che cosa vuoi dire?" chiede.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Quarg|	"No," it says. "The Drak do not interfere in a war unless their rules are broken. And, it would not help you anyway; the Pug always adjust the strength of their fleet to give their opponent what they consider to be fair odds."|1628|0
units.english: "No," it says. "The Drak do not interfere in a war unless their rules are broken. And, it would not help you anyway; the Pug always adjust the strength of their fleet to give their opponent what they consider to be fair odds."
units.italian: "No," dice. "I Drak non interferiscono in una guerra, a meno che le loro regole non vengano infrante. E comunque non vi aiuterebbe; i Pug regolano sempre la forza della loro flotta per dare all'avversario quelle che considerano possibilità eque."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Quarg|	"Wait," says Alondo, "you're saying they would intentionally attack us with a weaker force instead of using all their strength and guaranteeing victory?"|1629|0
units.english: "Wait," says Alondo, "you're saying they would intentionally attack us with a weaker force instead of using all their strength and guaranteeing victory?"
units.italian: "Aspetta," dice Alondo, "stai dicendo che ci attaccherebbero intenzionalmente con una forza più debole invece di usare tutta la loro potenza e garantirsi la vittoria?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Quarg|	"War is a game to the Pug," the Quarg says. "They are a strange species. Even if they start a war, their goal may not be to win it, but to lose in a certain way. We have seen them lose battles against species far less advanced than your own, even though they had weapons that would have guaranteed them victory. If they want war, you must play their game, and if you play their game, they may allow you to win."|1633|0
units.english: "War is a game to the Pug," the Quarg says. "They are a strange species. Even if they start a war, their goal may not be to win it, but to lose in a certain way. We have seen them lose battles against species far less advanced than your own, even though they had weapons that would have guaranteed them victory. If they want war, you must play their game, and if you play their game, they may allow you to win."
units.italian: "La guerra è un gioco per i Pug," dice il Quarg. "Sono una specie strana. Anche quando iniziano una guerra, il loro scopo può non essere vincerla, ma perderla in un certo modo. Li abbiamo visti perdere battaglie contro specie molto meno avanzate della vostra, anche se avevano armi che avrebbero garantito loro la vittoria. Se vogliono la guerra, dovete giocare al loro gioco, e se giocate al loro gioco, potrebbero permettervi di vincere."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Quarg|	"That makes no sense," says Alondo. "They would die for the sake of a game?"|1634|0
units.english: "That makes no sense," says Alondo. "They would die for the sake of a game?"
units.italian: "Non ha alcun senso," dice Alondo. "Morirebbero per il bene di un gioco?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Quarg|	The Quarg pauses for a moment as if struggling for words. "I am myself, and also I am Quarg. You are yourselves, and also you are human. But we think perhaps a Pug is Pug first, and then also itself."|1635|0
units.english: The Quarg pauses for a moment as if struggling for words. "I am myself, and also I am Quarg. You are yourselves, and also you are human. But we think perhaps a Pug is Pug first, and then also itself."
units.italian: Il Quarg resta in silenzio un momento, come se cercasse le parole. "Io sono me stesso, e sono anche Quarg. Voi siete voi stessi, e siete anche umani. Ma pensiamo che forse un Pug è Pug prima, e poi anche se stesso."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Quarg|	"Their identity is communal, rather than individual?" says Alondo.|1636|0
units.english: "Their identity is communal, rather than individual?" says Alondo.
units.italian: "La loro identità è comunitaria, non individuale?" dice Alondo.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Quarg|	"Indeed. And because they are so deeply connected, they perceive all things as being connected to them. At least, that is the best understanding we have been able to gain of their species."|1637|0
units.english: "Indeed. And because they are so deeply connected, they perceive all things as being connected to them. At least, that is the best understanding we have been able to gain of their species."
units.italian: "Esatto. E poiché sono così profondamente connessi, percepiscono tutte le cose come connesse a loro. Almeno, è la migliore comprensione che siamo riusciti a raggiungere della loro specie."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Quarg|	"Thank you for your time."|1639|0
units.english: "Thank you for your time."
units.italian: "Grazie per il tempo che ci avete dedicato."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Quarg|	"Is there any chance you could give us some jump drives, so we can bring a bigger fleet against the Pug?"|1641|0
units.english: "Is there any chance you could give us some jump drives, so we can bring a bigger fleet against the Pug?"
units.italian: "C'è qualche possibilità che possiate darci dei motori di salto, così da poter portare contro i Pug una flotta più grande?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3: Quarg|	"No, I apologize," it says. "We see that you have somehow gained access to a jump drive, and we will not take it away from you, but we also cannot give your species more of them."|1643|0
units.english: "No, I apologize," it says. "We see that you have somehow gained access to a jump drive, and we will not take it away from you, but we also cannot give your species more of them."
units.italian: "No, mi scuso," dice. "Vediamo che siete riusciti in qualche modo a procurarvi un motore di salto, e non ve lo toglieremo, ma non possiamo nemmeno darne altri alla vostra specie."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3A|name|1650|0
units.english: Gather the fleet
units.italian: Raduna la flotta

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3A|description|1651|0
units.english: Travel to <destination> and requisition two Free Worlds Dreadnoughts to join in the battle against the Pug. (But if you want to visit the Quarg or the Deep, do that first.)
units.italian: Recati su <destination> e requisisci due Dreadnought delle Free Worlds perché si uniscano alla battaglia contro i Pug. (Ma se vuoi visitare i Quarg o il Deep, fallo prima.)

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3A|Your ship caused quite a stir when it entered the Sol system via jump drive. Fortunately Parliament allowed you to land in one of their private hangars, but even so a few press drones managed to follow your ship into the hangar and have cameras pointed at you from the moment you and Alondo disembark.|1663|0
units.english: Your ship caused quite a stir when it entered the Sol system via jump drive. Fortunately Parliament allowed you to land in one of their private hangars, but even so a few press drones managed to follow your ship into the hangar and have cameras pointed at you from the moment you and Alondo disembark.
units.italian: La tua nave ha fatto un certo scalpore quando è entrata nel sistema Sol col motore di salto. Per fortuna il Parlamento ti ha permesso di atterrare in uno dei suoi hangar privati, ma anche così alcuni droni della stampa sono riusciti a seguire la nave nell'hangar e hanno le telecamere puntate su di te dal momento in cui tu e Alondo sbarcate.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3A|	You report to Parliament that the hyperspace links are being cut not by the Syndicate, but by an alien species, and that the Syndicate has offered to supply jump drives for an attack fleet if the Republic and the Free Worlds will supply the ships. You also report that the aliens' intention is to spread out to occupy more of human space and to demand a fraction of the resource production of all human planets, supposedly in the name of bringing "peace."|1664|0
units.english: You report to Parliament that the hyperspace links are being cut not by the Syndicate, but by an alien species, and that the Syndicate has offered to supply jump drives for an attack fleet if the Republic and the Free Worlds will supply the ships. You also report that the aliens' intention is to spread out to occupy more of human space and to demand a fraction of the resource production of all human planets, supposedly in the name of bringing "peace."
units.italian: Riferisci al Parlamento che i collegamenti iperspaziali non vengono recisi dal Sindacato, ma da una specie aliena, e che il Sindacato ha offerto di fornire motori di salto per una flotta d'attacco se la Repubblica e le Free Worlds forniranno le navi. Riferisci anche che l'intenzione degli alieni è espandersi per occupare altro spazio umano e pretendere una frazione della produzione di risorse di tutti i pianeti umani, presumibilmente in nome della "pace".

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3A|	One of the senators asks, "Do you think we have any chance of defeating the aliens?"|1665|0
units.english: One of the senators asks, "Do you think we have any chance of defeating the aliens?"
units.italian: Uno dei senatori chiede: "Pensi che abbiamo qualche possibilità di sconfiggere gli alieni?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3A|	"It's possible. They all live in a single star system, so we outnumber them."|1667|0
units.english: "It's possible. They all live in a single star system, so we outnumber them."
units.italian: "È possibile. Vivono tutti in un solo sistema stellare, quindi siamo più numerosi."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3A|	"It's unlikely. If we have any options other than fighting them, we should explore those options."|1669|0
units.english: "It's unlikely. If we have any options other than fighting them, we should explore those options."
units.italian: "È improbabile. Se abbiamo altre opzioni oltre a combatterli, dovremmo esplorarle."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3A|	"I think we have no choice," says one of the older members. "Even if it is a losing battle, we can't let the human race be enslaved without a fight."|1670|0
units.english: "I think we have no choice," says one of the older members. "Even if it is a losing battle, we can't let the human race be enslaved without a fight."
units.italian: "Credo che non abbiamo scelta," dice uno dei membri più anziani. "Anche se fosse una battaglia persa, non possiamo lasciare che la razza umana venga ridotta in schiavitù senza combattere."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3A|	They have many other questions after that; you answer them as best you can, and leave them with full copies of your sensor logs of the alien ships and planets. Parliament agrees that the next step is for you to convince the Free Worlds to contribute two Dreadnoughts to the attack fleet. "Also," one of the members of Parliament says, "maybe you could talk to those aliens who live down in your part of space, see if they can help us out in any way. It sure would be handy if the Pug turn out to be an enemy of theirs."|1672|0
units.english: They have many other questions after that; you answer them as best you can, and leave them with full copies of your sensor logs of the alien ships and planets. Parliament agrees that the next step is for you to convince the Free Worlds to contribute two Dreadnoughts to the attack fleet. "Also," one of the members of Parliament says, "maybe you could talk to those aliens who live down in your part of space, see if they can help us out in any way. It sure would be handy if the Pug turn out to be an enemy of theirs."
units.italian: Dopo di che hanno molte altre domande; rispondi come meglio puoi e li lasci con copie complete dei registri dei tuoi sensori sulle navi e sui pianeti alieni. Il Parlamento concorda che il passo successivo è che tu convinca le Free Worlds a contribuire con due Dreadnought alla flotta d'attacco. "Inoltre," dice uno dei membri del Parlamento, "magari potresti parlare con quegli alieni che vivono giù nella vostra parte di spazio, vedere se possono aiutarci in qualche modo. Sarebbe comodo se i Pug si rivelassero un loro nemico."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3A|	During the hearing, you refrained from mentioning that the Pug claimed to have assisted the Deep in the past, but once you are back in your ship Alondo says, "Maybe we should also visit Valhalla and see if Governor Flint has any information for us."|1673|0
units.english: During the hearing, you refrained from mentioning that the Pug claimed to have assisted the Deep in the past, but once you are back in your ship Alondo says, "Maybe we should also visit Valhalla and see if Governor Flint has any information for us."
units.italian: Durante l'udienza hai evitato di menzionare che i Pug sostengono di aver aiutato il Deep in passato, ma una volta tornato sulla tua nave Alondo dice: "Magari dovremmo visitare anche Valhalla e vedere se il governatore Flint ha qualche informazione per noi."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3A|dialog|1676|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Alondo hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Alondo non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3B|name|1682|0
units.english: Escort to <planet>
units.italian: Scorta per <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3B|description|1683|0
units.english: Travel to <planet> with two Free Worlds Dreadnoughts that will be joining the fight against the Pug.
units.italian: Recati su <planet> con due Dreadnought delle Free Worlds che si uniranno alla lotta contro i Pug.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3B|Freya meets you soon after you land. "I've heard the news," she says. "I talked to the Senate, and they think that I should travel with you during your assault on the Pug, in case I can help figure out their technology, maybe even how to restore the hyperspace links. And they say they need Alondo back here to do diplomatic visits and help keep people from panicking."|1697|0
units.english: Freya meets you soon after you land. "I've heard the news," she says. "I talked to the Senate, and they think that I should travel with you during your assault on the Pug, in case I can help figure out their technology, maybe even how to restore the hyperspace links. And they say they need Alondo back here to do diplomatic visits and help keep people from panicking."
units.italian: Freya ti incontra poco dopo l'atterraggio. "Ho saputo la notizia," dice. "Ho parlato con il Senato, e pensano che dovrei viaggiare con te durante l'assalto ai Pug, nel caso possa aiutare a capire la loro tecnologia, magari anche come ripristinare i collegamenti iperspaziali. E dicono che hanno bisogno che Alondo torni qui a fare visite diplomatiche e ad aiutare a impedire che la gente vada nel panico."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3B|	"I guess that makes sense," says Alondo.|1698|0
units.english: "I guess that makes sense," says Alondo.
units.italian: "Immagino che abbia senso," dice Alondo.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3B|	"Also," says Freya, "the Senate approved a raise for you, <first>. Your new salary will be seventeen thousand credits a day. I hope that means you'll be able to go into battle against the Pug with the strongest ship possible, because I suspect we'll need all the firepower we can get."|1699|0
units.english: "Also," says Freya, "the Senate approved a raise for you, <first>. Your new salary will be seventeen thousand credits a day. I hope that means you'll be able to go into battle against the Pug with the strongest ship possible, because I suspect we'll need all the firepower we can get."
units.italian: "Inoltre," dice Freya, "il Senato ha approvato un aumento per te, <first>. Il tuo nuovo stipendio sarà di diciassettemila crediti al giorno. Spero che questo significhi che potrai andare in battaglia contro i Pug con la nave più forte possibile, perché sospetto che ci servirà tutta la potenza di fuoco che riusciremo a mettere insieme."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3B|	Alondo wishes you the best of luck and leaves to catch a transport to Bourne, while Freya takes you to the spaceport and introduces you to the captains of the two Dreadnoughts that have volunteered to fight the Pug. She also asks you all sorts of technical questions: what sort of propulsion and energy sources the Pug seem to use, what their weapon capabilities are, and whether you saw any sign of the technology that was used to destroy the hyperspace links. You have a hard time answering her, but are glad that she will be with you this time to see the aliens firsthand.|1700|0
units.english: Alondo wishes you the best of luck and leaves to catch a transport to Bourne, while Freya takes you to the spaceport and introduces you to the captains of the two Dreadnoughts that have volunteered to fight the Pug. She also asks you all sorts of technical questions: what sort of propulsion and energy sources the Pug seem to use, what their weapon capabilities are, and whether you saw any sign of the technology that was used to destroy the hyperspace links. You have a hard time answering her, but are glad that she will be with you this time to see the aliens firsthand.
units.italian: Alondo ti augura ogni bene e parte per prendere un trasporto per Bourne, mentre Freya ti porta allo spazioporto e ti presenta i capitani dei due Dreadnought che si sono offerti volontari per combattere i Pug. Ti fa anche domande tecniche di ogni genere: che tipo di propulsione e di fonti di energia sembrano usare i Pug, quali sono le capacità delle loro armi, e se hai visto qualche segno della tecnologia usata per distruggere i collegamenti iperspaziali. Fatichi a risponderle, ma sei contento che questa volta sia con te a vedere gli alieni di persona.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3B|dialog|1711|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but the dreadnoughts are lagging behind you because they are using ordinary hyperdrives. Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma i Dreadnought sono rimasti indietro perché usano iperpropulsori normali. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivino in questo sistema.

units.id: conversation:fw pug|You land at the Republic Navy Yard on Geminus escorting the two Dreadnoughts that are the Free Worlds contribution to the war against the Pug. You are met by the shipyard supervisor and a team of engineers who are preparing the Navy ships to join you. "So, these are your Dreadnoughts," one of them says. "I'm glad to finally have the chance to see one up close. I don't suppose one of the captains would be willing to give me a tour."|1716|0
units.english: You land at the Republic Navy Yard on Geminus escorting the two Dreadnoughts that are the Free Worlds contribution to the war against the Pug. You are met by the shipyard supervisor and a team of engineers who are preparing the Navy ships to join you. "So, these are your Dreadnoughts," one of them says. "I'm glad to finally have the chance to see one up close. I don't suppose one of the captains would be willing to give me a tour."
units.italian: Atterri al Cantiere della Marina della Repubblica su Geminus scortando i due Dreadnought che sono il contributo delle Free Worlds alla guerra contro i Pug. Ti accolgono il supervisore del cantiere e una squadra di ingegneri che stanno preparando le navi della Marina a unirsi a voi. "Quindi questi sono i vostri Dreadnought," dice uno di loro. "Sono contento di avere finalmente l'occasione di vederne uno da vicino. Non suppongo che uno dei capitani sarebbe disposto a farmi fare un giro."

units.id: conversation:fw pug|	"Um, we're right in the middle of resisting an alien invasion, here."|1718|0
units.english: "Um, we're right in the middle of resisting an alien invasion, here."
units.italian: "Ehm, siamo nel bel mezzo di resistere a un'invasione aliena, qui."

units.id: conversation:fw pug|	"Sorry, we aren't authorized to share military secrets with you."|1719|0
units.english: "Sorry, we aren't authorized to share military secrets with you."
units.italian: "Scusa, non siamo autorizzati a condividere segreti militari con voi."

units.id: conversation:fw pug|	"Sure, I'm sure we could arrange something."|1720|0
units.english: "Sure, I'm sure we could arrange something."
units.italian: "Certo, sono sicuro che possiamo organizzare qualcosa."

units.id: conversation:fw pug|	Freya laughs. "Give him a break, <first>. He's just thinking like an engineer, rather than a tactician. I mean, I'd certainly jump at the chance to tour a Cruiser even at a time like this."|1723|0
units.english: Freya laughs. "Give him a break, <first>. He's just thinking like an engineer, rather than a tactician. I mean, I'd certainly jump at the chance to tour a Cruiser even at a time like this."
units.italian: Freya ride. "Dagli tregua, <first>. Sta solo pensando da ingegnere, non da tattico. Voglio dire, anch'io coglierei al volo l'occasione di visitare un incrociatore anche in un momento come questo."

units.id: conversation:fw pug|	The supervisor seems irked that his engineers are more interested in exploring nifty new ship technology than in the task at hand, but he grudgingly offers to give you a tour of the Navy Yard in exchange for letting his engineers take a closer look at the Dreadnoughts. Freya whispers to you, "Just think of this as another step toward peace and reconciliation."|1726|0
units.english: The supervisor seems irked that his engineers are more interested in exploring nifty new ship technology than in the task at hand, but he grudgingly offers to give you a tour of the Navy Yard in exchange for letting his engineers take a closer look at the Dreadnoughts. Freya whispers to you, "Just think of this as another step toward peace and reconciliation."
units.italian: Il supervisore sembra irritato dal fatto che i suoi ingegneri siano più interessati a esplorare la bella tecnologia delle navi nuove che al compito da svolgere, ma di malavoglia offre di farvi fare un giro del Cantiere della Marina in cambio del permesso ai suoi ingegneri di dare un'occhiata più da vicino ai Dreadnought. Freya ti sussurra: "Consideralo un altro passo verso la pace e la riconciliazione."

units.id: conversation:fw pug|	The new shipyard is some distance away from the old one, which is still in ruins, a radioactive crater a few kilometers away from the spaceport. "The attack happened at night," says the supervisor. "Three hundred and forty-seven people were killed. If the attack had been during working hours, that number would have been in the thousands. We're recovering some metal from the old shipyard, but other than that it's a total loss. The radiation is slowly dying down, though."|1727|0
units.english: The new shipyard is some distance away from the old one, which is still in ruins, a radioactive crater a few kilometers away from the spaceport. "The attack happened at night," says the supervisor. "Three hundred and forty-seven people were killed. If the attack had been during working hours, that number would have been in the thousands. We're recovering some metal from the old shipyard, but other than that it's a total loss. The radiation is slowly dying down, though."
units.italian: Il nuovo cantiere è a una certa distanza dal vecchio, che è ancora in rovina, un cratere radioattivo a qualche chilometro dallo spazioporto. "L'attacco è avvenuto di notte," dice il supervisore. "Sono morte trecentoquarantasette persone. Se l'attacco fosse stato durante l'orario di lavoro, quel numero sarebbe stato nell'ordine delle migliaia. Stiamo recuperando un po' di metallo dal vecchio cantiere, ma a parte questo è una perdita totale. Le radiazioni stanno lentamente calando, però."

units.id: conversation:fw pug|	There is deep anger in his voice as he speaks. You are glad that the Free Worlds have been proved innocent of involvement in the attack, but you suspect that on the worlds that were bombed, most people will not accept peace with the Syndicate on any terms except the full surrender of all the Syndicate personnel who were responsible.|1728|0
units.english: There is deep anger in his voice as he speaks. You are glad that the Free Worlds have been proved innocent of involvement in the attack, but you suspect that on the worlds that were bombed, most people will not accept peace with the Syndicate on any terms except the full surrender of all the Syndicate personnel who were responsible.
units.italian: C'è una rabbia profonda nella sua voce mentre parla. Sei contento che le Free Worlds siano state dimostrate innocenti da qualsiasi coinvolgimento nell'attacco, ma sospetti che sui mondi bombardati la maggior parte della gente non accetterà la pace con il Sindacato a nessuna condizione, se non la resa completa di tutto il personale del Sindacato che ne era responsabile.

units.id: conversation:fw pug|	When they're done giving you the tour, you return to the spaceport. The supervisor and the team of engineers wish you the best of luck, and depart.|1729|0
units.english: When they're done giving you the tour, you return to the spaceport. The supervisor and the team of engineers wish you the best of luck, and depart.
units.italian: Quando hanno finito di farvi fare il giro, tornate allo spazioporto. Il supervisore e la squadra di ingegneri vi augurano ogni bene e se ne vanno.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3C|name|1736|0
units.english: Escort to Hephaestus
units.italian: Scorta per Hephaestus

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3C|description|1737|0
units.english: Escort the combined Free Worlds and Navy fleet to <destination>, where the Syndicate will fit all the ships with jump drives.
units.italian: Scorta la flotta congiunta delle Free Worlds e della Marina fino a <destination>, dove il Sindacato doterà tutte le navi di motori di salto.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3C|log|1749|0
units.english: The Free Worlds and Republic Navy are sending a joint fleet into Syndicate space, where they will be fitted with jump drives to make an assault on Pug territory. The Syndicate only has six jump drives available, so this fleet will have to survive without reinforcements until a way is found to reopen the connection to the rest of human space.
units.italian: Le Free Worlds e la Marina della Repubblica stanno mandando una flotta congiunta nello spazio del Sindacato, dove sarà dotata di motori di salto per sferrare un assalto al territorio dei Pug. Il Sindacato ha solo sei motori di salto disponibili, quindi questa flotta dovrà sopravvivere senza rinforzi finché non si troverà un modo per riaprire il collegamento con il resto dello spazio umano.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3C|dialog|1768|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but part of your fleet is not here yet. Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma una parte della tua flotta non è ancora qui. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3C (Extra)|name|1774|0
units.english: Escort to Hephaestus
units.italian: Scorta per Hephaestus

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3C (Extra)|description|1775|0
units.english: Escort the combined Free Worlds and Navy fleet to <destination>, where the Syndicate will fit all the ships with jump drives.
units.italian: Scorta la flotta congiunta delle Free Worlds e della Marina fino a <destination>, dove il Sindacato doterà tutte le navi di motori di salto.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3C (Extra)|log|1787|0
units.english: The Free Worlds and Republic Navy are sending a joint fleet into Syndicate space, where they will be fitted with jump drives to make an assault on Pug territory. The Syndicate only has seven jump drives available, so this fleet will have to survive without reinforcements until a way is found to reopen the connection to the rest of human space.
units.italian: Le Free Worlds e la Marina della Repubblica stanno mandando una flotta congiunta nello spazio del Sindacato, dove sarà dotata di motori di salto per sferrare un assalto al territorio dei Pug. Il Sindacato ha solo sette motori di salto disponibili, quindi questa flotta dovrà sopravvivere senza rinforzi finché non si troverà un modo per riaprire il collegamento con il resto dello spazio umano.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 3C (Extra)|dialog|1807|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but part of your fleet is not here yet. Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma una parte della tua flotta non è ancora qui. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4|name|1898|0
units.english: Liberate <system>
units.italian: Libera <system>

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4|description|1899|0
units.english: Attempt to drive the Pug out of the <system> system, then land on <planet>.
units.italian: Prova a scacciare i Pug dal sistema <system>, poi atterra su <planet>.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4|The Syndicate directs you to land your ships in the private hangars for Syndicated Systems. Once you have landed, they quickly work to install jump drives in the Navy and Free Worlds ships. As they work, you hear one of the workers saying to another, "Golly, I'd forgotten how big those Navy ships are. Makes a Protector look puny by comparison, doesn't it?"|1913|0
units.english: The Syndicate directs you to land your ships in the private hangars for Syndicated Systems. Once you have landed, they quickly work to install jump drives in the Navy and Free Worlds ships. As they work, you hear one of the workers saying to another, "Golly, I'd forgotten how big those Navy ships are. Makes a Protector look puny by comparison, doesn't it?"
units.italian: Il Sindacato ti indica di far atterrare le tue navi negli hangar privati della Syndicate Systems. Una volta atterrati, si mettono subito al lavoro per installare motori di salto sulle navi della Marina e delle Free Worlds. Mentre lavorano, senti un operaio dire a un altro: "Perbacco, mi ero dimenticato quanto sono grandi quelle navi della Marina. Fa sembrare piccola una Protector al confronto, vero?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4|	Once the work is done, you meet with a senior Syndicate executive named Marco Bugati. "I really hope this works," he says, "because these are the only jump drives we've been able to acquire. If your fleet is destroyed, we will have lost access to the occupied territory entirely."|1916|0
units.english: Once the work is done, you meet with a senior Syndicate executive named Marco Bugati. "I really hope this works," he says, "because these are the only jump drives we've been able to acquire. If your fleet is destroyed, we will have lost access to the occupied territory entirely."
units.italian: Quando il lavoro è finito, incontri un dirigente di alto livello del Sindacato di nome Marco Bugati. "Spero davvero che funzioni," dice, "perché questi sono gli unici motori di salto che siamo riusciti a procurarci. Se la vostra flotta viene distrutta, avremo perso del tutto l'accesso al territorio occupato."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4|	Once the work is done, you meet with a senior Syndicate executive named Marco Bugati. "I really hope this works," he says, "because these are the only jump drives we've been able to acquire, though you seem to have picked one up yourself; I'd like to have a chat with you and find out how, if we all survive this. I can tell you, that extra ship we've got thanks to the spare jump drive may be pivotal. But if your fleet is destroyed, we will have lost access to the occupied territory entirely."|1919|0
units.english: Once the work is done, you meet with a senior Syndicate executive named Marco Bugati. "I really hope this works," he says, "because these are the only jump drives we've been able to acquire, though you seem to have picked one up yourself; I'd like to have a chat with you and find out how, if we all survive this. I can tell you, that extra ship we've got thanks to the spare jump drive may be pivotal. But if your fleet is destroyed, we will have lost access to the occupied territory entirely."
units.italian: Quando il lavoro è finito, incontri un dirigente di alto livello del Sindacato di nome Marco Bugati. "Spero davvero che funzioni," dice, "perché questi sono gli unici motori di salto che siamo riusciti a procurarci, anche se sembra che ve ne siate procurato uno per conto vostro; mi piacerebbe parlarne con te e scoprire come, se sopravviviamo tutti a questa storia. Ti posso dire che quella nave in più che abbiamo grazie al motore di salto di riserva potrebbe essere decisiva. Ma se la vostra flotta viene distrutta, avremo perso del tutto l'accesso al territorio occupato."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4|	You gather your fleet and prepare for an assault on Delta Capricorni, which is the occupied star system closest to Syndicate space.|1921|0
units.english: You gather your fleet and prepare for an assault on Delta Capricorni, which is the occupied star system closest to Syndicate space.
units.italian: Raduni la tua flotta e ti prepari a un assalto a Delta Capricorni, che è il sistema stellare occupato più vicino allo spazio del Sindacato.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4|[Take good care of this fleet: if ships are disabled, board them to "repair" them once the battle is over. And, when jumping into battle, remember that you can hold down the jump key to get all your ships ready to jump simultaneously, so no single ship enters the system first and bears the brunt of the enemy fire.]|1923|0
units.english: [Take good care of this fleet: if ships are disabled, board them to "repair" them once the battle is over. And, when jumping into battle, remember that you can hold down the jump key to get all your ships ready to jump simultaneously, so no single ship enters the system first and bears the brunt of the enemy fire.]
units.italian: [Abbi cura di questa flotta: se delle navi vengono messe fuori uso, abbordale per "ripararle" una volta finita la battaglia. E, quando salti in battaglia, ricorda che puoi tenere premuto il tasto del salto per preparare tutte le tue navi a saltare contemporaneamente, così nessuna nave entra nel sistema per prima e si prende tutto il fuoco nemico.]

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4|dialog|1943|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but there are either still Pug ships circling overhead, or you've left Freya behind. You should take off and help finish off the Pug or wait for your escort carrying Freya to arrive.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma o ci sono ancora navi Pug che girano là sopra, o hai lasciato indietro Freya. Dovresti decollare e aiutare a finire i Pug, o aspettare che arrivi la tua scorta che porta Freya.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4A|name|1951|0
units.english: Defend Maker
units.italian: Difendi Maker

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4A|description|1952|0
units.english: Keep the Pug from regaining control of Maker for long enough for Freya to figure out whether it is possible to restore the hyperspace link back to the Markab system.
units.italian: Impedisci ai Pug di riprendere il controllo di Maker abbastanza a lungo perché Freya capisca se è possibile ripristinare il collegamento iperspaziale verso il sistema Markab.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4A|log|1960|0
units.english: Succeeded in driving the Pug out of the Delta Capricorni system for long enough to land on Maker and explore the technology that the Pug left behind. Freya thinks that she has discovered the device that is used for creating or destroying hyperspace links, but it will take time for her to figure out how to operate it.
units.italian: Sei riuscito a scacciare i Pug dal sistema Delta Capricorni abbastanza a lungo da atterrare su Maker ed esaminare la tecnologia che i Pug hanno lasciato. Freya pensa di aver scoperto il dispositivo usato per creare o distruggere i collegamenti iperspaziali, ma le servirà tempo per capire come azionarlo.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4A|Along with the remaining ships from the combined attack fleet, you land at the main spaceport on <origin>. The other ships are carrying trained soldiers and equipment for planetary defense: ground-based laser turrets, surface to air missiles, and tracking radar for incoming ships. The soldiers have come armed and ready to fight the Pug on the ground if necessary, but it turns out that all the Pug who were here took off in one of the ships that were trying to repulse your attack.|1964|0
units.english: Along with the remaining ships from the combined attack fleet, you land at the main spaceport on <origin>. The other ships are carrying trained soldiers and equipment for planetary defense: ground-based laser turrets, surface to air missiles, and tracking radar for incoming ships. The soldiers have come armed and ready to fight the Pug on the ground if necessary, but it turns out that all the Pug who were here took off in one of the ships that were trying to repulse your attack.
units.italian: Insieme alle navi rimaste della flotta d'attacco congiunta, atterri allo spazioporto principale di <origin>. Le altre navi trasportano soldati addestrati e attrezzature per la difesa planetaria: torrette laser a terra, missili terra-aria e radar di tracciamento per le navi in arrivo. I soldati sono arrivati armati e pronti a combattere i Pug a terra se necessario, ma si scopre che tutti i Pug che erano qui sono decollati su una delle navi che cercavano di respingere il vostro attacco.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4A|You have liberated this planet, but with your entire fleet destroyed your victory may be short-lived. Still, you have no option but to continue on and try your best. Fortunately, it turns out that none of the Pug are left on the ground here on Maker; they all left the planet to join in the fleet that you just destroyed. So at least you don't have a land war to worry about.|1968|0
units.english: You have liberated this planet, but with your entire fleet destroyed your victory may be short-lived. Still, you have no option but to continue on and try your best. Fortunately, it turns out that none of the Pug are left on the ground here on Maker; they all left the planet to join in the fleet that you just destroyed. So at least you don't have a land war to worry about.
units.italian: Hai liberato questo pianeta, ma con l'intera flotta distrutta la tua vittoria potrebbe essere di breve durata. Non hai però altra scelta che andare avanti e fare del tuo meglio. Per fortuna si scopre che quaggiù su Maker non è rimasto nessun Pug; sono tutti partiti dal pianeta per unirsi alla flotta che hai appena distrutto. Quindi almeno non hai una guerra terrestre di cui preoccuparti.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4A|	Freya has some good news: she is picking up very faint, intermittent signals from the hyperspace communications relay back in the Markab system. "That means the link may not be closed completely," she says, "or at least, there's some residue remaining."|1972|0
units.english: Freya has some good news: she is picking up very faint, intermittent signals from the hyperspace communications relay back in the Markab system. "That means the link may not be closed completely," she says, "or at least, there's some residue remaining."
units.italian: Freya ha buone notizie: sta captando segnali molto deboli e intermittenti dal ripetitore delle comunicazioni iperspaziali nel sistema Markab. "Il che significa che il collegamento potrebbe non essere chiuso del tutto," dice, "o almeno che resta qualche residuo."
