units.id: mission:FW Pug 4A|	Freya directs you to fly over the planet and survey the buildings and equipment that the Pug left behind, and after searching for a while you discover an alien building that vaguely resembles a radio transmitter. You land nearby, and as you approach the building on foot, you feel as if the ground beneath you is heaving and rolling like the deck of a ship on choppy seas. "Graviton distortions," she says. "This may be it, the equipment they used to disrupt the hyperspace links. It will take me a while to figure out how it works, though."|1973|0
units.english: Freya directs you to fly over the planet and survey the buildings and equipment that the Pug left behind, and after searching for a while you discover an alien building that vaguely resembles a radio transmitter. You land nearby, and as you approach the building on foot, you feel as if the ground beneath you is heaving and rolling like the deck of a ship on choppy seas. "Graviton distortions," she says. "This may be it, the equipment they used to disrupt the hyperspace links. It will take me a while to figure out how it works, though."
units.italian: Freya ti indica di sorvolare il pianeta e rilevare gli edifici e le attrezzature che i Pug hanno lasciato, e dopo aver cercato per un po' scoprite un edificio alieno che assomiglia vagamente a un trasmettitore radio. Atterrate lì vicino, e mentre vi avvicinate all'edificio a piedi, hai la sensazione che il terreno sotto di voi si sollevi e rolli come il ponte di una nave su un mare agitato. "Distorsioni gravitoniche," dice. "Potrebbe essere questo, l'equipaggiamento che hanno usato per disturbare i collegamenti iperspaziali. Mi servirà un po' per capire come funziona, però."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4A|	You agree that she will stay here to try to figure out the alien technology, while you do your best to defend the planet and to keep the Pug from retaking it.|1974|0
units.english: You agree that she will stay here to try to figure out the alien technology, while you do your best to defend the planet and to keep the Pug from retaking it.
units.italian: Concordate che lei resterà qui a cercare di capire la tecnologia aliena, mentre tu farai del tuo meglio per difendere il pianeta e impedire ai Pug di riprenderlo.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4A|dialog|1977|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but there are still Pug ships circling overhead. You should take off and help finish them off.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ci sono ancora navi Pug che girano là sopra. Dovresti decollare e aiutare a finirle.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4A|dialog|1999|0
units.english: You receive a message from Freya: "Captain, I think I've figured out the transmitter, and there is indeed a chance that we can reopen the hyperspace links. Meet me back down on the planet as soon as possible - I'll need you to take some equipment back to Hephaestus and set it up there."
units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio da Freya: "Capitano, credo di aver capito il trasmettitore, e c'è davvero la possibilità di riaprire i collegamenti iperspaziali. Raggiungimi di nuovo sul pianeta il prima possibile: avrò bisogno che tu porti un po' di attrezzatura su Hephaestus e la installi lì."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4B|name|2016|0
units.english: Reflector to Hephaestus
units.italian: Riflettore per Hephaestus

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4B|description|2017|0
units.english: Freya found a device that she believes is a "graviton reflector," which can somehow be set up in the <system> system to re-establish the hyperspace link between there and Delta Capricorni. Bring the transmitter to the Syndicate officials on <planet>.
units.italian: Freya ha trovato un dispositivo che ritiene essere un "riflettore di gravitoni", che può in qualche modo essere installato nel sistema <system> per ristabilire il collegamento iperspaziale fra lì e Delta Capricorni. Porta il trasmettitore ai funzionari del Sindacato su <planet>.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4B|blocked|2023|0
units.english: Freya contacts you and says, "Captain, you're going to need ten tons of cargo space." You do not have that much available, so you should return here when you do.
units.italian: Freya ti contatta e dice: "Capitano, ti serviranno dieci tonnellate di spazio di carico." Non ne hai a disposizione altrettante, quindi dovresti tornare qui quando ce l'avrai.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4B|Freya meets you soon after you land. She has brought with her a large piece of alien machinery, mounted on a flat-bed truck for easy transportation. "I shut down the transmitter," she says, "and sure enough, the signal from Markab started to gradually become stronger. I think it was somehow jamming or suppressing the hyperspace link, rather than completely severing it. So then I found that the transmitter has a different setting, where instead of sending random graviton noise, it sends a steady, harmonic pulse. And that accelerated the process of reopening the link."|2029|0
units.english: Freya meets you soon after you land. She has brought with her a large piece of alien machinery, mounted on a flat-bed truck for easy transportation. "I shut down the transmitter," she says, "and sure enough, the signal from Markab started to gradually become stronger. I think it was somehow jamming or suppressing the hyperspace link, rather than completely severing it. So then I found that the transmitter has a different setting, where instead of sending random graviton noise, it sends a steady, harmonic pulse. And that accelerated the process of reopening the link."
units.italian: Freya ti incontra poco dopo l'atterraggio. Ha portato con sé un grosso pezzo di macchinario alieno, montato su un camion a pianale per facilitarne il trasporto. "Ho spento il trasmettitore," dice, "e come previsto il segnale da Markab ha cominciato a rafforzarsi gradualmente. Credo che in qualche modo stesse disturbando o sopprimendo il collegamento iperspaziale, invece di reciderlo del tutto. Poi ho scoperto che il trasmettitore ha un'impostazione diversa, in cui invece di inviare rumore gravitonico casuale invia un impulso armonico costante. E questo ha accelerato il processo di riapertura del collegamento."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4B|	"Great! How soon until the link is open again?"|2031|0
units.english: "Great! How soon until the link is open again?"
units.italian: "Ottimo! Fra quanto sarà riaperto il collegamento?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4B|	"Are you sure we should be playing with alien technology we don't understand?"|2033|0
units.english: "Are you sure we should be playing with alien technology we don't understand?"
units.italian: "Sei sicura che dovremmo giocare con tecnologia aliena che non capiamo?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4B|	"Do we really have any better options?" she asks. "Without reinforcements, how many more Pug attacks do you really think you can survive? Besides, there's a certain logic and balance to the rules of physics, so even when dealing with something we can't understand, sometimes intuition can guide us." She pauses for a second, and says, "And sometimes intuition steers us terribly wrong, but let's not think about that right now."|2035|0
units.english: "Do we really have any better options?" she asks. "Without reinforcements, how many more Pug attacks do you really think you can survive? Besides, there's a certain logic and balance to the rules of physics, so even when dealing with something we can't understand, sometimes intuition can guide us." She pauses for a second, and says, "And sometimes intuition steers us terribly wrong, but let's not think about that right now."
units.italian: "Abbiamo davvero opzioni migliori?" chiede. "Senza rinforzi, quanti altri attacchi dei Pug pensi davvero di poter sopravvivere? Inoltre c'è una certa logica e un certo equilibrio nelle regole della fisica, quindi anche quando abbiamo a che fare con qualcosa che non capiamo, a volte l'intuito può guidarci." Si ferma un secondo e dice: "E a volte l'intuito ci porta terribilmente fuori strada, ma non pensiamoci adesso."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4B|	"So, you succeeded in opening the link?" you say.|2036|0
units.english: "So, you succeeded in opening the link?" you say.
units.italian: "Quindi sei riuscita ad aprire il collegamento?" dici.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4B|	"Well, that's the bad news," she says. "At this rate, it will take several years to reopen the connection. And I doubt this method would work at all if there weren't still the residual link in place. But that's where this equipment comes in."|2038|0
units.english: "Well, that's the bad news," she says. "At this rate, it will take several years to reopen the connection. And I doubt this method would work at all if there weren't still the residual link in place. But that's where this equipment comes in."
units.italian: "Beh, questa è la cattiva notizia," dice. "A questo ritmo ci vorranno diversi anni per riaprire la connessione. E dubito che questo metodo funzionerebbe affatto se non ci fosse ancora il collegamento residuo. Ma è qui che entra in gioco questa attrezzatura."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4B|	She points to the alien machine. "This machine is like the transmitter, but much simpler. The transmitter somehow redirects a planet's gravity spaceward; what this machine does is reflect a graviton beam back where it comes from. If we can mount the reflector on Hephaestus, and align them both very precisely, we can set up a standing wave between the two that will regenerate the hyperspace link much more quickly. Or for all I know it might create an artificial singularity that destroys us all. I'm mostly flying blind here."|2039|0
units.english: She points to the alien machine. "This machine is like the transmitter, but much simpler. The transmitter somehow redirects a planet's gravity spaceward; what this machine does is reflect a graviton beam back where it comes from. If we can mount the reflector on Hephaestus, and align them both very precisely, we can set up a standing wave between the two that will regenerate the hyperspace link much more quickly. Or for all I know it might create an artificial singularity that destroys us all. I'm mostly flying blind here."
units.italian: Indica la macchina aliena. "Questa macchina è simile al trasmettitore, ma molto più semplice. Il trasmettitore in qualche modo reindirizza la gravità di un pianeta verso lo spazio; questa macchina riflette un fascio di gravitoni là da dove viene. Se riusciamo a montare il riflettore su Hephaestus e ad allinearli entrambi con molta precisione, possiamo creare un'onda stazionaria fra i due che rigenererà il collegamento iperspaziale molto più in fretta. O, per quanto ne so, potrebbe creare una singolarità artificiale che ci distrugge tutti. Sto andando in gran parte alla cieca."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4B|	"Well, I guess we should give it a try."|2041|0
units.english: "Well, I guess we should give it a try."
units.italian: "Beh, immagino che dovremmo provarci."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4B|	"Sounds risky. Are there any other options we could try?"|2043|0
units.english: "Sounds risky. Are there any other options we could try?"
units.italian: "Sembra rischioso. Ci sono altre opzioni che potremmo provare?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4B|	"No," she says, "no, there are not. Sorry."|2045|0
units.english: "No," she says, "no, there are not. Sorry."
units.italian: "No," dice, "no, non ci sono. Scusa."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4B|	You load the reflector onto your ship, and get ready to travel to Hephaestus. You suspect that the Pug are going to try to stop you, once they realize what is happening...|2047|0
units.english: You load the reflector onto your ship, and get ready to travel to Hephaestus. You suspect that the Pug are going to try to stop you, once they realize what is happening...
units.italian: Carichi il riflettore sulla tua nave e ti prepari a partire per Hephaestus. Sospetti che i Pug proveranno a fermarti, una volta capito che cosa sta succedendo...

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4B|dialog|2050|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying the graviton reflector hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta il riflettore di gravitoni non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4C|name|2106|0
units.english: Return to <system>
units.italian: Torna nel sistema <system>

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4C|description|2107|0
units.english: Return to <destination>, accompanied by your new reinforcement fleet supplied by the Syndicate, and talk with Freya to decide on what your next steps should be now that you have the ability to restore the links to human space.
units.italian: Torna su <destination>, accompagnato dalla tua nuova flotta di rinforzo fornita dal Sindacato, e parla con Freya per decidere quali siano i prossimi passi ora che hai la capacità di ripristinare i collegamenti con lo spazio umano.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4C|Freya sent detailed instructions with the reflector for where it should be set up and how it should be adjusted to interface with the transmitter back in Pug space. You hand it over to a team of Syndicate engineers, who seem quite capable and confident that they can make it work; you suspect that these are the same engineers who have been playing with equipment stolen from the Korath, so they are no strangers to alien technology.|2118|0
units.english: Freya sent detailed instructions with the reflector for where it should be set up and how it should be adjusted to interface with the transmitter back in Pug space. You hand it over to a team of Syndicate engineers, who seem quite capable and confident that they can make it work; you suspect that these are the same engineers who have been playing with equipment stolen from the Korath, so they are no strangers to alien technology.
units.italian: Freya ha mandato istruzioni dettagliate insieme al riflettore su dove installarlo e come regolarlo per interfacciarsi con il trasmettitore nello spazio dei Pug. Lo consegni a una squadra di ingegneri del Sindacato, che sembrano piuttosto capaci e sicuri di riuscirci; sospetti che siano gli stessi ingegneri che hanno giocato con l'equipaggiamento rubato ai Korath, quindi non sono estranei alla tecnologia aliena.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4C|	You also meet with Marco Bugati, the Syndicate executive who oversaw the installation of your jump drives, and tell him that you may soon be able to reopen one of the connections to Republic space, as well. You ask if he can send a courier ship to Earth to inform them of the new situation, to have them begin massing a fleet there. He agrees. He also tells you that a few of the Syndicate ships that met you in orbit have been designated as additions to your attack fleet, so they will be traveling back to Maker with you if the reflector succeeds in reopening the link.|2119|0
units.english: You also meet with Marco Bugati, the Syndicate executive who oversaw the installation of your jump drives, and tell him that you may soon be able to reopen one of the connections to Republic space, as well. You ask if he can send a courier ship to Earth to inform them of the new situation, to have them begin massing a fleet there. He agrees. He also tells you that a few of the Syndicate ships that met you in orbit have been designated as additions to your attack fleet, so they will be traveling back to Maker with you if the reflector succeeds in reopening the link.
units.italian: Incontri anche Marco Bugati, il dirigente del Sindacato che ha sovrinteso all'installazione dei tuoi motori di salto, e gli dici che presto potreste essere in grado di riaprire anche una delle connessioni con lo spazio della Repubblica. Gli chiedi se può mandare una nave corriere sulla Terra per informarli della nuova situazione, così che comincino a radunare una flotta lì. Accetta. Ti dice anche che alcune delle navi del Sindacato che vi hanno incontrato in orbita sono state designate come aggiunte alla tua flotta d'attacco, quindi torneranno con te su Maker se il riflettore riuscirà a riaprire il collegamento.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 4C|	A few hours later, the engineers tell you that they think the link is beginning to reopen. Bugati says, "You should take off and return as soon as possible, in case Maker has been attacked in your absence."|2120|0
units.english: A few hours later, the engineers tell you that they think the link is beginning to reopen. Bugati says, "You should take off and return as soon as possible, in case Maker has been attacked in your absence."
units.italian: Qualche ora dopo, gli ingegneri ti dicono che secondo loro il collegamento sta cominciando a riaprirsi. Bugati dice: "Dovresti decollare e tornare il prima possibile, nel caso Maker sia stata attaccata in tua assenza."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 5|name|2127|0
units.english: Liberate <planet>
units.italian: Libera <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Pug 5|description|2128|0
units.english: If you can drive the Pug away from <destination>, you will be able to re-establish the hyperspace link between Altair and the Sol system, and immediately bring in Navy ships as reinforcements.
units.italian: Se riesci a scacciare i Pug da <destination>, potrai ristabilire il collegamento iperspaziale fra Altair e il sistema Sol, e portare subito navi della Marina come rinforzi.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 5|blocked|2136|0
units.english: Freya contacts you and says, "<first>, we're going to need space for me, plus ten tons of cargo, on your ship. Think you can do that?" You tell her you will contact her here on <origin> as soon as you have made the space available.
units.italian: Freya ti contatta e dice: "<first>, sulla tua nave ci servirà spazio per me, più dieci tonnellate di carico. Pensi di riuscirci?" Le dici che la contatterai qui su <origin> appena avrai liberato lo spazio.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 5|log|2141|0
units.english: Freya succeeded in reopening the hyperspace link to one of the Syndicate systems. If the same can be done for the link to Sol, the entire Navy will be able to join the battle against the Pug.
units.italian: Freya è riuscita a riaprire il collegamento iperspaziale verso uno dei sistemi del Sindacato. Se si può fare lo stesso con il collegamento verso il Sol, l'intera Marina potrà unirsi alla battaglia contro i Pug.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 5|Freya is overjoyed that she has found a way to reverse the Pug technology and restore a hyperspace connection to human space. "Now we actually have a chance," she says. "Before, with just you and six other ships, victory seemed unlikely."|2146|0
units.english: Freya is overjoyed that she has found a way to reverse the Pug technology and restore a hyperspace connection to human space. "Now we actually have a chance," she says. "Before, with just you and six other ships, victory seemed unlikely."
units.italian: Freya è raggiante per aver trovato il modo di invertire la tecnologia dei Pug e ripristinare un collegamento iperspaziale con lo spazio umano. "Ora abbiamo davvero una possibilità," dice. "Prima, con solo te e altre sei navi, la vittoria sembrava improbabile."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 5|Freya is overjoyed that she has found a way to reverse the Pug technology and restore a hyperspace connection to human space. "Now we actually have a chance," she says. "Before, with just you and seven other ships, victory seemed unlikely."|2149|0
units.english: Freya is overjoyed that she has found a way to reverse the Pug technology and restore a hyperspace connection to human space. "Now we actually have a chance," she says. "Before, with just you and seven other ships, victory seemed unlikely."
units.italian: Freya è raggiante per aver trovato il modo di invertire la tecnologia dei Pug e ripristinare un collegamento iperspaziale con lo spazio umano. "Ora abbiamo davvero una possibilità," dice. "Prima, con solo te e altre sette navi, la vittoria sembrava improbabile."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 5|	"What should we do next?"|2152|0
units.english: "What should we do next?"
units.italian: "Che cosa dovremmo fare adesso?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 5|	"Are you sure that generating these graviton waves is safe?"|2154|0
units.english: "Are you sure that generating these graviton waves is safe?"
units.italian: "Sei sicura che generare queste onde gravitoniche sia sicuro?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 5|	"I'm sure of nothing," she says, "but it seemed to work, and without any catastrophic side effects so far, so that's something."|2156|0
units.english: "I'm sure of nothing," she says, "but it seemed to work, and without any catastrophic side effects so far, so that's something."
units.italian: "Non sono sicura di niente," dice, "ma sembrava funzionare, e finora senza effetti collaterali catastrofici, il che è già qualcosa."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 5|	Freya leads you to a warehouse in the spaceport where another one of the "graviton reflectors" is stored. "This should work the same as the one you brought to Hephaestus," she says. "If there's a transmitter on Shiver, we can bring the reflector to Sol and open a link back to the very heart of human space. And at that point, we may even have the Pug outgunned. But first, we need to drive them away from that star system for long enough for me to work the transmitter."|2158|0
units.english: Freya leads you to a warehouse in the spaceport where another one of the "graviton reflectors" is stored. "This should work the same as the one you brought to Hephaestus," she says. "If there's a transmitter on Shiver, we can bring the reflector to Sol and open a link back to the very heart of human space. And at that point, we may even have the Pug outgunned. But first, we need to drive them away from that star system for long enough for me to work the transmitter."
units.italian: Freya ti guida in un magazzino dello spazioporto dove è custodito un altro dei "riflettori di gravitoni". "Dovrebbe funzionare come quello che hai portato su Hephaestus," dice. "Se c'è un trasmettitore su Shiver, possiamo portare il riflettore nel Sol e aprire un collegamento proprio verso il cuore dello spazio umano. E a quel punto potremmo persino avere i Pug in inferiorità. Ma prima dobbiamo scacciarli da quel sistema stellare abbastanza a lungo perché io possa azionare il trasmettitore."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 5|dialog|2161|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but there are still Pug ships circling overhead. You should take off and help finish them off.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ci sono ancora navi Pug che girano là sopra. Dovresti decollare e aiutare a finirle.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 5A|name|2206|0
units.english: Reflector to <planet>
units.italian: Riflettore per <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Pug 5A|description|2207|0
units.english: Bring this "graviton reflector" to <planet> and set it up there, in order to restore the hyperspace link between the Sol and Altair systems.
units.italian: Porta questo "riflettore di gravitoni" su <planet> e installalo lì, per ripristinare il collegamento iperspaziale fra i sistemi Sol e Altair.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 5A|Sure enough, Freya finds a graviton wave transmitter on <origin>, set up to broadcast incoherent graviton noise in the direction of the Sol system. "This is it," she says. "If you can reach <planet> with the reflector before we are overrun by the Pug here, we can reopen the hyperspace link and the entire Navy will be at our backs. Hopefully the Syndicate got a message through and they'll have a fleet waiting for you when you arrive."|2220|0
units.english: Sure enough, Freya finds a graviton wave transmitter on <origin>, set up to broadcast incoherent graviton noise in the direction of the Sol system. "This is it," she says. "If you can reach <planet> with the reflector before we are overrun by the Pug here, we can reopen the hyperspace link and the entire Navy will be at our backs. Hopefully the Syndicate got a message through and they'll have a fleet waiting for you when you arrive."
units.italian: Come previsto, Freya trova un trasmettitore di onde gravitoniche su <origin>, impostato per diffondere rumore gravitonico incoerente in direzione del sistema Sol. "È questo," dice. "Se riesci a raggiungere <planet> con il riflettore prima che qui veniamo travolti dai Pug, possiamo riaprire il collegamento iperspaziale e l'intera Marina sarà alle nostre spalle. Speriamo che il Sindacato sia riuscito a far arrivare un messaggio e che abbiano una flotta ad aspettarti quando arrivi."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 5A|	"You really think you can hold off the Pug if I make a run for <planet>?"|2222|0
units.english: "You really think you can hold off the Pug if I make a run for <planet>?"
units.italian: "Pensi davvero di poter tenere a bada i Pug se io corro verso <planet>?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 5A|	"I'm worried that you won't survive if I leave this system undefended."|2223|0
units.english: "I'm worried that you won't survive if I leave this system undefended."
units.italian: "Temo che non sopravviverai se lascio questo sistema indifeso."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 5A|	"Don't worry about us here," she says. "We have a fair number of ships here on the ground, if it comes to that. But the most important thing is that you rendezvous with the Navy reinforcements in the <system> system, and if you can draw the Pug fleet to pursue you, all the better. Good luck, <first>."|2224|0
units.english: "Don't worry about us here," she says. "We have a fair number of ships here on the ground, if it comes to that. But the most important thing is that you rendezvous with the Navy reinforcements in the <system> system, and if you can draw the Pug fleet to pursue you, all the better. Good luck, <first>."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti per noi qui," dice. "Abbiamo un buon numero di navi a terra, se si arriverà a questo. Ma la cosa più importante è che tu ti ricongiunga ai rinforzi della Marina nel sistema <system>, e se riesci a farti inseguire dalla flotta dei Pug, tanto meglio. Buona fortuna, <first>."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 5A|dialog|2227|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying the graviton reflector hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta il riflettore di gravitoni non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 5B|name|2255|0
units.english: Defend Altair
units.italian: Difendi Altair

units.id: mission:FW Pug 5B|description|2256|0
units.english: Freya sent you a message that the <system> system is under attack. Return there, accompanied by your new Navy reinforcements, and drive off the Pug.
units.italian: Freya ti ha mandato un messaggio che il sistema <system> è sotto attacco. Torna lì, accompagnato dai tuoi nuovi rinforzi della Marina, e scaccia i Pug.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 5B|log|2266|0
units.english: Succeeded in rendezvousing with the Navy in the Sol system and reopening a link to the Pug territory. But now Shiver is under attack by a massive Pug fleet.
units.italian: Sei riuscito a ricongiungerti alla Marina nel sistema Sol e a riaprire un collegamento verso il territorio dei Pug. Ma ora Shiver è sotto attacco da una flotta Pug enorme.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 5B|You help some Navy engineers on Earth to set up the graviton reflector according to Freya's instructions. As before, soon after the reflector is operational the ground seems to tilt and roll as Freya's beam homes in on the reflector and sets up a harmonic oscillation between the two. "The link is reopening!" says one of the engineers. "We're beginning to receive hyperspace communications from Altair again, and from the Syndicate too."|2269|0
units.english: You help some Navy engineers on Earth to set up the graviton reflector according to Freya's instructions. As before, soon after the reflector is operational the ground seems to tilt and roll as Freya's beam homes in on the reflector and sets up a harmonic oscillation between the two. "The link is reopening!" says one of the engineers. "We're beginning to receive hyperspace communications from Altair again, and from the Syndicate too."
units.italian: Aiuti alcuni ingegneri della Marina sulla Terra a installare il riflettore di gravitoni secondo le istruzioni di Freya. Come prima, poco dopo che il riflettore è operativo il terreno sembra inclinarsi e rollare, mentre il fascio di Freya si aggancia al riflettore e stabilisce un'oscillazione armonica fra i due. "Il collegamento si sta riaprendo!" dice uno degli ingegneri. "Ricominciamo a ricevere comunicazioni iperspaziali da Altair, e anche dal Sindacato."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 5B|	A second later your own communicator beeps. It's Freya. "Get back here quickly," she says. "Bring whatever reinforcements you can. A massive Pug fleet just appeared in orbit."|2270|0
units.english: A second later your own communicator beeps. It's Freya. "Get back here quickly," she says. "Bring whatever reinforcements you can. A massive Pug fleet just appeared in orbit."
units.italian: Un secondo dopo il tuo comunicatore trilla. È Freya. "Torna qui in fretta," dice. "Porta tutti i rinforzi che puoi. In orbita è appena comparsa una flotta Pug enorme."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 5B|dialog|2273|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but there are still Pug ships circling overhead. You should take off and help finish them off.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ci sono ancora navi Pug che girano là sopra. Dovresti decollare e aiutare a finirle.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|name|2310|0
units.english: Defeat the Pug
units.italian: Sconfiggi i Pug

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|description|2311|0
units.english: Now that the Navy has joined you, it is time to take the battle directly to the Pug home system. Once their fleet is eliminated, land on their home world of <planet> to attempt to negotiate for peace.
units.italian: Ora che la Marina si è unita a te, è il momento di portare la battaglia direttamente nel sistema natale dei Pug. Una volta eliminata la loro flotta, atterra sul loro mondo natale <planet> per tentare di negoziare la pace.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|blocked|2319|0
units.english: You need a bunk free for Freya to continue this mission.
units.italian: Per continuare questa missione ti serve una cuccetta libera per Freya.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|You enter the Deneb system expecting a massive Pug battle fleet to be waiting for you. Instead, it is entirely deserted. Also, your sensors are picking up some sort of anomaly outside the orbit of the outermost planet.|2322|0
units.english: You enter the Deneb system expecting a massive Pug battle fleet to be waiting for you. Instead, it is entirely deserted. Also, your sensors are picking up some sort of anomaly outside the orbit of the outermost planet.
units.italian: Entri nel sistema Deneb aspettandoti una massiccia flotta da battaglia Pug ad attenderti. Invece è del tutto deserto. Inoltre i tuoi sensori captano una qualche anomalia fuori dall'orbita del pianeta più esterno.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|log|2327|0
units.english: Preparing for the final assault on the Pug homeworld. There seems to be no other option but to force them to surrender, but with the help of the Navy that no longer seems like an impossible task.
units.italian: Ti stai preparando all'assalto finale al mondo natale dei Pug. Non sembra esserci altra opzione che costringerli ad arrendersi, ma con l'aiuto della Marina non sembra più un'impresa impossibile.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|The tiny spaceport on Shiver is packed with people as more and more Navy ships come in for a landing. The Navy admirals have decided that there is no sense in delaying: you will be launching an attack on the Pug homeworld in the morning. Despite your success so far in battling the Pug, you know that if their entire fleet opposes you, even the Navy may not be strong enough to defeat them. This may be the last time you see many of these officers and crew members alive.|2330|0
units.english: The tiny spaceport on Shiver is packed with people as more and more Navy ships come in for a landing. The Navy admirals have decided that there is no sense in delaying: you will be launching an attack on the Pug homeworld in the morning. Despite your success so far in battling the Pug, you know that if their entire fleet opposes you, even the Navy may not be strong enough to defeat them. This may be the last time you see many of these officers and crew members alive.
units.italian: Il piccolo spazioporto su Shiver è stipato di gente, mentre sempre più navi della Marina arrivano ad atterrare. Gli ammiragli della Marina hanno deciso che non ha senso rimandare: domani mattina lancerete un attacco al mondo natale dei Pug. Nonostante i successi ottenuti finora contro i Pug, sai che, se l'intera loro flotta vi si opponesse, nemmeno la Marina potrebbe essere abbastanza forte da sconfiggerli. Questa potrebbe essere l'ultima volta che vedi vivi molti di questi ufficiali e membri degli equipaggi.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|	Everyone prepares for death in different ways. The spaceport's pub is packed, with the crowd spilling out into the hallway and loud music blasting. The chapel is equally full, and the sound of whispered prayers and chanting clashes with the dance music from the pub. Through the doorway of the chapel you see some people sitting cross-legged on the floor and others kneeling on prayer rugs, as the various cultures that make up the Republic do their best to share the space.|2331|0
units.english: Everyone prepares for death in different ways. The spaceport's pub is packed, with the crowd spilling out into the hallway and loud music blasting. The chapel is equally full, and the sound of whispered prayers and chanting clashes with the dance music from the pub. Through the doorway of the chapel you see some people sitting cross-legged on the floor and others kneeling on prayer rugs, as the various cultures that make up the Republic do their best to share the space.
units.italian: Ognuno si prepara alla morte a modo suo. Il pub dello spazioporto è pieno zeppo, con la folla che si riversa nel corridoio e musica ad alto volume che rimbomba. La cappella è altrettanto piena, e il suono di preghiere sussurrate e canti si scontra con la musica da ballo del pub. Dalla porta della cappella vedi alcuni seduti a gambe incrociate sul pavimento e altri inginocchiati su tappeti da preghiera, mentre le varie culture che compongono la Repubblica fanno del loro meglio per condividere lo spazio.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|	You find Freya sitting in a secluded nook on the upper floor of the spaceport building, watching the drifting snow out the window. "Ready for the last battle, Captain?" she asks.|2332|0
units.english: You find Freya sitting in a secluded nook on the upper floor of the spaceport building, watching the drifting snow out the window. "Ready for the last battle, Captain?" she asks.
units.italian: Trovi Freya seduta in un angolo appartato al piano superiore dell'edificio dello spazioporto, a guardare la neve che scende fuori dalla finestra. "Pronto per l'ultima battaglia, Capitano?" chiede.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|	"Sure, with the Navy at our backs I think we've got a good chance."|2334|0
units.english: "Sure, with the Navy at our backs I think we've got a good chance."
units.italian: "Certo, con la Marina alle spalle credo che abbiamo buone possibilità."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|	"As ready as I'll ever be, I guess."|2335|0
units.english: "As ready as I'll ever be, I guess."
units.italian: "Pronto quanto lo sarò mai, immagino."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|	She laughs. "I suppose that's the best we can hope for. Do you mind if I ride in your ship tomorrow, rather than one of the others? If this is the end, I'd rather face it with people I know." You agree. She turns back to look out the window.|2336|0
units.english: She laughs. "I suppose that's the best we can hope for. Do you mind if I ride in your ship tomorrow, rather than one of the others? If this is the end, I'd rather face it with people I know." You agree. She turns back to look out the window.
units.italian: Ride. "Immagino sia il meglio che possiamo sperare. Ti dispiace se domani viaggio sulla tua nave, invece che su una delle altre? Se questa è la fine, preferirei affrontarla con gente che conosco." Sei d'accordo. Lei si volta di nuovo a guardare fuori dalla finestra.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|	Since Freya seems to want to be alone, you return downstairs, and discover that a sizable Oathkeeper fleet has arrived. In the main vestibule of the spaceport, an Oathkeeper officer is leading a group in qigong meditation. And surprisingly, you spot Admiral Danforth sitting with the Muslim prayer group and chanting in fluent Arabic. Meanwhile, the party outside the pub continues.|2337|0
units.english: Since Freya seems to want to be alone, you return downstairs, and discover that a sizable Oathkeeper fleet has arrived. In the main vestibule of the spaceport, an Oathkeeper officer is leading a group in qigong meditation. And surprisingly, you spot Admiral Danforth sitting with the Muslim prayer group and chanting in fluent Arabic. Meanwhile, the party outside the pub continues.
units.italian: Dato che Freya sembra voler restare sola, torni di sotto, e scopri che è arrivata una flotta consistente di Oathkeepers. Nel vestibolo principale dello spazioporto, un ufficiale Oathkeeper guida un gruppo in meditazione qigong. E con sorpresa scorgi l'ammiraglio Danforth seduto con il gruppo di preghiera musulmana, che canta in un arabo fluente. Intanto la festa fuori dal pub continua.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|	Eventually morning comes, and you prepare your ship for the assault on the Pug homeworld...|2338|0
units.english: Eventually morning comes, and you prepare your ship for the assault on the Pug homeworld...
units.italian: Alla fine arriva il mattino, e prepari la tua nave all'assalto al mondo natale dei Pug...

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|dialog|2396|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Freya hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Freya non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|log|2398|0
units.english: The Pug have fled, apparently traveling through an artificial wormhole back to whatever galaxy they came from. And, it turns out that many of their cities on "Pugglemug" were only for show: buildings with no inhabitants, and with holograms creating the appearance of a heavily populated world. They left no advanced technology behind, and no sign of what their true intentions were, but it turns out that the fake cities here were designed for human habitation. They must have been planning this departure for a very long time.
units.italian: I Pug sono fuggiti, a quanto pare attraversando un wormhole artificiale verso qualunque galassia da cui erano venuti. E si scopre che molte delle loro città su "Pugglemug" erano solo di facciata: edifici senza abitanti, con ologrammi che creavano l'apparenza di un mondo densamente popolato. Non hanno lasciato tecnologia avanzata, né traccia di quali fossero le loro vere intenzioni, ma si scopre che le città finte qui erano progettate per l'abitazione umana. Dovevano aver pianificato questa partenza da molto, molto tempo.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|log|2399|0
units.english: Now that the Pug are gone, the Navy will be able to use the "graviton reflectors" to repair the broken hyperspace links and to reconnect all of human space.
units.italian: Ora che i Pug se ne sono andati, la Marina potrà usare i "riflettori di gravitoni" per riparare i collegamenti iperspaziali interrotti e riconnettere tutto lo spazio umano.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|log|2400|0
units.english: The Pug disappeared from human space, and left behind more questions than answers. It is possible that the true purpose of their attack was to give human beings a common enemy that would force them to band together and forget their internal struggles.
units.italian: I Pug sono spariti dallo spazio umano, lasciando dietro di sé più domande che risposte. È possibile che il vero scopo del loro attacco fosse dare agli esseri umani un nemico comune che li costringesse a unirsi e a dimenticare le loro lotte interne.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|As you bring your fleet in for a landing, you find that the main Pug spaceport is surprisingly empty. However, a group of Pug children are gathered in a loose circle on one of the landing pads. They appear to be playing some sort of game; they ignore your fleet overhead.|2407|0
units.english: As you bring your fleet in for a landing, you find that the main Pug spaceport is surprisingly empty. However, a group of Pug children are gathered in a loose circle on one of the landing pads. They appear to be playing some sort of game; they ignore your fleet overhead.
units.italian: Mentre porti la tua flotta ad atterrare, scopri che lo spazioporto principale dei Pug è sorprendentemente vuoto. Però un gruppo di bambini Pug è raccolto in cerchio su una delle piazzole. Sembrano giocare a qualcosa; ignorano la tua flotta sopra di loro.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|	(Attack them.)|2409|0
units.english: (Attack them.)
units.italian: (Attaccali.)

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|	(Avoid harming them and land.)|2410|0
units.english: (Avoid harming them and land.)
units.italian: (Evita di fargli del male e atterra.)

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|	You fire a single shot into the center of the circle, leaving a dark scar on the landing pad and sending a plume of dust and smoke into the air. The children continue their game, as if nothing has happened.|2413|0
units.english: You fire a single shot into the center of the circle, leaving a dark scar on the landing pad and sending a plume of dust and smoke into the air. The children continue their game, as if nothing has happened.
units.italian: Spara un solo colpo al centro del cerchio, lasciando una cicatrice scura sulla piazzola e sollevando una colonna di polvere e fumo. I bambini continuano il loro gioco, come se non fosse successo niente.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|	You land your ship near the circle of Pug children. They are bouncing a ball back and forth between them, and studiously ignoring your presence. Aside from the sound of the ball striking the pavement, the entire city is eerily quiet. "This is really weird," says Freya.|2415|0
units.english: You land your ship near the circle of Pug children. They are bouncing a ball back and forth between them, and studiously ignoring your presence. Aside from the sound of the ball striking the pavement, the entire city is eerily quiet. "This is really weird," says Freya.
units.italian: Fai atterrare la nave vicino al cerchio dei bambini Pug. Si passano una palla avanti e indietro, e ignorano ostinatamente la tua presenza. A parte il rumore della palla che colpisce l'asfalto, l'intera città è inquietantemente silenziosa. "È davvero strano," dice Freya.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|	(Explore the city.)|2417|0
units.english: (Explore the city.)
units.italian: (Esplora la città.)

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|	(Join the game.)|2419|0
units.english: (Join the game.)
units.italian: (Unisciti al gioco.)

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|	You step into the circle and make a grab for the ball, but it passes straight through your fingers. Freya reaches out to touch one of the children, and her hand, too, passes through them. "Some sort of holographic projection," she says.|2423|0
units.english: You step into the circle and make a grab for the ball, but it passes straight through your fingers. Freya reaches out to touch one of the children, and her hand, too, passes through them. "Some sort of holographic projection," she says.
units.italian: Entri nel cerchio e cerchi di afferrare la palla, ma ti passa dritta attraverso le dita. Freya allunga la mano per toccare uno dei bambini, e anche la sua mano li attraversa. "Qualche tipo di proiezione olografica," dice.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|	The Navy ships are beginning to land and send crew out to explore. You and Freya walk into the city, passing by a pair of adult Pug who sit at a table outside what looks like some sort of cafe, playing a board game with black and white stones on a hexagonal grid. You check and find that they, too, are a holographic illusion.|2424|0
units.english: The Navy ships are beginning to land and send crew out to explore. You and Freya walk into the city, passing by a pair of adult Pug who sit at a table outside what looks like some sort of cafe, playing a board game with black and white stones on a hexagonal grid. You check and find that they, too, are a holographic illusion.
units.italian: Le navi della Marina cominciano ad atterrare e a mandare gli equipaggi a esplorare. Tu e Freya entrate in città, passando accanto a due Pug adulti seduti a un tavolo fuori da quello che sembra una specie di caffè, che giocano a un gioco da tavolo con pietre bianche e nere su una griglia esagonale. Controlli e scopri che anche loro sono un'illusione olografica.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|	The Navy ships are beginning to land and send crew out to explore. You and Freya walk into the city. The streets are mostly deserted, but on one of them you pass by a pair of adult Pug who sit at a table outside what looks like some sort of cafe, playing a board game with black and white stones on a hexagonal grid.|2428|0
units.english: The Navy ships are beginning to land and send crew out to explore. You and Freya walk into the city. The streets are mostly deserted, but on one of them you pass by a pair of adult Pug who sit at a table outside what looks like some sort of cafe, playing a board game with black and white stones on a hexagonal grid.
units.italian: Le navi della Marina cominciano ad atterrare e a mandare gli equipaggi a esplorare. Tu e Freya entrate in città. Le strade sono per lo più deserte, ma in una passate accanto a due Pug adulti seduti a un tavolo fuori da quello che sembra una specie di caffè, che giocano a un gioco da tavolo con pietre bianche e nere su una griglia esagonale.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|	(Attack them.)|2430|0
units.english: (Attack them.)
units.italian: (Attaccali.)

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|	(Try to talk to them.)|2432|0
units.english: (Try to talk to them.)
units.italian: (Prova a parlare con loro.)

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|	You throw a punch at one of the Pug at the table, but your fist passes right through its head as if nothing is there. Surprised, Freya reaches out to touch the other one, and again her hand passes through them. "Some sort of holographic projection," she says. You continue exploring.|2436|0
units.english: You throw a punch at one of the Pug at the table, but your fist passes right through its head as if nothing is there. Surprised, Freya reaches out to touch the other one, and again her hand passes through them. "Some sort of holographic projection," she says. You continue exploring.
units.italian: Tiri un pugno a uno dei Pug al tavolo, ma il tuo pugno attraversa la sua testa come se non ci fosse nulla. Sorpresa, Freya allunga la mano per toccare l'altro, e di nuovo la sua mano li attraversa. "Qualche tipo di proiezione olografica," dice. Continuate a esplorare.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|	You try to talk to the Pug, but they, like the children, are ignoring you completely; they do not even seem to be aware of your existence. Finally, Freya reaches out to shake one of them by the shoulder, and her hand passes straight through it. Surprised, she waves her hands back and forth through both of them. "Some sort of holographic projection," she says.|2440|0
units.english: You try to talk to the Pug, but they, like the children, are ignoring you completely; they do not even seem to be aware of your existence. Finally, Freya reaches out to shake one of them by the shoulder, and her hand passes straight through it. Surprised, she waves her hands back and forth through both of them. "Some sort of holographic projection," she says.
units.italian: Provi a parlare con i Pug, ma loro, come i bambini, ti ignorano completamente; non sembrano nemmeno accorgersi della tua esistenza. Alla fine Freya allunga la mano per scuotere uno di loro per la spalla, e la sua mano lo attraversa. Sorpresa, agita le mani avanti e indietro attraverso entrambi. "Qualche tipo di proiezione olografica," dice.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|	You continue to explore for a while. Aside from the illusions, the city seems to be deserted. "Let's check inside one of the houses," Freya says at last. You climb up the steps to what looks like an apartment building and find that all the doors are unlocked. Inside one of the living spaces, you explore the different rooms and find that the water fixtures and electricity are working, but a thick layer of dust covers everything. Freya, meanwhile, is staring at one of the electrical outlets. "<first>," she says, "do you see anything odd about this?"|2444|0
units.english: You continue to explore for a while. Aside from the illusions, the city seems to be deserted. "Let's check inside one of the houses," Freya says at last. You climb up the steps to what looks like an apartment building and find that all the doors are unlocked. Inside one of the living spaces, you explore the different rooms and find that the water fixtures and electricity are working, but a thick layer of dust covers everything. Freya, meanwhile, is staring at one of the electrical outlets. "<first>," she says, "do you see anything odd about this?"
units.italian: Continuate a esplorare per un po'. A parte le illusioni, la città sembra deserta. "Diamo un'occhiata dentro una delle case," dice alla fine Freya. Salite i gradini di quello che sembra un edificio di appartamenti e scoprite che tutte le porte sono aperte. Dentro uno degli alloggi esplorate le varie stanze e scoprite che gli impianti idraulici e l'elettricità funzionano, ma uno spesso strato di polvere copre ogni cosa. Freya, intanto, fissa una delle prese elettriche. "<first>," dice, "ci vedi niente di strano?"

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|	"No, it's just an ordinary electric outlet."|2446|0
units.english: "No, it's just an ordinary electric outlet."
units.italian: "No, è una normale presa elettrica."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|	"Everything here is odd. The city, the holograms, all of it."|2447|0
units.english: "Everything here is odd. The city, the holograms, all of it."
units.italian: "Qui è tutto strano. La città, gli ologrammi, tutto."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|	She says, "It's an ordinary, human style electrical outlet. Human. In an alien city. And the steps we came up to get here: the Pug have legs half again as long as ours. But the tread spacing was at the normal human height. This building wasn't made for the Pug. It was made for us."|2448|0
units.english: She says, "It's an ordinary, human style electrical outlet. Human. In an alien city. And the steps we came up to get here: the Pug have legs half again as long as ours. But the tread spacing was at the normal human height. This building wasn't made for the Pug. It was made for us."
units.italian: Dice: "È una presa elettrica normale, di tipo umano. Umana. In una città aliena. E i gradini che abbiamo salito per arrivare qui: i Pug hanno le gambe una volta e mezza le nostre. Ma l'altezza dei gradini era quella normale per un umano. Questo edificio non è stato fatto per i Pug. È stato fatto per noi."

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|	Reports begin coming in as the Navy explores the rest of the planet, and they are all finding the same thing: the cities are abandoned, many of them with signs that they were never inhabited in the first place. The first time you visited this planet, you thought it must have a billion inhabitants, but now it seems that its true population was less than a million - all of whom have apparently departed to somewhere beyond the wormhole.|2449|0
units.english: Reports begin coming in as the Navy explores the rest of the planet, and they are all finding the same thing: the cities are abandoned, many of them with signs that they were never inhabited in the first place. The first time you visited this planet, you thought it must have a billion inhabitants, but now it seems that its true population was less than a million - all of whom have apparently departed to somewhere beyond the wormhole.
units.italian: Cominciano ad arrivare rapporti mentre la Marina esplora il resto del pianeta, e trovano tutti la stessa cosa: le città sono abbandonate, molte con segni che non sono mai state abitate. La prima volta che hai visitato questo pianeta, hai pensato che dovesse avere un miliardo di abitanti, ma ora sembra che la popolazione reale fosse meno di un milione: tutti quanti, a quanto pare, partiti verso un luogo oltre il wormhole.

units.id: mission:FW Pug 6|	Freya says, "Let's get back to the spaceport and meet up with the admirals."|2450|0
units.english: Freya says, "Let's get back to the spaceport and meet up with the admirals."
units.italian: Freya dice: "Torniamo allo spazioporto e incontriamo gli ammiragli."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1|name|2455|0
units.english: Deal with the Syndicate
units.italian: Sistemare il Sindacato

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1|description|2456|0
units.english: Now that the Pug appear to have been driven off, it's time to get some answers from the Syndicate. Travel with Admiral Danforth back to <destination> for another meeting with the CEO of the Syndicate.
units.italian: Ora che i Pug sembrano essere stati scacciati, è il momento di ottenere qualche risposta dal Sindacato. Torna con l'ammiraglio Danforth su <destination> per un altro incontro con l'amministratore delegato del Sindacato.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1|When you and Freya get back to the spaceport, Danforth pulls you aside. "We should talk," he says. He leads you to a private room aboard his ship, and says, "It seems that we've reached the end of whatever game these aliens were playing with us. And that means we need to get back to what we were doing before they interrupted us: bringing the Syndicate to justice."|2468|0
units.english: When you and Freya get back to the spaceport, Danforth pulls you aside. "We should talk," he says. He leads you to a private room aboard his ship, and says, "It seems that we've reached the end of whatever game these aliens were playing with us. And that means we need to get back to what we were doing before they interrupted us: bringing the Syndicate to justice."
units.italian: Quando tu e Freya tornate allo spazioporto, Danforth ti tira da parte. "Dobbiamo parlare," dice. Ti porta in una stanza privata a bordo della sua nave e dice: "Sembra che siamo arrivati alla fine di qualsiasi gioco questi alieni stessero facendo con noi. Il che significa che dobbiamo tornare a quello che stavamo facendo prima che ci interrompessero: portare il Sindacato davanti alla giustizia."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1|	"Sounds good. What's your plan?"|2470|0
units.english: "Sounds good. What's your plan?"
units.italian: "Mi sembra bene. Qual è il tuo piano?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1|	"We just fought a major battle, and the Syndicate helped us. Do we really want to be at war with them again?"|2472|0
units.english: "We just fought a major battle, and the Syndicate helped us. Do we really want to be at war with them again?"
units.italian: "Abbiamo appena combattuto una grande battaglia, e il Sindacato ci ha aiutato. Vogliamo davvero essere di nuovo in guerra con loro?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1|	Danforth sighs. "No, I don't want more war. But I also don't think we can go back to trusting the Syndicate. Especially now that we know they've got nuclear weapons."|2474|0
units.english: Danforth sighs. "No, I don't want more war. But I also don't think we can go back to trusting the Syndicate. Especially now that we know they've got nuclear weapons."
units.italian: Danforth sospira. "No, non voglio altra guerra. Ma non credo nemmeno che possiamo tornare a fidarci del Sindacato. Soprattutto ora che sappiamo che hanno armi nucleari."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1|	"What's your plan, then?" asks Freya.|2475|0
units.english: "What's your plan, then?" asks Freya.
units.italian: "Allora qual è il tuo piano?" chiede Freya.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1|	"From what I've heard of your conversation with their CEO, Korban," says Danforth, "I think the Syndicate leadership might be willing to surrender these extremists to us. Especially if it helps the leaders to clear their own names. I'm thinking we should stop by the Syndicate headquarters while the rest of their fleet is still occupied here. If just my ship and yours leave, it won't attract too much attention."|2477|0
units.english: "From what I've heard of your conversation with their CEO, Korban," says Danforth, "I think the Syndicate leadership might be willing to surrender these extremists to us. Especially if it helps the leaders to clear their own names. I'm thinking we should stop by the Syndicate headquarters while the rest of their fleet is still occupied here. If just my ship and yours leave, it won't attract too much attention."
units.italian: "Da quello che ho sentito della vostra conversazione con il loro amministratore delegato, Korban," dice Danforth, "credo che la dirigenza del Sindacato sia disposta a consegnarci questi estremisti. Soprattutto se questo aiuta i capi a ripulire la propria reputazione. Pensavo che dovremmo passare dal quartier generale del Sindacato mentre il resto della loro flotta è ancora impegnato qui. Se partono solo la mia nave e la tua, non attirerà troppo l'attenzione."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|name|2492|0
units.english: Cloaking Device
units.italian: Dispositivo di occultamento

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|description|2493|0
units.english: Alastair Korban has agreed to give you a cloaking device that will allow you to evade missile attacks. Travel to Hephaestus, where they will install the device on your ship.
units.italian: Alastair Korban ha accettato di darti un dispositivo di occultamento che ti permetterà di evitare gli attacchi missilistici. Va' su Hephaestus, dove installeranno il dispositivo sulla tua nave.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|log|2504|0
units.english: With the Pug defeated, it is finally time to deal with the Syndicate extremists and the Alphas that they allied with. The extremists are armed with nuclear missiles, but the Syndicate CEO has agreed to provide a cloaking device that will make it possible to dodge the missiles.
units.italian: Con i Pug sconfitti, è finalmente il momento di occuparsi degli estremisti del Sindacato e degli Alphas a cui si sono alleati. Gli estremisti sono armati di missili nucleari, ma l'amministratore delegato del Sindacato ha accettato di fornire un dispositivo di occultamento che renderà possibile schivare i missili.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|log|2505|0
units.english: Following the defeat of the Pug, Korban has revealed that the "extremist faction" of the Syndicate collaborated with Alphas in starting the human civil war, ostensibly to prevent humanity from entering a new dark age. This revelation has resulted in his resignation from his position as CEO of the Syndicate.
units.italian: Dopo la sconfitta dei Pug, Korban ha rivelato che la "fazione estremista" del Sindacato ha collaborato con gli Alphas per far cominciare la guerra civile umana, apparentemente per impedire all'umanità di entrare in una nuova età oscura. Questa rivelazione ha portato alle sue dimissioni dalla carica di amministratore delegato del Sindacato.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|The presence of a Navy Cruiser in orbit seldom goes unnoticed, especially a Cruiser captained by someone as famous as William Danforth. As soon as you land, a Syndicate employee meets you and escorts you, Freya, and Danforth to the office of Alastair Korban, the CEO. He does not seem very happy to see you. "I only just got word that the aliens were defeated a few days ago," he says. "I'm surprised you're back here already."|2507|0
units.english: The presence of a Navy Cruiser in orbit seldom goes unnoticed, especially a Cruiser captained by someone as famous as William Danforth. As soon as you land, a Syndicate employee meets you and escorts you, Freya, and Danforth to the office of Alastair Korban, the CEO. He does not seem very happy to see you. "I only just got word that the aliens were defeated a few days ago," he says. "I'm surprised you're back here already."
units.italian: La presenza di un incrociatore della Marina in orbita raramente passa inosservata, soprattutto un incrociatore comandato da qualcuno famoso come William Danforth. Appena atterri, un dipendente del Sindacato vi incontra e scorta te, Freya e Danforth nell'ufficio di Alastair Korban, l'amministratore delegato. Non sembra molto felice di vedervi. "Ho saputo solo pochi giorni fa che gli alieni erano stati sconfitti," dice. "Mi sorprende che siate già di nuovo qui."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	Danforth says, "I've got a whole Navy fleet just a few jumps away from here who are itching to destroy something. So here's the deal. You name me some targets: the men who were responsible for the terrorist attack. Then I will do you a favor and take them off your hands. Fair enough?"|2508|0
units.english: Danforth says, "I've got a whole Navy fleet just a few jumps away from here who are itching to destroy something. So here's the deal. You name me some targets: the men who were responsible for the terrorist attack. Then I will do you a favor and take them off your hands. Fair enough?"
units.italian: Danforth dice: "Ho un'intera flotta della Marina a pochi salti da qui che non vede l'ora di distruggere qualcosa. Quindi ecco l'accordo. Fammi dei nomi: gli uomini responsabili dell'attentato terroristico. Poi ti farò un favore e me ne porterò via le mani. Ti sta bene?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	Korban sighs, and then opens his desk and pulls out a sheet of paper. "This is my resignation letter," he says. "I've been working on it since my first meeting with Captain <last>. I've failed in my leadership of this company. But you have no idea how deep that failure goes."|2509|0
units.english: Korban sighs, and then opens his desk and pulls out a sheet of paper. "This is my resignation letter," he says. "I've been working on it since my first meeting with Captain <last>. I've failed in my leadership of this company. But you have no idea how deep that failure goes."
units.italian: Korban sospira, poi apre il cassetto della scrivania e tira fuori un foglio di carta. "Questa è la mia lettera di dimissioni," dice. "Ci lavoro dal mio primo incontro con il capitano <last>. Ho fallito nella guida di questa azienda. Ma non avete idea di quanto in profondità arrivi quel fallimento."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	"What do you mean?"|2511|0
units.english: "What do you mean?"
units.italian: "Che cosa vuoi dire?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	"Years ago," he says, "some leaders of our financial division were approached by some... consultants. Some very intelligent and knowledgeable individuals. These consultants had built a powerful quantum computer, running a model of the galactic economy. They called it the 'Oracle.' As you may know, business is all about taking risks, for uncertain payoffs. But the Oracle gave us a way to predict the future, for everything from supply chain management to stock trading to the commodities market."|2513|0
units.english: "Years ago," he says, "some leaders of our financial division were approached by some... consultants. Some very intelligent and knowledgeable individuals. These consultants had built a powerful quantum computer, running a model of the galactic economy. They called it the 'Oracle.' As you may know, business is all about taking risks, for uncertain payoffs. But the Oracle gave us a way to predict the future, for everything from supply chain management to stock trading to the commodities market."
units.italian: "Anni fa," dice, "alcuni dirigenti della nostra divisione finanziaria sono stati avvicinati da quelli che... consulenti. Individui molto intelligenti e ben informati. Questi consulenti avevano costruito un potente computer quantistico, che eseguiva un modello dell'economia galattica. Lo chiamavano l''Oracolo'. Come forse saprete, gli affari consistono nel correre rischi per guadagni incerti. Ma l'Oracolo ci dava un modo per prevedere il futuro, da tutto ciò che riguarda la gestione della catena di approvvigionamento al trading azionario al mercato delle materie prime."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	"These consultants," says Freya, "were they human?"|2514|0
units.english: "These consultants," says Freya, "were they human?"
units.italian: "Questi consulenti," dice Freya, "erano umani?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	Alastair looks very uncomfortable. "Yes... and no," he says.|2515|0
units.english: Alastair looks very uncomfortable. "Yes... and no," he says.
units.italian: Alastair sembra molto a disagio. "Sì... e no," dice.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	Danforth swears. "Alphas. You were dealing with the Alphas. What did you give them in return?"|2516|0
units.english: Danforth swears. "Alphas. You were dealing with the Alphas. What did you give them in return?"
units.italian: Danforth impreca. "Alphas. Avevate a che fare con gli Alphas. Che cosa gli avete dato in cambio?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	"The Korath raids had just begun," says Alastair, "so we suddenly had access to alien technology. They were interested in all of it, but particularly the jump drives. So they could spread beyond human space."|2517|0
units.english: "The Korath raids had just begun," says Alastair, "so we suddenly had access to alien technology. They were interested in all of it, but particularly the jump drives. So they could spread beyond human space."
units.italian: "Le incursioni dei Korath erano appena cominciate," dice Alastair, "quindi all'improvviso avevamo accesso a tecnologia aliena. A loro interessava tutta, ma in particolare i motori di salto. Così potevano diffondersi oltre lo spazio umano."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	"Was the information from the Oracle accurate?"|2519|0
units.english: "Was the information from the Oracle accurate?"
units.italian: "Le informazioni dell'Oracolo erano accurate?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	"Why would you ever agree to work with the Alphas?"|2521|0
units.english: "Why would you ever agree to work with the Alphas?"
units.italian: "Perché avete mai accettato di lavorare con gli Alphas?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	"They have power. And knowledge. To some of us, that was enough," he says.|2523|0
units.english: "They have power. And knowledge. To some of us, that was enough," he says.
units.italian: "Hanno potere. E conoscenza. Per alcuni di noi era abbastanza," dice.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	"Was that knowledge accurate?" asks Freya.|2524|0
units.english: "Was that knowledge accurate?" asks Freya.
units.italian: "Quella conoscenza era accurata?" chiede Freya.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	"Very accurate," he says. "Our business flourished like never before. But then a month came when instead, the Oracle's predictions were bleak. A massive recession was coming, an end to the golden days of the Republic. We tried altering the model in every way we could: changing our production, our wages. We even asked the Oracle if dissolving the Syndicate would avert the recession. But its predictions remained the same. Then we learned from our contacts in Parliament about the Southern Defense Pact, and the fear that they were about to declare independence. So we asked the Oracle what would happen if war broke out."|2526|0
units.english: "Very accurate," he says. "Our business flourished like never before. But then a month came when instead, the Oracle's predictions were bleak. A massive recession was coming, an end to the golden days of the Republic. We tried altering the model in every way we could: changing our production, our wages. We even asked the Oracle if dissolving the Syndicate would avert the recession. But its predictions remained the same. Then we learned from our contacts in Parliament about the Southern Defense Pact, and the fear that they were about to declare independence. So we asked the Oracle what would happen if war broke out."
units.italian: "Molto accurata," dice. "I nostri affari prosperavano come mai prima. Ma poi è arrivato un mese in cui invece le previsioni dell'Oracolo erano cupe. Stava arrivando una recessione enorme, la fine dei giorni d'oro della Repubblica. Abbiamo provato a modificare il modello in tutti i modi possibili: cambiando la produzione, i salari. Abbiamo persino chiesto all'Oracolo se sciogliere il Sindacato avrebbe evitato la recessione. Ma le sue previsioni restavano le stesse. Poi abbiamo saputo dai nostri contatti in Parlamento del Patto di Difesa del Sud, e del timore che stessero per dichiarare l'indipendenza. Così abbiamo chiesto all'Oracolo che cosa sarebbe successo se fosse scoppiata una guerra."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	"You started a war... to save the economy?" says Danforth. He sounds disgusted. "Do you know how many lives have been lost because of your sick greed?"|2527|0
units.english: "You started a war... to save the economy?" says Danforth. He sounds disgusted. "Do you know how many lives have been lost because of your sick greed?"
units.italian: "Avete iniziato una guerra... per salvare l'economia?" dice Danforth. Sembra disgustato. "Sapete quante vite sono andate perdute per la vostra avidità malata?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	Alastair snaps at Danforth. "Do you think we made this decision lightly? Do you know how many lives would have been lost had such a recession actually occurred? The last time the economy fell as hard as the Oracle predicted, humanity entered a dark age where millions died of starvation and billions more suffered from the resulting chaos!|2528|0
units.english: Alastair snaps at Danforth. "Do you think we made this decision lightly? Do you know how many lives would have been lost had such a recession actually occurred? The last time the economy fell as hard as the Oracle predicted, humanity entered a dark age where millions died of starvation and billions more suffered from the resulting chaos!
units.italian: Alastair si rivolta contro Danforth. "Credi che abbiamo preso questa decisione alla leggera? Sai quante vite sarebbero andate perdute se quella recessione si fosse davvero verificata? L'ultima volta che l'economia è crollata così duramente come prevedeva l'Oracolo, l'umanità è entrata in un'età oscura in cui milioni sono morti di fame e miliardi hanno sofferto per il caos che ne è seguito!

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	"But... the Alphas were only too glad to help. Especially with the nuclear research. Which, incidentally, is why I'm telling you all this, because if your fleet tries to take out the Alphas, they'll strike back with nukes."|2529|0
units.english: "But... the Alphas were only too glad to help. Especially with the nuclear research. Which, incidentally, is why I'm telling you all this, because if your fleet tries to take out the Alphas, they'll strike back with nukes."
units.italian: "Ma... gli Alphas non chiedevano di meglio che aiutare. Soprattutto con la ricerca nucleare. Il che, per inciso, è il motivo per cui vi sto dicendo tutto questo, perché se la vostra flotta prova a eliminare gli Alphas, risponderanno con le testate."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	"Do you have an alternative to attacking them?"|2531|0
units.english: "Do you have an alternative to attacking them?"
units.italian: "Avete un'alternativa ad attaccarli?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	"Is there any way we could disable the nukes?"|2532|0
units.english: "Is there any way we could disable the nukes?"
units.italian: "C'è un modo per disattivare le testate?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	"We gave the Alphas most of the alien technology we recovered," he says, "but one device, we managed to keep secret from them. We found it in a Korath cargo hold, and it took us a long time to even figure out how to activate it. But when we did, we discovered that it's a cloaking device. It obscures a ship not just from the visible spectrum, but from radar as well, and every other sensor we've tested except for gravitational ones. I'm certain it would hide you from the tracking systems on the nukes."|2534|0
units.english: "We gave the Alphas most of the alien technology we recovered," he says, "but one device, we managed to keep secret from them. We found it in a Korath cargo hold, and it took us a long time to even figure out how to activate it. But when we did, we discovered that it's a cloaking device. It obscures a ship not just from the visible spectrum, but from radar as well, and every other sensor we've tested except for gravitational ones. I'm certain it would hide you from the tracking systems on the nukes."
units.italian: "Abbiamo dato agli Alphas la maggior parte della tecnologia aliena che abbiamo recuperato," dice, "ma un dispositivo siamo riusciti a tenerlo segreto. L'abbiamo trovato in una stiva Korath, e ci è voluto molto tempo solo per capire come attivarlo. Ma quando ci siamo riusciti, abbiamo scoperto che è un dispositivo di occultamento. Nasconde una nave non solo dallo spettro visibile, ma anche dal radar, e da ogni altro sensore che abbiamo provato tranne quelli gravitazionali. Sono certo che ti nasconderebbe dai sistemi di tracciamento delle testate."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	Freya says, "But it would only hide one ship. That doesn't sound like it would do much good."|2535|0
units.english: Freya says, "But it would only hide one ship. That doesn't sound like it would do much good."
units.italian: Freya dice: "Ma nasconderebbe solo una nave. Non mi sembra che sarebbe di grande aiuto."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	Alastair says, "They have a limited number of nukes. Our plan was to send a ship in cloaked, have it uncloak long enough to draw their fire, and then cloak to avoid the missiles. Basically, see how many missiles we can get them to spend before the main attack fleet arrives."|2536|0
units.english: Alastair says, "They have a limited number of nukes. Our plan was to send a ship in cloaked, have it uncloak long enough to draw their fire, and then cloak to avoid the missiles. Basically, see how many missiles we can get them to spend before the main attack fleet arrives."
units.italian: Alastair dice: "Hanno un numero limitato di testate. Il nostro piano era mandare una nave occultata, farla smascherare quel tanto che basta per attirare il loro fuoco, e poi occultarla di nuovo per evitare i missili. In pratica, vedere quante testate riusciamo a far loro spendere prima che arrivi la flotta d'attacco principale."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	Danforth says, "That's not a bad idea. Captain <last>, would you be willing to serve as the decoy?"|2537|0
units.english: Danforth says, "That's not a bad idea. Captain <last>, would you be willing to serve as the decoy?"
units.italian: Danforth dice: "Non è una cattiva idea. Capitano <last>, saresti disposto a fare da esca?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	"It sounds risky, but I'll do it."|2539|0
units.english: "It sounds risky, but I'll do it."
units.italian: "Sembra rischioso, ma lo farò."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	"Do I get to keep the cloaking device when I'm done?"|2541|0
units.english: "Do I get to keep the cloaking device when I'm done?"
units.italian: "Posso tenermi il dispositivo di occultamento quando avremo finito?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	"I don't see why not," says Danforth, fixing Alastair with a piercing gaze. "It's certainly better than leaving it in Syndicate hands."|2543|0
units.english: "I don't see why not," says Danforth, fixing Alastair with a piercing gaze. "It's certainly better than leaving it in Syndicate hands."
units.italian: "Non vedo perché no," dice Danforth, fissando Alastair con uno sguardo penetrante. "È certamente meglio che lasciarlo nelle mani del Sindacato."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	Alastair tells you that the device is being kept on Hephaestus, and the engineers there can install it in your ship. Meanwhile, Danforth will call in the rest of his Oathkeeper fleet. "And when we're through with this, I'll be seeing to it that this Oracle is destroyed so that this can never happen again," says Danforth. Alastair gives a meek nod in agreement. "Now, where are the Alphas?"|2545|0
units.english: Alastair tells you that the device is being kept on Hephaestus, and the engineers there can install it in your ship. Meanwhile, Danforth will call in the rest of his Oathkeeper fleet. "And when we're through with this, I'll be seeing to it that this Oracle is destroyed so that this can never happen again," says Danforth. Alastair gives a meek nod in agreement. "Now, where are the Alphas?"
units.italian: Alastair ti dice che il dispositivo è tenuto su Hephaestus, e che gli ingegneri lì possono installarlo sulla tua nave. Nel frattempo Danforth richiamerà il resto della sua flotta di Oathkeepers. "E quando avremo finito con questa storia, mi assicurerò che questo Oracolo venga distrutto, perché non possa mai più succedere," dice Danforth. Alastair accenna un cenno remissivo d'assenso. "Ora, dove sono gli Alphas?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1A|	"The Alphas are holed up on Buccaneer Bay," says Alastair, "an old pirate world. Good luck in defeating them."|2546|0
units.english: "The Alphas are holed up on Buccaneer Bay," says Alastair, "an old pirate world. Good luck in defeating them."
units.italian: "Gli Alphas sono trincerati su Buccaneer Bay," dice Alastair, "un vecchio mondo pirata. Buona fortuna a sconfiggerli."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1B|name|2561|0
units.english: Final Battle
units.italian: Battaglia finale

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1B|description|2562|0
units.english: A fleet of nuclear-armed Syndicate extremists controlled by the Alphas is occupying the <system> system. Travel there and use the cloaking device to draw their fire; the Oathkeeper fleet will be right behind you.
units.italian: Una flotta di estremisti del Sindacato armati di testate nucleari, controllata dagli Alphas, occupa il sistema <system>. Va' lì e usa il dispositivo di occultamento per attirare il loro fuoco; la flotta degli Oathkeepers sarà subito dietro di te.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1B|You land in the same private hangar that you visited previously to have the jump drive installed, and you think these engineers are the same crew that met you back then. "This thing is almost as bizarre as the jump drive itself," one of them says. "We have no clue how it works, and we weren't done studying it when Korban ordered us to give it to you, so please don't get yourself blown up. Okay?"|2577|0
