units.english: You land in the same private hangar that you visited previously to have the jump drive installed, and you think these engineers are the same crew that met you back then. "This thing is almost as bizarre as the jump drive itself," one of them says. "We have no clue how it works, and we weren't done studying it when Korban ordered us to give it to you, so please don't get yourself blown up. Okay?"
units.italian: Atterri nello stesso hangar privato in cui eri già stato per farti installare il motore di salto, e pensi che questi ingegneri siano gli stessi che ti avevano accolto allora. "Questa cosa è quasi bizzarra quanto il motore di salto stesso," dice uno di loro. "Non abbiamo idea di come funzioni, e non avevamo finito di studiarla quando Korban ci ha ordinato di dartela, quindi per favore non farti saltare in aria. Va bene?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1B|	Meanwhile, Danforth is on his way back to Deneb to rally the Oathkeepers. You should head directly for the <system> system, so that you arrive there far enough in advance of the Oathkeeper fleet.|2578|0
units.english: Meanwhile, Danforth is on his way back to Deneb to rally the Oathkeepers. You should head directly for the <system> system, so that you arrive there far enough in advance of the Oathkeeper fleet.
units.italian: Nel frattempo Danforth è in viaggio verso Deneb per radunare gli Oathkeepers. Dovresti puntare dritto verso il sistema <system>, così da arrivarci con sufficiente anticipo rispetto alla flotta degli Oathkeepers.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1B|dialog|2581|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but there are still Syndicate ships circling overhead. You should take off and help finish them off.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ci sono ancora navi del Sindacato che girano là sopra. Dovresti decollare e aiutare a finirle.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|name|2648|0
units.english: Report to Parliament
units.italian: Riferisci al Parlamento

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|description|2649|0
units.english: Return to Earth to report to Parliament on the resolution of the conflicts with the Pug and with the Syndicate extremists.
units.italian: Torna sulla Terra per riferire al Parlamento sulla risoluzione dei conflitti con i Pug e con gli estremisti del Sindacato.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|log|2661|0
units.english: Succeeded in drawing the fire of the Syndicate extremists for long enough for a Navy fleet to safely arrive in-system and assist in destroying them. This cloaking device will come in very handy in the future.
units.italian: Sei riuscito ad attirare il fuoco degli estremisti del Sindacato abbastanza a lungo perché una flotta della Marina arrivasse in sicurezza nel sistema e aiutasse a distruggerli. Questo dispositivo di occultamento sarà molto utile in futuro.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|Soon after you land, more Navy ships begin pouring into the system, including Admiral Danforth's own Cruiser. Navy soldiers and ships are scouring the whole surface of the planet; there is very little chance that any of the Alphas who remain here will be able to escape their detection. Admiral Danforth meets with you and Freya and thanks you for providing the decoy that kept his own ships from bearing the brunt of the Alphas' nuclear arsenal.|2665|0
units.english: Soon after you land, more Navy ships begin pouring into the system, including Admiral Danforth's own Cruiser. Navy soldiers and ships are scouring the whole surface of the planet; there is very little chance that any of the Alphas who remain here will be able to escape their detection. Admiral Danforth meets with you and Freya and thanks you for providing the decoy that kept his own ships from bearing the brunt of the Alphas' nuclear arsenal.
units.italian: Poco dopo l'atterraggio, altre navi della Marina cominciano a riversarsi nel sistema, compreso l'incrociatore personale dell'ammiraglio Danforth. Soldati e navi della Marina stanno setacciando tutta la superficie del pianeta; c'è pochissima possibilità che qualcuno degli Alphas rimasti qui riesca a sfuggire alla loro individuazione. L'ammiraglio Danforth incontra te e Freya e vi ringrazia per l'esca che ha risparmiato alle sue navi il peso maggiore dell'arsenale nucleare degli Alphas.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|	"Do you need us to do anything more here?" asks Freya.|2666|0
units.english: "Do you need us to do anything more here?" asks Freya.
units.italian: "Ti serve che facciamo ancora qualcosa qui?" chiede Freya.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|	"No," he says, "and I hear that Parliament wants to speak with you, Captain <last>. Something about an official commendation for your part in the battle against the Pug, I think. Meanwhile, this may not be the end of our trouble with the Syndicate, but at least it's a good start. It's been an honor to fight alongside you."|2667|0
units.english: "No," he says, "and I hear that Parliament wants to speak with you, Captain <last>. Something about an official commendation for your part in the battle against the Pug, I think. Meanwhile, this may not be the end of our trouble with the Syndicate, but at least it's a good start. It's been an honor to fight alongside you."
units.italian: "No," dice, "e sento che il Parlamento vuole parlare con te, capitano <last>. Qualcosa su una menzione ufficiale per la tua parte nella battaglia contro i Pug, credo. Nel frattempo, questa potrebbe non essere la fine dei nostri problemi con il Sindacato, ma almeno è un buon inizio. È stato un onore combattere al tuo fianco."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|	"You too, sir."|2669|0
units.english: "You too, sir."
units.italian: "Altrettanto, signore."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|	"You mean this is the end? No more battles to fight?"|2671|0
units.english: "You mean this is the end? No more battles to fight?"
units.italian: "Vuoi dire che questa è la fine? Niente più battaglie da combattere?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|	"What, does peace and reconciliation sound boring to you?" he says. "Don't worry about that. With that jump drive installed in your ship, the whole galaxy is open to you. Who knows what you might discover beyond the boundaries of human space?"|2673|0
units.english: "What, does peace and reconciliation sound boring to you?" he says. "Don't worry about that. With that jump drive installed in your ship, the whole galaxy is open to you. Who knows what you might discover beyond the boundaries of human space?"
units.italian: "Che cosa, la pace e la riconciliazione ti sembrano noiose?" dice. "Non preoccuparti. Con quel motore di salto installato sulla tua nave, l'intera galassia ti è aperta. Chissà che cosa potresti scoprire oltre i confini dello spazio umano?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|	You return to your ship, and prepare for the journey back to Earth, hopeful that at last Parliament will be willing to negotiate a permanent peace with the Free Worlds.|2675|0
units.english: You return to your ship, and prepare for the journey back to Earth, hopeful that at last Parliament will be willing to negotiate a permanent peace with the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Torni alla tua nave e ti prepari al viaggio di ritorno sulla Terra, sperando che finalmente il Parlamento sia disposto a negoziare una pace duratura con le Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|dialog|2679|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Freya hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Freya non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|log|2681|0
units.english: Received an official commendation from Parliament and a promise that the war with the Free Worlds are officially over. Humanity is at peace once more, but new challenges may await in the star systems out beyond human space that are accessible only by jump drive.
units.italian: Hai ricevuto una menzione ufficiale dal Parlamento e la promessa che la guerra con le Free Worlds è ufficialmente finita. L'umanità è di nuovo in pace, ma nuove sfide potrebbero attendere nei sistemi stellari oltre lo spazio umano, raggiungibili solo con un motore di salto.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|log|2682|0
units.english: Tensions between the Free Worlds and the Republic mounted when additional systems decided to leave the Republic and join the Free Worlds, culminating in a series of military confrontations that ended when the Free Worlds were able to present credible evidence denying any involvement in the terrorist attacks. After the Free Worlds joined the effort to drive out the Pug invaders, the Republic officially recognized the Free Worlds and diplomatic relations were established.
units.italian: Le tensioni fra le Free Worlds e la Repubblica crebbero quando altri sistemi decisero di lasciare la Repubblica e unirsi alle Free Worlds, culminando in una serie di scontri militari che terminarono quando le Free Worlds riuscirono a presentare prove credibili che negavano qualsiasi coinvolgimento negli attentati terroristici. Dopo che le Free Worlds si unirono allo sforzo per scacciare gli invasori Pug, la Repubblica riconobbe ufficialmente le Free Worlds e furono stabilite relazioni diplomatiche.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|log|2683|0
units.english: It was exposed that the bombings of Geminus and Martini that helped cause the war between the Republic and Free Worlds were the doing of the Syndicate, designed by top executives with the help of a group of Alphas. Despite the claims that all the extremists responsible have been purged and handed over to the Navy, the reputation of the Syndicate will be damaged for years to come.
units.italian: È emerso che gli attentati di Geminus e Martini che contribuirono a causare la guerra fra la Repubblica e le Free Worlds furono opera del Sindacato, progettati da dirigenti di primo piano con l'aiuto di un gruppo di Alphas. Nonostante le dichiarazioni che tutti gli estremisti responsabili siano stati epurati e consegnati alla Marina, la reputazione del Sindacato resterà danneggiata per anni.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|On Earth, you return to something of a hero's welcome, far different from the first time you were here on a diplomatic mission. A crowd of locals gathers in the spaceport to watch your ship land. With the Free Worlds having been instrumental in defeating the aliens, and absolved of any guilt in the terrorist attacks, it seems that most people here are ready to see you as a hero rather than a criminal.|2691|0
units.english: On Earth, you return to something of a hero's welcome, far different from the first time you were here on a diplomatic mission. A crowd of locals gathers in the spaceport to watch your ship land. With the Free Worlds having been instrumental in defeating the aliens, and absolved of any guilt in the terrorist attacks, it seems that most people here are ready to see you as a hero rather than a criminal.
units.italian: Sulla Terra trovi una specie di accoglienza da eroe, molto diversa dalla prima volta che sei stato qui in missione diplomatica. Una folla di gente del posto si raduna allo spazioporto per vedere atterrare la tua nave. Dato che le Free Worlds sono state determinanti nel sconfiggere gli alieni e sono state scagionate da ogni colpa negli attentati, sembra che la maggior parte della gente qui sia pronta a vederti come un eroe invece che come un criminale.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|	Your meeting with Parliament is long and grueling, as they press you and Freya for every detail you can give them about the enigmatic Pug and their apparent motivation in invading human space. The questions about the Syndicate are equally hard to answer. But at the end of the session, one of the members of Parliament informs you that they have authorized an official commendation for you, along with a reward of five million credits "to cover any of your expenses from fighting the aliens."|2692|0
units.english: Your meeting with Parliament is long and grueling, as they press you and Freya for every detail you can give them about the enigmatic Pug and their apparent motivation in invading human space. The questions about the Syndicate are equally hard to answer. But at the end of the session, one of the members of Parliament informs you that they have authorized an official commendation for you, along with a reward of five million credits "to cover any of your expenses from fighting the aliens."
units.italian: Il tuo incontro con il Parlamento è lungo e faticoso, perché ti incalzano, te e Freya, per ogni dettaglio che potete dare loro sugli enigmatici Pug e sulla loro apparente motivazione nell'invadere lo spazio umano. Le domande sul Sindacato sono altrettanto difficili. Ma alla fine della sessione uno dei membri del Parlamento ti informa che hanno autorizzato una menzione ufficiale per te, insieme a una ricompensa di cinque milioni di crediti "per coprire qualsiasi spesa sostenuta combattendo gli alieni".

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|	As you walk out, you find Alondo, JJ, and Katya sitting in the courtyard of Parliament. When they spot you walking towards them, JJ waves and says, "<first> and Freya! Am I glad to see the two of you still in one piece! What brings you to Earth?"|2693|0
units.english: As you walk out, you find Alondo, JJ, and Katya sitting in the courtyard of Parliament. When they spot you walking towards them, JJ waves and says, "<first> and Freya! Am I glad to see the two of you still in one piece! What brings you to Earth?"
units.italian: Mentre esci, trovi Alondo, JJ e Katya seduti nel cortile del Parlamento. Quando ti vedono arrivare verso di loro, JJ ti saluta con la mano e dice: "<first> e Freya! Come sono contento di vedervi ancora tutti interi! Che cosa vi porta sulla Terra?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|	"I received a commendation from Parliament."|2695|0
units.english: "I received a commendation from Parliament."
units.italian: "Ho ricevuto una menzione dal Parlamento."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|	"Parliament wanted to interrogate us on what happened with the Pug and the Syndicate."|2696|0
units.english: "Parliament wanted to interrogate us on what happened with the Pug and the Syndicate."
units.italian: "Il Parlamento voleva interrogarci su quello che è successo con i Pug e con il Sindacato."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|	"We just needed to deal with some boring administrative stuff."|2698|0
units.english: "We just needed to deal with some boring administrative stuff."
units.italian: "Dovevamo solo sbrigare un po' di noiose faccende amministrative."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|	"And I'm sure that it was very well deserved," says Katya with a smirk.|2700|0
units.english: "And I'm sure that it was very well deserved," says Katya with a smirk.
units.italian: "E sono sicura che se l'è meritata tutta," dice Katya con un sorriso sornione.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|	"I hope that they were nicer questioning you than they were to me," Katya says with a grin.|2704|0
units.english: "I hope that they were nicer questioning you than they were to me," Katya says with a grin.
units.italian: "Spero che siano stati più gentili a interrogare te di quanto lo siano stati con me," dice Katya con un sorriso.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|	"Well," Katya says while smirking, "You'll be glad to know that you aren't alone in grappling with the bureaucracy."|2708|0
units.english: "Well," Katya says while smirking, "You'll be glad to know that you aren't alone in grappling with the bureaucracy."
units.italian: "Beh," dice Katya con un sorriso sornione, "ti farà piacere sapere che non sei il solo ad avere a che fare con la burocrazia."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|	"What have you three been doing?" Freya asks.|2711|0
units.english: "What have you three been doing?" Freya asks.
units.italian: "Che cosa avete fatto voi tre?" chiede Freya.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|	Alondo says, "We've been talking to Parliament, and they're finally beginning to let off of us. They have signed a treaty with the Free Worlds, agreeing that the Navy will begin pulling out of any occupied systems, and that the Free Worlds will be allowed autonomy in the region they currently control as long as they do not seek to expand their territory further. As of now, our war against the Republic is officially over."|2715|0
units.english: Alondo says, "We've been talking to Parliament, and they're finally beginning to let off of us. They have signed a treaty with the Free Worlds, agreeing that the Navy will begin pulling out of any occupied systems, and that the Free Worlds will be allowed autonomy in the region they currently control as long as they do not seek to expand their territory further. As of now, our war against the Republic is officially over."
units.italian: Alondo dice: "Abbiamo parlato con il Parlamento, e finalmente cominciano a darci tregua. Hanno firmato un trattato con le Free Worlds, accordando che la Marina comincerà a ritirarsi da tutti i sistemi occupati, e che alle Free Worlds sarà concessa l'autonomia nella regione che controllano attualmente, a patto che non cerchino di espandere ulteriormente il loro territorio. Da questo momento, la nostra guerra contro la Repubblica è ufficialmente finita."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|	Alondo says, "We've been talking to Parliament, and they're finally beginning to let off of us. They have signed a treaty with the Free Worlds, agreeing that the Free Worlds will be allowed autonomy in the region they currently control as long as they do not seek to expand their territory further. As of now, our war against the Republic is officially over."|2719|0
units.english: Alondo says, "We've been talking to Parliament, and they're finally beginning to let off of us. They have signed a treaty with the Free Worlds, agreeing that the Free Worlds will be allowed autonomy in the region they currently control as long as they do not seek to expand their territory further. As of now, our war against the Republic is officially over."
units.italian: Alondo dice: "Abbiamo parlato con il Parlamento, e finalmente cominciano a darci tregua. Hanno firmato un trattato con le Free Worlds, accordando che alle Free Worlds sarà concessa l'autonomia nella regione che controllano attualmente, a patto che non cerchino di espandere ulteriormente il loro territorio. Da questo momento, la nostra guerra contro la Repubblica è ufficialmente finita."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|	"What about you two?" says JJ. "How did fighting the Pug go?"|2722|0
units.english: "What about you two?" says JJ. "How did fighting the Pug go?"
units.italian: "E voi due?" dice JJ. "Com'è andata a finire con i Pug?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|	You and Freya explain to the rest of the Council how the Pug were defeated, as well as the truth behind the Syndicate starting the war. When you finish, Katya says, "Vanishing aliens, prophetic supercomputers starting wars, Alphas pulling strings in the Syndicate's ranks; if I hadn't seen events just as unbelievable over the last few months, I would write what you're saying off as a bad conspiracy theory."|2723|0
units.english: You and Freya explain to the rest of the Council how the Pug were defeated, as well as the truth behind the Syndicate starting the war. When you finish, Katya says, "Vanishing aliens, prophetic supercomputers starting wars, Alphas pulling strings in the Syndicate's ranks; if I hadn't seen events just as unbelievable over the last few months, I would write what you're saying off as a bad conspiracy theory."
units.italian: Tu e Freya spiegate al resto del Consiglio come sono stati sconfitti i Pug, e la verità sul fatto che è stato il Sindacato a far cominciare la guerra. Quando finite, Katya dice: "Alieni che svaniscono, supercomputer profetici che fanno scoppiare guerre, Alphas che tirano i fili nelle file del Sindacato; se non avessi visto eventi altrettanto incredibili negli ultimi mesi, scriverei quello che dite come una brutta teoria del complotto."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|	"Well, it looks like the Council is all together again," says JJ, "for the last time, as it so happens. Now that the war has ended, and the Pug have been defeated, the Senate has voted to dissolve the Council, leaving us free to return to civilian life. However, they've also agreed to pay you, <first>, a reduced salary in gratitude of your service. So, what do you think you will do next?"|2724|0
units.english: "Well, it looks like the Council is all together again," says JJ, "for the last time, as it so happens. Now that the war has ended, and the Pug have been defeated, the Senate has voted to dissolve the Council, leaving us free to return to civilian life. However, they've also agreed to pay you, <first>, a reduced salary in gratitude of your service. So, what do you think you will do next?"
units.italian: "Beh, sembra che il Consiglio sia di nuovo al completo," dice JJ, "per l'ultima volta, a quanto pare. Ora che la guerra è finita e i Pug sono stati sconfitti, il Senato ha votato per sciogliere il Consiglio, lasciandoci liberi di tornare alla vita civile. Tuttavia hanno anche accettato di pagarti, <first>, uno stipendio ridotto in segno di gratitudine per il tuo servizio. Allora, che cosa pensi di fare adesso?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|	"Build a merchant fleet and live a safe, quiet life."|2726|0
units.english: "Build a merchant fleet and live a safe, quiet life."
units.italian: "Metterò su una flotta mercantile e vivrò una vita tranquilla e sicura."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|	"See if folks in the fringe worlds need any help against the pirates."|2727|0
units.english: "See if folks in the fringe worlds need any help against the pirates."
units.italian: "Vedrò se la gente dei mondi di frontiera ha bisogno di aiuto contro i pirati."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|	"Use my jump drive to explore beyond human space."|2728|0
units.english: "Use my jump drive to explore beyond human space."
units.italian: "Userò il mio motore di salto per esplorare oltre lo spazio umano."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Extremists 1C|	"Well, we all wish you the best of luck," says Freya. "We would never have gotten this far without you. Be sure to stay in touch." You hug each of them goodbye, and return to your ship. What you do next is up to you...|2729|0
units.english: "Well, we all wish you the best of luck," says Freya. "We would never have gotten this far without you. Be sure to stay in touch." You hug each of them goodbye, and return to your ship. What you do next is up to you...
units.italian: "Beh, ti auguriamo ogni bene," dice Freya. "Non saremmo mai arrivati fin qui senza di te. Mi raccomando, tieniti in contatto." Abbracci ciascuno di loro per salutarti e torni alla tua nave. Quello che farai adesso dipende da te...
